ko.text: 개미 눈으로 보면 풀잎이 나무처럼 커다래요!
곡식을 톡톡 눌러서 창고로 날라 줘요!
창고 칸이 가득 찼어요! 하나부터 열까지, 열 칸!
베짱이와 꽃을 톡톡 눌러 봐요. 봄 노래가 이어져요!
큰 잎을 톡 눌러서 개미들 우산을 펼쳐 줘요!
도토리를 톡톡 눌러서 창고로 데굴데굴 굴려요!
가을엔 무엇을 입을까? 옷을 골라 봐요!
너무 얇지도, 너무 두껍지도 않은 옷!
겨울엔 무엇을 입을까? 옷을 골라 봐요!
목도리와 털모자예요! 반짝이는 걸 눌러 봐요!
눈 오는 날, 베짱이가 오들오들 떨며 창고 문을 두드렸어요.
"개미야, 먹을 것 좀 나눠 줄 수 있니?"
문을 톡 눌러서 활짝 열어 줄까요?
창고 안이 곡식이랑 도토리로 가득해요! 여름부터 미리 모은 덕분이에요.
먹을 게 이렇게 많으니 친구들도 불러요!
친구가 넷이나 왔어요! 먹을 게 많아서 모두 나눠 먹을 수 있어요.
반딧불이가 불을 밝히고, 겨울 음악회가 시작됐어요!
베짱이가 겨울 노래를 들려줘요. 가만히 들어 봐요.
베짱이랑 친구들을 톡톡 눌러 봐요. 겨울 노래가 이어지고 춤을 춰요!
띠리링~ 짝짝짝! 겨울이 하나도 춥지 않았어요.
계절 카드를 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울 순서대로 톡 눌러 봐요!
봄은 어디 있을까? 봄 카드를 톡!
여름은 어디 있을까? 여름 카드를 톡!
가을은 어디 있을까? 가을 카드를 톡!
겨울은 어디 있을까? 겨울 카드를 톡!
봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울! 계절은 빙글빙글 돌아요.
미리 준비하고 함께 나누니, 겨울도 따뜻했답니다.

en.text: It's summer. The ants march in a line, carrying food.
Tap the marching ants!
Now tap the grasshopper!
Tap the green grasshopper!
"Summer is so fun! Tra-la-la~" The grasshopper sings a song.
Through an ant's eyes, blades of grass look as big as trees!
Tap the grain to carry it to the storeroom!
Tap the yellow grain!
The storeroom is full! From one to ten, ten rooms!
"Let's play together~ Tra-la-la!" the grasshopper sings.
Tap the grasshopper and the flowers. The spring song keeps going!
Some ants passing by said, "We have to get ready for winter!"
"Winter is still far away~" the grasshopper sang again.
Oh no, a rain shower! Pitter-patter, pitter-patter!
Tap the big leaf to open an umbrella for the ants!
Tap the green leaf!
Under the leaf umbrella, the ants are nice and dry.
The grasshopper got soaking wet, all alone. Achoo! But the grasshopper said, "It's okay~" and smiled.
Autumn has come. Colorful leaves are fluttering down.
Tap the acorns to roll them to the storeroom, roll, roll!
Tap the acorns!
The storeroom is even fuller with acorns!
The wind is cool. What should we wear in autumn?
The T-shirt? Brr, brr~ I'm a little cold.
The thick coat? Phew, so hot! Sweat is dripping!
What should we wear in autumn? Pick some clothes!
Not too thin, not too thick!
It's the jacket! Tap the sparkly one!
That's right! A jacket is just right for cool autumn.
Big white snowflakes are falling! Winter is here. Brrr, so cold.
What should we wear in winter?
The T-shirt? Brr, brr~ It's too cold!
Ha ha, swimsuits are for summer~ Ooh, it's cold!
What should we wear in winter? Pick some clothes!
When it snows, keep your head and neck warm!
It's the scarf and the fur hat! Tap the sparkly one!
That's right! With a scarf and a fur hat, it's warm.
The ants hurried into the warm storeroom.
On a snowy day, the grasshopper came shivering and knocked on the storeroom door.
"Ant, could you share some food with me?"
The ant asked, "What did you do in the summer?"
"I sang. Tra-la-la~"
"Then go dance all winter!"
Then the baby ant said, "But Grasshopper looks so cold."
Tap the door to open it wide?
Tap the storeroom door!
"Come in, come in! Let's spend the winter together."
"Thank you! In return, I'll play you some wonderful music!"
The storeroom is full of grain and acorns! That's thanks to gathering ahead of time since summer.
They shared a scarf and a fur hat with the grasshopper, too.
There's so much to eat, so let's invite friends!
Tap the ladybug and invite it in!
One! A ladybug has come.
Tap the snail and invite it in!
Two! A snail has come.
Tap the pill bug and invite it in!
Three! A pill bug has come.
Tap the firefly and invite it in!
Four! A firefly has come.
Four friends came! There's lots of food, so everyone can share.
The firefly lit up its light, and the winter concert began!
The grasshopper plays a winter song. Listen quietly.
Tap the grasshopper and friends. The winter song goes on, and everyone dances!
Tra-la-la~ Clap, clap, clap! Winter wasn't cold at all.
Warm spring has come. Little sprouts pop up!
This time the grasshopper carries food too.
Tap the grasshopper, heave-ho, heave-ho!
"Heave-ho! I'll sing in summer, and work together, too!"
Tap the season cards in order: spring, summer, autumn, winter!
Where is spring? Tap the spring card!
Spring is next! It's the sparkly card.
Tap the spring card!
Tap the spring card!
Where is summer? Tap the summer card!
Summer is next! It's the sparkly card.
Tap the summer card!
Tap the summer card!
Where is autumn? Tap the autumn card!
Autumn is next! It's the sparkly card.
Tap the autumn card!
Tap the autumn card!
Where is winter? Tap the winter card!
Winter is next! It's the sparkly card.
Tap the winter card!
Tap the winter card!
"I'm next~"
Number one, spring!
Number two, summer!
Number three, autumn!
Number four, winter!
Spring, summer, autumn, winter! The seasons go round and round.
By getting ready ahead and sharing together, even winter was warm.

read_ko.key: 창고 밖엔 눈이 펑펑 내렸지만, 안은 포근포근했지요.

read_ko.text: 띠리링~ 짝짝짝! 겨울이 하나도 춥지 않았어요.
read_ko.key: 띠리링~ 짝짝짝! 겨울이 하나도 춥지 않았어요.

read_ko.text: 따뜻한 봄이 왔어요. 새싹이 쏙쏙!
read_ko.key: 따뜻한 봄이 왔어요. 새싹이 쏙쏙!

read_ko.text: 눈이 녹은 풀밭으로 개미들과 베짱이가 나왔어요.
read_ko.key: 눈이 녹은 풀밭으로 개미들과 베짱이가 나왔어요.

read_ko.text: 개미들은 다시 뚜벅뚜벅 줄지어 먹이를 날랐어요.
read_ko.key: 개미들은 다시 뚜벅뚜벅 줄지어 먹이를 날랐어요.

read_ko.text: 이번엔 베짱이도 함께 날라요.
read_ko.key: 이번엔 베짱이도 함께 날라요.

read_ko.text: "영차! 여름엔 노래하고, 일도 함께 할래요!"
read_ko.key: "영차! 여름엔 노래하고, 일도 함께 할래요!"

read_ko.text: 개미들은 베짱이를 보고 방긋방긋 웃었어요.
read_ko.key: 개미들은 베짱이를 보고 방긋방긋 웃었어요.

read_ko.text: 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울! 계절은 빙글빙글 돌아요.
read_ko.key: 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울! 계절은 빙글빙글 돌아요.

read_ko.text: 미리 준비하고 함께 나누니, 겨울도 따뜻했답니다.
read_ko.key: 미리 준비하고 함께 나누니, 겨울도 따뜻했답니다.

read_en.text: It's summer. The ants march in a line, carrying food.
read_en.key: 여름이에요. 개미들이 줄지어 먹이를 날라요.

read_en.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho! The ants carried grain, dripping with sweat.
read_en.key: 영차영차! 개미들은 땀을 뻘뻘 흘리며 곡식을 날랐어요.

read_en.text: Right next to them, the grasshopper lay flopped in the shade of a leaf.
read_en.key: 그 옆에서 베짱이는 풀잎 그늘에 벌렁 누워 있었지요.

read_en.text: "Summer is so fun! Tra-la-la~" The grasshopper sings a song.
read_en.key: "여름은 신나! 띠리링~" 베짱이는 노래를 불러요.

read_en.text: Shall we take a closer look at the ants working in the grass?
read_en.key: 풀밭에서 일하던 개미들을 가까이 들여다볼까요?

read_en.text: Through an ant's eyes, blades of grass look as big as trees!
read_en.key: 개미 눈으로 보면 풀잎이 나무처럼 커다래요!

read_en.text: Even a yellow grain was like a big boulder to an ant.
read_en.key: 노란 곡식 알갱이도 개미한테는 커다란 바위 같았지요.

read_en.text: One by one, the ants lifted them up and marched, stomp, stomp, to the storeroom.
read_en.key: 개미들은 하나씩 번쩍 들어 창고로 뚜벅뚜벅 날랐어요.

read_en.text: The storeroom is full! From one to ten, ten rooms!
read_en.key: 창고 칸이 가득 찼어요! 하나부터 열까지, 열 칸!

read_en.text: Meanwhile, Grasshopper was singing on a leaf.
read_en.key: 그동안 베짱이는 풀잎 위에서 노래하고 있었어요.

read_en.text: "Let's play together~ Tra-la-la!" the grasshopper sings.
read_en.key: "같이 놀자~ 띠리링!" 베짱이가 노래해요.

read_en.text: The flowers swayed, sway, sway, and the butterflies fluttered, flit, flit, in a dance.
read_en.key: 꽃들이 살랑살랑, 나비가 팔랑팔랑 춤을 췄어요.

read_en.text: Some ants passing by said, "We have to get ready for winter!"
read_en.key: 지나가던 개미들이 말했어요. "우린 겨울 준비해야 해!"

read_en.text: "Winter is still far away~" the grasshopper sang again.
read_en.key: "겨울은 아직 멀었는걸~" 베짱이는 또 노래했어요.

read_en.text: The ants shook their heads, no, no, and marched on by.
read_en.key: 개미들은 고개를 절레절레 흔들며 지나갔어요.

read_en.text: Dark clouds gathered over the grass where the ants were carrying food.
read_en.key: 개미들이 먹이를 나르는 풀밭에 먹구름이 몰려왔어요.

read_en.text: Oh no, a rain shower! Pitter-patter, pitter-patter!
read_en.key: 앗, 소나기가 와요! 후두둑 후두둑!

read_en.text: The ants lifted a great big leaf and opened it up like an umbrella.
read_en.key: 개미들은 커다란 잎을 번쩍 들어 우산처럼 펼쳤어요.

read_en.text: Under the leaf umbrella, the ants are nice and dry.
read_en.key: 잎 우산 아래 개미들은 뽀송뽀송해요.

read_en.text: Raindrops came pouring, drip, drop, splash, right on the grasshopper's head.
read_en.key: 빗방울이 베짱이 머리 위로 주룩주룩 쏟아졌어요.

read_en.text: The grasshopper got soaking wet, all alone. Achoo! But the grasshopper said, "It's okay~" and smiled.
read_en.key: 베짱이는 혼자 흠뻑 젖었어요. 에취! 그래도 "괜찮아~" 하고 웃었어요.

read_en.text: Autumn has come. Colorful leaves are fluttering down.
read_en.key: 가을이 왔어요. 나뭇잎이 알록달록 휘날려요.

read_en.text: The ants gathered more winter food in the grass.
read_en.key: 개미들은 풀밭에서 겨울 먹이를 더 모았어요.

read_en.text: The ants rolled acorns, roll, roll, roll, all the way to the storeroom.
read_en.key: 개미들은 도토리를 데굴데굴 굴려 창고로 날랐어요.

read_en.text: The storeroom is even fuller with acorns!
read_en.key: 창고가 도토리로 더 가득해졌어요!

read_en.text: The wind is cool.
read_en.key: 바람이 선선해요.

read_en.text: Brr, it was getting chilly, so the ants put on light jackets.
read_en.key: 개미들은 으슬으슬 추울까 봐 가벼운 재킷을 걸쳤어요.

read_en.text: Big white snowflakes are falling! Winter is here. Brrr, so cold.
read_en.key: 하얀 눈이 펑펑! 겨울이 왔어요. 호호, 추워라.

read_en.text: Soft snow piled up over the ants outside the storehouse.
read_en.key: 창고 밖에 있던 개미들 위로 눈이 소복소복 쌓였어요.

read_en.text: The ants shivered, brrr, brrr, and huddled close together.
read_en.key: 개미들은 오들오들 떨며 서로 꼭 붙었어요.

read_en.text: When it snows, keep your head and neck warm!
read_en.key: 눈이 오면 머리랑 목을 따뜻하게!

read_en.text: The ants put on fluffy scarves and fur hats and smiled big smiles.
read_en.key: 개미들은 폭신한 목도리와 털모자를 쓰고 방긋 웃었어요.

read_en.text: The ants hurried into the warm storeroom.
read_en.key: 개미들은 따뜻한 창고로 쏙 들어갔어요.

read_en.text: Grasshopper had saved no food, and his tummy went rumble, rumble.
read_en.key: 먹이를 모아 두지 않은 베짱이는 배가 꼬르륵 고팠어요.

read_en.text: On a snowy day, the grasshopper came shivering and knocked on the storeroom door.
read_en.key: 눈 오는 날, 베짱이가 오들오들 떨며 창고 문을 두드렸어요.

read_en.text: "Ant, could you share some food with me?"
read_en.key: "개미야, 먹을 것 좀 나눠 줄 수 있니?"

read_en.text: Creak! An ant opened the door and looked at Grasshopper.
read_en.key: 끼익, 문을 연 개미가 베짱이를 바라보았어요.

read_en.text: The ant asked, "What did you do in the summer?"
read_en.key: 개미가 물었어요. "여름엔 뭘 했니?"

read_en.text: "I sang. Tra-la-la~"
read_en.key: "노래했지. 띠리링~"

read_en.text: The ant answered Grasshopper.
read_en.key: 개미가 베짱이에게 대답했어요.

read_en.text: "Then go dance all winter!"
read_en.key: "그럼 겨울엔 춤이나 추렴!"

read_en.text: The grasshopper hung its head low and sniffled, sniff, sniff.
read_en.key: 베짱이는 고개를 푹 숙이고 훌쩍훌쩍 울었어요.

read_en.text: Then the baby ant said, "But Grasshopper looks so cold."
read_en.key: 그때 아기 개미가 말했어요. "그래도 추워 보여요."

read_en.text: "And our storeroom has lots and lots of food." The ant thought for a moment, and then smiled.
read_en.key: "우리 창고엔 먹을 게 아주 많잖아요." 개미는 잠깐 생각하다가 빙긋 웃었어요.

read_en.text: The ant spoke kindly to Grasshopper.
read_en.key: 개미가 베짱이에게 다정하게 말했어요.

read_en.text: "Come in, come in! Let's spend the winter together."
read_en.key: "어서 들어와요! 같이 겨울을 나요."

read_en.text: "Thank you! In return, I'll play you some wonderful music!"
read_en.key: "고마워요! 대신 내가 멋진 음악을 들려줄게요!"

read_en.text: Grasshopper followed the ants into the warm storehouse.
read_en.key: 베짱이는 개미들을 따라 따뜻한 창고 안으로 들어갔어요.

read_en.text: The storeroom is full of grain and acorns! That's thanks to gathering ahead of time since summer.
read_en.key: 창고 안이 곡식이랑 도토리로 가득해요! 여름부터 미리 모은 덕분이에요.

read_en.text: They shared a scarf and a fur hat with the grasshopper, too.
read_en.key: 베짱이에게 목도리와 털모자도 나눠 줬어요.

read_en.text: The grasshopper slurped up warm soup and patted its full tummy, pat, pat.
read_en.key: 베짱이는 따뜻한 수프를 후루룩 마시고 배를 통통 두드렸어요.

read_en.text: There's so much to eat, so let's invite friends!
read_en.key: 먹을 게 이렇게 많으니 친구들도 불러요!

read_en.text: A ladybug, a snail, a pill bug, and a firefly came in, one after another.
read_en.key: 무당벌레, 달팽이, 쥐며느리, 반딧불이가 줄줄이 찾아왔어요.

read_en.text: Four friends came! There's lots of food, so everyone can share.
read_en.key: 친구가 넷이나 왔어요! 먹을 게 많아서 모두 나눠 먹을 수 있어요.

read_en.text: In the storehouse full of friends, Grasshopper picked up his instrument.
read_en.key: 친구들이 모인 창고에서 베짱이가 악기를 들었어요.

read_en.text: The firefly lit up its light, and the winter concert began!
read_en.key: 반딧불이가 불을 밝히고, 겨울 음악회가 시작됐어요!

read_en.text: The grasshopper plays a winter song. Listen quietly.
read_en.key: 베짱이가 겨울 노래를 들려줘요. 가만히 들어 봐요.

read_en.text: Tra-la-la~ The friends bounced their shoulders and stomped their feet, stomp, stomp.
read_en.key: 띠리링~ 친구들은 어깨를 들썩들썩, 발을 콩콩 굴렀어요.

read_en.text: Outside the storeroom, the snow fell thick and heavy, but inside it was warm and snug.
read_en.key: 창고 밖엔 눈이 펑펑 내렸지만, 안은 포근포근했지요.

read_en.text: Tra-la-la~ Clap, clap, clap! Winter wasn't cold at all.
read_en.key: 띠리링~ 짝짝짝! 겨울이 하나도 춥지 않았어요.

read_en.text: Warm spring has come. Little sprouts pop up!
read_en.key: 따뜻한 봄이 왔어요. 새싹이 쏙쏙!

read_en.text: The ants and Grasshopper came out into the grass as the snow melted.
read_en.key: 눈이 녹은 풀밭으로 개미들과 베짱이가 나왔어요.

read_en.text: The ants marched in a line again, stomp, stomp, carrying food.
read_en.key: 개미들은 다시 뚜벅뚜벅 줄지어 먹이를 날랐어요.

read_en.text: This time the grasshopper carries food too.
read_en.key: 이번엔 베짱이도 함께 날라요.

read_en.text: "Heave-ho! I'll sing in summer, and work together, too!"
read_en.key: "영차! 여름엔 노래하고, 일도 함께 할래요!"

read_en.text: The ants looked at the grasshopper and grinned from ear to ear.
read_en.key: 개미들은 베짱이를 보고 방긋방긋 웃었어요.

read_en.text: Spring, summer, autumn, winter! The seasons go round and round.
read_en.key: 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울! 계절은 빙글빙글 돌아요.

read_en.text: By getting ready ahead and sharing together, even winter was warm.
read_en.key: 미리 준비하고 함께 나누니, 겨울도 따뜻했답니다.

ko.text: 옛날에 상인에게 딸이 셋 있었어요. 막내 벨은 마음이 고와서 모두 '미녀'라고 불렀어요.
어느 날 배들이 가라앉아, 가족은 시골 작은 집으로 갔어요.
배 한 척이 돌아왔대요! 아버지가 도시로 떠나요.
그런데 배의 짐은 남의 것이 되어, 아버지는 빈손으로 돌아오다 눈보라에 길을 잃었어요.
멀리 불빛! 커다란 궁전에 아무도 없고, 따뜻한 저녁상만 차려져 있었어요.
아버지는 배불리 먹고, 푹신한 의자에서 잠이 들었어요.
아침이 되자 눈 속에 장미가 활짝 피어 있었어요!
그 덤불은 장미가 두 송이예요. 적어요.
그 덤불은 장미가 다섯 송이예요. 많아요.
자리를 바꿨어요. 장미가 적은 덤불은 어느 쪽일까요?
그때 덤불 뒤에서 커다란 야수가 천천히 나왔어요.
내 장미를 꺾었구나. 재워 주고 먹여 줬는데.
나리가 아니라 야수라고 불러라. 장미를 꺾었으니 벌을 받아야 해. 네가 돌아오든지, 딸 하나가 스스로 오든지.
착하구나. 아버지는 내일 아침 집으로 가거라.
방 문에 '벨의 방'이라고 쓰여 있어요. 책도 많고, 장미도 있어요.
벨, 잘 지냈니? 나와 결혼해 줄래?
벨은 날마다 친절하게 대답했고, 둘은 친구가 되었어요.
창밖은 아침, 낮, 밤으로 바뀌어요. 아침부터 차례로 눌러 봐요.
맞아요, 밤! 아침, 낮, 밤. 하루가 이렇게 지나가요.
어느 날, 벨은 거울로 집을 보았어요.
다녀와요. 하지만 일주일 뒤엔 꼭 돌아와요. 안 오면 나는 너무 슬플 거예요.
자기 전에 이 반지를 탁자에 놓으면, 아침에 여기로 돌아와요.
다음 날 아침, 벨은 집에 와 있었어요.
해가 뜨고 지고, 일주일이 훌쩍 지났어요. 어느 밤, 벨은 꿈을 꾸었어요.
벨은 반지를 탁자에 놓고 다시 잠이 들었어요.
아침이 되자 벨은 궁전 정원에 있었어요. 야수는 샘가에 힘없이 누워 있었어요.
사랑해요, 야수님. 제 남편이 되어 주세요.
그러자 반짝! 야수가 멋진 왕자님으로 변했어요.
고마워요, 벨. 겉모습만 보지 않고 내 마음을 봐 줬어요.

en.text: Once upon a time, a merchant had three daughters. The youngest, Belle, was so kind-hearted that everyone called her Beauty.
One day his ships sank, and the family moved to a small cottage in the countryside.
It's all right. I will do the housework.
One of the ships came back! Father is leaving for the city.
A silk dress for me! And rings and ribbons too!
A single rose is all I need.
All right. I will be back soon.
Tap the horse.
Clip-clop, clip-clop. Father rode off to the city.
But the ship's goods now belonged to someone else. Father came home empty-handed and lost his way in a snowstorm.
A light far away! In a huge palace there was no one at all, only a warm supper laid out on the table.
Is anyone here? ... Thank you, I will gladly eat.
Father ate his fill and fell asleep in a soft armchair.
In the morning, roses were blooming in the snow!
Which bush has MORE roses?
That bush has two roses. That is fewer.
That bush has five roses. That is more.
That's right, five roses! That bush has more.
They switched places! Which bush has FEWER roses?
That's right, two roses! That bush has fewer.
Just one rose, for Belle.
Then, from behind the bush, a huge Beast slowly came out.
You picked my rose. After I gave you a bed and a meal.
I am sorry, my lord. My youngest daughter asked for it.
Do not call me lord. Call me Beast. You picked my rose, so you must be punished. Either you come back, or one of your daughters comes here of her own free will.
Father came home holding the rose.
The Beast... said one of my daughters must go to him.
It is because of my rose. I will go.
No, Belle.
It's all right. I want to go.
Father brought Belle all the way to the palace.
Did you come here of your own free will?
Yes.
You are a good girl. Your father shall go home tomorrow morning.
On the door it says 'Belle's Room'. There are lots of books, and roses too.
Find the rose ON the table.
Find the rose UNDER the table.
Find the rose BESIDE the table.
That one is on the table.
That one is under the table.
That one is beside the table.
That's right, on the table!
That's right, under the table!
That's right, beside the table!
Every evening, the Beast came to see her.
Belle, how are you? Will you marry me?
No, Beast. But I like you very much as a friend.
Then I will come again tomorrow evening.
Belle answered kindly every day, and the two became friends.
Outside the window it turns morning, day, and night. Tap them in order, starting with morning.
That is daytime. Where is the morning?
That is night. Where is the morning?
That's right, morning! What comes after morning?
That is night. What comes after morning?
That's right, daytime! What comes after daytime?
That's right, night! Morning, day, night. That is how a day goes by.
One day, Belle looked at her home through the magic mirror.
Father is ill...
Go to him. But come back in one week, without fail. If you do not, I will be so very sad.
Put this ring on the table before you sleep, and in the morning you will be back here.
I will come back. I promise.
The next morning, Belle was home.
Thanks to you, I am all better.
Stay just a little longer. Please? Just a little.
Maybe I could...
The sun rose and set, and a whole week slipped by. One night, Belle had a dream.
Beast! I broke my promise. I must go back.
Belle put the ring on the table and fell asleep again.
In the morning, Belle was in the palace garden. The Beast lay by the spring, weak and still.
Beast, wake up!
Tap the spring water.
Belle... you came back.
I love you, Beast. Please be my husband.
And then, a flash of light! The Beast turned into a handsome prince.
Thank you, Belle. You did not judge me by my looks. You saw my heart.
The fairy's spell is broken at last.
Father and her sisters came running too.
And they all lived happily together in the palace.
Look at the heart, not the looks.

read_ko.text: 벨은 샘물을 두 손으로 떠서 야수에게 똑똑 떨어뜨려 주었어요.
read_ko.key: 벨은 샘물을 두 손으로 떠서 야수에게 똑똑 떨어뜨려 주었어요.

read_ko.text: 벨… 돌아왔구나.
read_ko.key: 벨… 돌아왔구나.

read_ko.text: 사랑해요, 야수님. 제 남편이 되어 주세요.
read_ko.key: 사랑해요, 야수님. 제 남편이 되어 주세요.

read_ko.text: 그러자 반짝! 야수가 멋진 왕자님으로 변했어요.
read_ko.key: 그러자 반짝! 야수가 멋진 왕자님으로 변했어요.

read_ko.text: 같은 정원에서 벨은 왕자님을 바라보았어요.
read_ko.key: 같은 정원에서 벨은 왕자님을 바라보았어요.

read_ko.text: 벨은 눈을 비비고 또 비볐어요. 야수가 정말 왕자님이 된 거예요!
read_ko.key: 벨은 눈을 비비고 또 비볐어요. 야수가 정말 왕자님이 된 거예요!

read_ko.text: 고마워요, 벨. 겉모습만 보지 않고 내 마음을 봐 줬어요.
read_ko.key: 고마워요, 벨. 겉모습만 보지 않고 내 마음을 봐 줬어요.

read_ko.text: 요정이 건 마법이 이제 풀렸어요.
read_ko.key: 요정이 건 마법이 이제 풀렸어요.

read_ko.text: 두 사람은 손을 꼭 잡고 빙글빙글 돌았어요.
read_ko.key: 두 사람은 손을 꼭 잡고 빙글빙글 돌았어요.

read_ko.text: 아버지와 언니들도 달려왔어요.
read_ko.key: 아버지와 언니들도 달려왔어요.

read_ko.text: 모두 함께 궁전에서 행복하게 살았어요.
read_ko.key: 모두 함께 궁전에서 행복하게 살았어요.

read_ko.text: 겉모습이 아니라 마음을 봐요.
read_ko.key: 겉모습이 아니라 마음을 봐요.

read_en.text: Once upon a time, a merchant had three daughters. The youngest, Belle, was so kind-hearted that everyone called her Beauty.
read_en.key: 옛날에 상인에게 딸이 셋 있었어요. 막내 벨은 마음이 고와서 모두 '미녀'라고 불렀어요.

read_en.text: The older sisters loved pretty dresses and sparkly, twinkly jewels.
read_en.key: 언니들은 예쁜 옷과 반짝반짝 보석을 좋아했어요.

read_en.text: One day his ships sank, and the family moved to a small cottage in the countryside.
read_en.key: 어느 날 배들이 가라앉아, 가족은 시골 작은 집으로 갔어요.

read_en.text: The cottage was small, and the wind whistled, whoo, whoo, through the cracks.
read_en.key: 집은 작고, 바람이 휘휘 새어 들어왔어요.

read_en.text: Belle spoke kindly to her father.
read_en.key: 벨이 아버지에게 다정하게 말했어요.

read_en.text: It's all right. I will do the housework.
read_en.key: 괜찮아요, 제가 집안일을 할게요.

read_en.text: Belle swept the floor, swish, swish, humming a happy little tune.
read_en.key: 벨은 싹싹 빗자루질을 하며 콧노래를 흥얼거렸어요.

read_en.text: Father and his three daughters gathered outside their little cottage.
read_en.key: 작은 집 앞에 아버지와 세 딸이 모였어요.

read_en.text: One of the ships came back! Father is leaving for the city.
read_en.key: 배 한 척이 돌아왔대요! 아버지가 도시로 떠나요.

read_en.text: The older sisters asked Father for gifts.
read_en.key: 언니들은 아버지에게 선물을 부탁했어요.

read_en.text: A silk dress for me! And rings and ribbons too!
read_en.key: 비단옷이요! 반지랑 리본도요!

read_en.text: Belle quietly asked Father for a gift too.
read_en.key: 벨도 아버지에게 조용히 부탁했어요.

read_en.text: A single rose is all I need.
read_en.key: 저는 장미 한 송이면 돼요.

read_en.text: All right. I will be back soon.
read_en.key: 그래, 다녀오마.

read_en.text: Father hopped up, hup, onto the horse's back.
read_en.key: 아버지는 말 등에 훌쩍 올라탔어요.

read_en.text: Clip-clop, clip-clop. Father rode off to the city.
read_en.key: 따각따각, 아버지가 도시로 떠났어요.

read_en.text: Belle waved and waved, until Father was out of sight.
read_en.key: 벨은 아버지가 보이지 않을 때까지 손을 흔들흔들 했어요.

read_en.text: But the ship's goods now belonged to someone else. Father came home empty-handed and lost his way in a snowstorm.
read_en.key: 그런데 배의 짐은 남의 것이 되어, 아버지는 빈손으로 돌아오다 눈보라에 길을 잃었어요.

read_en.text: The forest grew dark as Father rode through it.
read_en.key: 아버지가 말을 타고 지나던 숲은 어두워졌어요.

read_en.text: The snow came down thick and fast, and the wind blew, whoosh, whoosh.
read_en.key: 눈이 펑펑 쏟아지고, 바람이 쌩쌩 불었어요.

read_en.text: A light far away! In a huge palace there was no one at all, only a warm supper laid out on the table.
read_en.key: 멀리 불빛! 커다란 궁전에 아무도 없고, 따뜻한 저녁상만 차려져 있었어요.

read_en.text: The great big door swung open all by itself, creeeak.
read_en.key: 커다란 문이 저절로 스르르 열렸어요.

read_en.text: Father went inside the palace and up to the table.
read_en.key: 아버지는 궁전 안 식탁 앞으로 들어갔어요.

read_en.text: Is anyone here? ... Thank you, I will gladly eat.
read_en.key: 누구 계세요? …고맙게 먹겠습니다.

read_en.text: Yum, yum, munch, munch! The warm soup and bread were so delicious.
read_en.key: 냠냠, 쩝쩝! 따뜻한 수프와 빵이 정말 맛있었어요.

read_en.text: Father ate his fill and fell asleep in a soft armchair.
read_en.key: 아버지는 배불리 먹고, 푹신한 의자에서 잠이 들었어요.

read_en.text: Father woke up and went out into the palace garden.
read_en.key: 잠에서 깬 아버지는 궁전 정원으로 나왔어요.

read_en.text: In the morning, roses were blooming in the snow!
read_en.key: 아침이 되자 눈 속에 장미가 활짝 피어 있었어요!

read_en.text: One bush had five roses and the other had two, all sparkling, twinkle, twinkle, in the snow.
read_en.key: 덤불 하나엔 장미 다섯 송이, 다른 덤불엔 두 송이가 반짝반짝 빛났어요.

read_en.text: Just one rose, for Belle.
read_en.key: 벨에게 줄 장미 한 송이만.

read_en.text: Father snapped off a single rose, snip.
read_en.key: 아버지는 장미 한 송이를 똑 꺾었어요.

read_en.text: Then, from behind the bush, a huge Beast slowly came out.
read_en.key: 그때 덤불 뒤에서 커다란 야수가 천천히 나왔어요.

read_en.text: Thump, thump! The ground shook with every footstep.
read_en.key: 쿵, 쿵! 발소리에 땅이 흔들흔들했어요.

read_en.text: You picked my rose. After I gave you a bed and a meal.
read_en.key: 내 장미를 꺾었구나. 재워 주고 먹여 줬는데.

read_en.text: I am sorry, my lord. My youngest daughter asked for it.
read_en.key: 죄송해요, 나리. 막내딸이 부탁한 거예요.

read_en.text: Father was so startled that his hat fell to the ground. Plop!
read_en.key: 놀란 아버지의 모자가 바닥에 툭 떨어졌어요.

read_en.text: Do not call me lord. Call me Beast. You picked my rose, so you must be punished. Either you come back, or one of your daughters comes here of her own free will.
read_en.key: 나리가 아니라 야수라고 불러라. 장미를 꺾었으니 벌을 받아야 해. 네가 돌아오든지, 딸 하나가 스스로 오든지.

read_en.text: Father trembled, shiver, shiver, and nodded his head, nod, nod.
read_en.key: 아버지는 덜덜 떨며 고개를 끄덕끄덕했어요.

read_en.text: Father came home holding the rose.
read_en.key: 아버지는 장미를 들고 집으로 돌아왔어요.

read_en.text: Back in the cottage, the three daughters listened to Father.
read_en.key: 작은 집에서 세 딸이 아버지의 이야기를 들었어요.

read_en.text: The Beast... said one of my daughters must go to him.
read_en.key: 야수가… 딸 하나를 보내라고 했단다.

read_en.text: The sisters gasped, and their mouths fell wide open.
read_en.key: 언니들은 깜짝 놀라 입을 떡 벌렸어요.

read_en.text: It is because of my rose. I will go.
read_en.key: 제 장미 때문이에요. 제가 갈게요.

read_en.text: No, Belle.
read_en.key: 안 된다, 벨.

read_en.text: It's all right. I want to go.
read_en.key: 괜찮아요. 제가 가고 싶어요.

read_en.text: Belle held Father's hand tight and gave him a sweet little smile.
read_en.key: 벨은 아버지의 손을 꼭 잡고 방긋 웃었어요.

read_en.text: Father brought Belle all the way to the palace.
read_en.key: 아버지는 벨을 궁전까지 데려다주었어요.

read_en.text: Beast was waiting for them in the garden.
read_en.key: 정원에서는 야수가 두 사람을 기다리고 있었어요.

read_en.text: Belle's heart went thump, thump, thump.
read_en.key: 벨의 가슴이 두근두근 뛰었어요.

read_en.text: Did you come here of your own free will?
read_en.key: 스스로 온 거니?

read_en.text: Yes.
read_en.key: 네.

read_en.text: You are a good girl. Your father shall go home tomorrow morning.
read_en.key: 착하구나. 아버지는 내일 아침 집으로 가거라.

read_en.text: Belle went to her own room inside the palace.
read_en.key: 벨은 궁전 안에 마련된 자기 방으로 갔어요.

read_en.text: On the door it says 'Belle's Room'. There are lots of books, and roses too.
read_en.key: 방 문에 '벨의 방'이라고 쓰여 있어요. 책도 많고, 장미도 있어요.

read_en.text: There were roses on the table, under the table and beside it, all blooming wide, wide open.
read_en.key: 탁자 위에도, 아래에도, 옆에도 장미가 활짝활짝 피어 있었어요.

read_en.text: Belle flopped down, plop, onto the soft bed and opened a book.
read_en.key: 벨은 폭신한 침대에 풀썩 누워 책을 펼쳤어요.

read_en.text: The next morning, Father went home.
read_en.key: 다음 날 아침, 아버지는 집으로 돌아갔어요.

read_en.text: Belle stayed at the palace and sat at the table each evening.
read_en.key: 궁전에 남은 벨은 저녁이면 식탁에 앉았어요.

read_en.text: Every evening, the Beast came to see her.
read_en.key: 저녁마다 야수가 찾아왔어요.

read_en.text: The Beast sat down gently across from Belle, ever so carefully.
read_en.key: 야수는 조심조심, 벨의 맞은편에 살며시 앉았어요.

read_en.text: Belle, how are you? Will you marry me?
read_en.key: 벨, 잘 지냈니? 나와 결혼해 줄래?

read_en.text: No, Beast. But I like you very much as a friend.
read_en.key: 아니요, 야수님. 하지만 친구로 좋아해요.

read_en.text: Then I will come again tomorrow evening.
read_en.key: 그럼 내일 저녁에 또 올게.

read_en.text: Belle answered kindly every day, and the two became friends.
read_en.key: 벨은 날마다 친절하게 대답했고, 둘은 친구가 되었어요.

read_en.text: Outside the window it turned morning, day and night, and the days slipped by, one after another.
read_en.key: 창밖은 아침, 낮, 밤으로 바뀌고, 날들이 술술 흘러갔어요.

read_en.text: One evening, Beast was with Belle in her room.
read_en.key: 어느 저녁, 야수는 벨의 방에 함께 있었어요.

read_en.text: One day, Belle looked at her home through the magic mirror.
read_en.key: 어느 날, 벨은 거울로 집을 보았어요.

read_en.text: It was a magic mirror that could show her faraway home.
read_en.key: 그 거울은 멀리 있는 집도 보여 주는 신기한 거울이었어요.

read_en.text: In the mirror, Father was coughing, cough, cough.
read_en.key: 거울 속에서 아버지가 콜록콜록 기침을 했어요.

read_en.text: Father is ill...
read_en.key: 아버지가 아파요…

read_en.text: Beast spoke to worried Belle.
read_en.key: 야수가 걱정하는 벨에게 말했어요.

read_en.text: Go to him. But come back in one week, without fail. If you do not, I will be so very sad.
read_en.key: 다녀와요. 하지만 일주일 뒤엔 꼭 돌아와요. 안 오면 나는 너무 슬플 거예요.

read_en.text: Put this ring on the table before you sleep, and in the morning you will be back here.
read_en.key: 자기 전에 이 반지를 탁자에 놓으면, 아침에 여기로 돌아와요.

read_en.text: The little gold ring sparkled, twinkle, twinkle.
read_en.key: 작은 금반지가 반짝반짝 빛났어요.

read_en.text: I will come back. I promise.
read_en.key: 꼭 돌아올게요, 약속해요.

read_en.text: The next morning, Belle was home.
read_en.key: 다음 날 아침, 벨은 집에 와 있었어요.

read_en.text: Belle took gentle care of her sick father.
read_en.key: 벨은 아픈 아버지를 정성껏 돌보았어요.

read_en.text: Thanks to you, I am all better.
read_en.key: 네 덕분에 다 나았다.

read_en.text: When Father was well, the sisters asked Belle to stay.
read_en.key: 아버지가 나아지자 언니들이 벨을 붙잡았어요.

read_en.text: Stay just a little longer. Please? Just a little.
read_en.key: 조금만 더 있다 가. 응? 조금만 더.

read_en.text: Maybe I could...
read_en.key: 그럴까…

read_en.text: The sun rose and set, and a whole week slipped by. One night, Belle had a dream.
read_en.key: 해가 뜨고 지고, 일주일이 훌쩍 지났어요. 어느 밤, 벨은 꿈을 꾸었어요.

read_en.text: In her dream, the Beast lay slumped by the spring, all limp and still.
read_en.key: 꿈속에서 야수가 샘가에 축 늘어져 있었어요.

read_en.text: Beast! I broke my promise. I must go back.
read_en.key: 야수님! 약속을 어겼어요. 돌아가야 해요.

read_en.text: Belle put the ring on the table and fell asleep again.
read_en.key: 벨은 반지를 탁자에 놓고 다시 잠이 들었어요.

read_en.text: In the morning, Belle was in the palace garden. The Beast lay by the spring, weak and still.
read_en.key: 아침이 되자 벨은 궁전 정원에 있었어요. 야수는 샘가에 힘없이 누워 있었어요.

read_en.text: Belle ran over, pitter-patter, and dropped to her knees beside the Beast.
read_en.key: 벨은 후다닥 달려가 야수 곁에 털썩 무릎을 꿇었어요.

read_en.text: Beast, wake up!
read_en.key: 야수님, 일어나요!

read_en.text: Belle scooped up spring water in her hands and let it drip, drip, drip onto the Beast.
read_en.key: 벨은 샘물을 두 손으로 떠서 야수에게 똑똑 떨어뜨려 주었어요.

read_en.text: Belle... you came back.
read_en.key: 벨… 돌아왔구나.

read_en.text: I love you, Beast. Please be my husband.
read_en.key: 사랑해요, 야수님. 제 남편이 되어 주세요.

read_en.text: And then, a flash of light! The Beast turned into a handsome prince.
read_en.key: 그러자 반짝! 야수가 멋진 왕자님으로 변했어요.

read_en.text: There in the garden, Belle looked at the prince.
read_en.key: 같은 정원에서 벨은 왕자님을 바라보았어요.

read_en.text: Belle rubbed her eyes and rubbed them again. The Beast really had become a prince!
read_en.key: 벨은 눈을 비비고 또 비볐어요. 야수가 정말 왕자님이 된 거예요!

read_en.text: Thank you, Belle. You did not judge me by my looks. You saw my heart.
read_en.key: 고마워요, 벨. 겉모습만 보지 않고 내 마음을 봐 줬어요.

read_en.text: The fairy's spell is broken at last.
read_en.key: 요정이 건 마법이 이제 풀렸어요.

read_en.text: The two held hands tight and twirled round and round.
read_en.key: 두 사람은 손을 꼭 잡고 빙글빙글 돌았어요.

read_en.text: Father and her sisters came running too.
read_en.key: 아버지와 언니들도 달려왔어요.

read_en.text: And they all lived happily together in the palace.
read_en.key: 모두 함께 궁전에서 행복하게 살았어요.

read_en.text: Look at the heart, not the looks.
read_en.key: 겉모습이 아니라 마음을 봐요.

ko.text: 옛날 옛날, 방앗간에 늙은 당나귀가 살았어요.

꼬끼오 하고 우는 친구는 누굴까? 다시 들어 봐요.
당나귀: "그럼 우리 같이 브레멘에 가서 음악가가 되자!"

en.text: Once upon a time, an old donkey lived at a mill.
Give the donkey a tap!
Tap the donkey!
The donkey had carried heavy sacks of grain for a very long time. Now the donkey was too tired.
Miller: "You can't work anymore. I have to send you away."
Donkey: "That's okay! I'll go to Bremen and become a musician!"
The donkey walked along the road, and a bush began to wiggle and wobble.
Woof, woof, from behind the bush! Who could it be?
Who goes woof, woof? Listen again.
Who goes meow? Listen again.
Who goes cock-a-doodle-doo? Listen again.
It's the donkey! Tap the sparkling friend!
It's the dog! Tap the sparkling friend!
It's the cat! Tap the sparkling friend!
It's the rooster! Tap the sparkling friend!
The dog went huff, huff, with a long tongue sticking out.
Dog: "I got too old to hunt, so I was sent away."
Donkey: "Then come with us! Let's go to Bremen and be musicians together!"
A meow from up on the wall! Who could it be?
This cat's whiskers are drooping. "I can't catch mice anymore, so I was sent away."
Dog: "Come with us! Let's sing in Bremen!"
A cock-a-doodle-doo from up on the roof! Who could it be?
Rooster: "They say I'm not needed anymore. Cock-a-doodle-doo..."
Donkey: "Join our band! Your voice is the best!"
Donkey, dog, cat, and rooster. Four friends together at last!
Let's practice singing on the grassy roadside. The donkey will go first. Listen well, then tap just the same!
This time there are three! Listen carefully.
This is the last song. Listen carefully.
Now tap just the same!
Ha ha, that made a brand-new song! Try once more!
Whose sound came first?
Whose sound came next?
Woof, meow! Well done!
Hee-haw, woof, cock-a-doodle-doo! What a wonderful song!
Meow, cock-a-doodle-doo, hee-haw! The best band ever!
The sun went down, and the forest grew dark. The owl went hoo, hoo.
Let's walk through the forest.
Tap, tap, tap! Through the forest we go.
The rooster flapped up to the top of a tree.
Rooster: "I see a light over there! There's a house!"
Light is shining out of a window. But it's so high that no one can reach it.
Let's climb onto each other's backs and build a tower! The biggest, heaviest friend goes at the bottom.
Who will stand at the bottom?
Who goes at the very top?
Who will climb onto the donkey's back?
Who will climb onto the dog's back?
Dog: "Oof, so heavy! I'll go up on top instead~"
Cat: "Oof, so heavy! I'll go up on top instead~"
Rooster: "Oof, so heavy! I'll go up on top instead~"
Wobble, wobble! The bigger, heavier friend goes first.
The donkey goes at the bottom! So strong.
Donkey, dog, cat, rooster! The rooster reached the window!
Peeking through the window, three robbers are counting gold coins and eating tasty food.
Robber: "Look at all this gold! Ha ha ha!"
Rooster: "Let's play our music nice and loud!"
This song will scare the robbers. Listen first!
This time, tap the friend who is singing!
All together, as loud as you can!
Tap, tap, tap the tower! Sing even louder!
The robbers yelled, "A monster!" and scampered off into the forest.
The four friends munched the leftover food, put out the light, and fell fast asleep.
In the middle of the night, one robber tiptoed back. Shh!
Something is sparkling in the fireplace! Give it a tap.
Robber: "Ouch, that stings! I thought it was a glowing ember!"
Another sparkle by the door! Give it a tap.
Robber: "Ow! Something poked my leg!"
There's a sparkle in the pile of straw, too! Give it a tap.
Robber: "Yikes! Something kicked me, boom!"
And another sparkle up on the high beam! Give it a tap.
Robber: "Help me~!"
Robber: "In that house, a ghost scratched me, someone poked my leg, a giant kicked me, and up on the roof a judge shouted, 'Catch the thief!'"
It was really a cat, a dog, a donkey, and a rooster! The robbers never came back.
Morning came. The four friends loved this house.
"We never got to Bremen, but this is our home!"
Let's play the song of joy!
This time, tap the friends and play together!
Together, the Bremen Town Musicians were so happy.

read_en.text: Once upon a time, an old donkey lived at a mill.
read_en.key: 옛날 옛날, 방앗간에 늙은 당나귀가 살았어요.

read_en.text: The donkey had carried heavy sacks of grain for a very long time. Now the donkey was too tired.
read_en.key: 당나귀는 오랫동안 무거운 곡식 자루를 날랐어요. 이제는 힘이 없어요.

read_en.text: Its legs wobbled, and its long ears drooped down low.
read_en.key: 다리는 후들후들, 귀는 축 늘어졌지요.

read_en.text: Miller: "You can't work anymore. I have to send you away."
read_en.key: 주인: "이제 일을 못 하겠구나. 너를 내보내야겠다."

read_en.text: The donkey felt sad for a moment, but soon its ears perked right up.
read_en.key: 당나귀는 잠깐 슬펐지만, 곧 귀를 쫑긋 세웠어요.

read_en.text: Donkey: "That's okay! I'll go to Bremen and become a musician!"
read_en.key: 당나귀: "괜찮아! 브레멘에 가서 음악가가 될 거야!"

read_en.text: The donkey walked along the road, and a bush began to wiggle and wobble.
read_en.key: 당나귀가 길을 가는데, 덤불이 흔들흔들.

read_en.text: Woof, woof, from behind the bush!
read_en.key: 덤불 뒤에서 멍멍!

read_en.text: Out from behind the bush crawled an old dog, slow and creaky.
read_en.key: 덤불 뒤에서 늙은 강아지가 엉금엉금 나왔어요.

read_en.text: The dog went huff, huff, with a long tongue sticking out.
read_en.key: 강아지가 헉헉, 혀를 쭉 내밀었어요.

read_en.text: Dog: "I got too old to hunt, so I was sent away."
read_en.key: 강아지: "늙어서 사냥을 못 한다고 내보내졌어요."

read_en.text: Donkey: "Then come with us! Let's go to Bremen and be musicians together!"
read_en.key: 당나귀: "그럼 우리 같이 브레멘에 가서 음악가가 되자!"

read_en.text: As the two friends plodded along the village road, a sound came from up on the wall.
read_en.key: 두 친구가 마을 길을 터벅터벅 걷는데, 담장 위에서 소리가 났어요.

read_en.text: A meow from up on the wall!
read_en.key: 담장 위에서 야옹~

read_en.text: This cat's whiskers are drooping. "I can't catch mice anymore, so I was sent away."
read_en.key: 수염이 축 처진 고양이예요. "쥐를 못 잡는다고 내보내졌어."

read_en.text: Dog: "Come with us! Let's sing in Bremen!"
read_en.key: 강아지: "우리랑 같이 가자! 브레멘에서 노래하자!"

read_en.text: Cat: "Meow, I can sing too!"
read_en.key: 고양이: "야옹, 나도 노래라면 자신 있어!"

read_en.text: The cat hopped lightly, pit-pat, down from the wall and stood beside its new friends.
read_en.key: 고양이는 담장에서 사뿐사뿐 뛰어내려 친구들 곁에 섰어요.

read_en.text: The three friends were passing a house in the village.
read_en.key: 세 친구가 마을 집 앞을 지나가고 있었어요.

read_en.text: A cock-a-doodle-doo from up on the roof!
read_en.key: 지붕 위에서 꼬끼오!

read_en.text: Up on the roof sat a rooster, its head hanging low.
read_en.key: 지붕 위의 닭은 고개를 푹 숙이고 있었어요.

read_en.text: Rooster: "They say I'm not needed anymore. Cock-a-doodle-doo..."
read_en.key: 닭: "이제 나는 필요 없대. 꼬끼오…"

read_en.text: Donkey: "Join our band! Your voice is the best!"
read_en.key: 당나귀: "우리랑 음악대 하자! 네 목소리 최고야!"

read_en.text: The rooster flapped down, flutter, flutter, and hopped right in front of the friends.
read_en.key: 닭은 푸드덕 날아 내려와 친구들 앞에 폴짝 섰어요.

read_en.text: Donkey, dog, cat, and rooster. Four friends together at last!
read_en.key: 당나귀, 강아지, 고양이, 닭. 친구 넷이 모였어요!

read_en.text: The four friends practiced their songs on the grassy roadside, full of cheer.
read_en.key: 친구 넷은 길가 풀밭에서 신나게 노래 연습을 했어요.

read_en.text: Hee-haw! Woof! Meow! Cock-a-doodle-doo! One at a time, and then all together!
read_en.key: 히힝! 멍멍! 야옹! 꼬끼오! 한 명씩 차례로, 그다음엔 다 같이!

read_en.text: Meow, cock-a-doodle-doo, hee-haw! The best band ever!
read_en.key: 야옹, 꼬끼오, 히힝! 최고의 음악대예요!

read_en.text: After singing practice, the four friends set off along a forest path.
read_en.key: 노래 연습을 마친 친구 넷은 숲길로 들어섰어요.

read_en.text: The sun went down, and the forest grew dark. The owl went hoo, hoo.
read_en.key: 해가 지고 캄캄한 숲이 되었어요. 부엉이가 부엉부엉.

read_en.text: Let's walk through the forest.
read_en.key: 숲을 지나가요.

read_en.text: Bremen was still far away. The friends' legs were tired, and their tummies went grumble, grumble.
read_en.key: 브레멘은 아직 멀었어요. 친구들은 다리가 아프고 배가 꼬르륵 고팠지요.

read_en.text: The rooster flapped up to the top of a tree.
read_en.key: 닭이 나무 꼭대기로 푸드덕 올라갔어요.

read_en.text: Rooster: "I see a light over there! There's a house!"
read_en.key: 닭: "저기 불빛이 보여요! 집이 있어요!"

read_en.text: The friends tiptoed quietly, step by step, toward the light.
read_en.key: 친구들은 불빛을 따라 살금살금 걸어갔어요.

read_en.text: The four friends reached the house in the woods.
read_en.key: 친구 넷은 숲속 집 앞에 도착했어요.

read_en.text: Light is shining out of a window. But it's so high that no one can reach it.
read_en.key: 불빛이 새어 나오는 창문이에요. 그런데 너무 높아서 아무도 안 닿아요.

read_en.text: Let's climb onto each other's backs and build a tower!
read_en.key: 서로 등에 올라서 탑을 쌓아요!

read_en.text: The donkey goes at the bottom! So strong.
read_en.key: 당나귀가 맨 아래! 튼튼해요.

read_en.text: Hop! The dog climbed on top, and then, pit-pat, the cat climbed up on the dog.
read_en.key: 그 위에 강아지가 폴짝, 또 그 위에 고양이가 사뿐 올라갔어요.

read_en.text: Wobble, wobble! The bigger, heavier friend goes first.
read_en.key: 흔들흔들! 더 크고 무거운 친구가 먼저예요.

read_en.text: Donkey, dog, cat, rooster! The rooster reached the window!
read_en.key: 당나귀, 강아지, 고양이, 닭! 닭이 창문에 닿았어요!

read_en.text: Rooster, up on top, peeped into the house.
read_en.key: 맨 위에 올라간 닭이 집 안을 살펴보았어요.

read_en.text: Peeking through the window, three robbers are counting gold coins and eating tasty food.
read_en.key: 창문 안을 들여다보니, 도둑 셋이 금화를 세며 맛있는 걸 먹고 있어요.

read_en.text: Robber: "Look at all this gold! Ha ha ha!"
read_en.key: 도둑: "금화가 잔뜩이다! 하하하!"

read_en.text: Robber: "Yum, yum, all this bread and meat is mine, mine, mine!"
read_en.key: 도둑: "이 빵도 고기도 냠냠, 다 내 거야!"

read_en.text: The rooster whispered, psst, psst, to its friends.
read_en.key: 닭이 친구들에게 소곤소곤 속삭였어요.

read_en.text: Rooster: "Let's play our music nice and loud!"
read_en.key: 닭: "우리 음악을 크게 들려주자!"

read_en.text: Outside the window, the four friends got ready to sing together.
read_en.key: 창문 밖의 친구 넷이 함께 노래할 준비를 했어요.

read_en.text: All together, as loud as you can!
read_en.key: 다 같이 목청껏!

read_en.text: Hee-haw! Woof! Meow! Cock-a-doodle-doo! And then, crash, they tumbled in through the window!
read_en.key: 히힝! 멍멍! 야옹! 꼬끼오! 그리고 와장창, 창문으로 뛰어들었어요!

read_en.text: The robbers yelled, "A monster!" and scampered off into the forest.
read_en.key: 도둑들은 "괴물이다!" 하고 숲으로 후다닥 달아났어요.

read_en.text: The four friends munched the leftover food, put out the light, and fell fast asleep.
read_en.key: 친구 넷은 남은 음식을 냠냠 먹고, 불을 끄고 잠이 들었어요.

read_en.text: Inside the dark house, each friend found a place to rest.
read_en.key: 어두운 집 안에서 친구 넷은 저마다 자리를 잡았어요.

read_en.text: Cat lay by the fireplace, and Dog lay by the door.
read_en.key: 고양이는 아궁이에, 강아지는 문 앞에 누웠어요.

read_en.text: Donkey rested in the straw, and Rooster perched on a beam overhead.
read_en.key: 당나귀는 짚더미에, 닭은 천장 아래 나무 위에 있었어요.

read_en.text: In the middle of the night, one robber tiptoed back. Shh!
read_en.key: 한밤중, 도둑 하나가 살금살금 돌아왔어요. 쉿!

read_en.text: Something twinkled in the fireplace! The robber thought it was an ember and slowly reached out his hand.
read_en.key: 아궁이에서 뭔가 반짝반짝! 도둑은 불씨인 줄 알고 손을 살며시 내밀었지요.

read_en.text: Those two little lights were Cat’s eyes.
read_en.key: 반짝이던 것은 고양이의 두 눈이었어요.

read_en.text: Cat woke up and scratched the robber’s hand.
read_en.key: 잠에서 깬 고양이가 도둑의 손을 할퀴었어요.

read_en.text: Robber: "Ouch, that stings! I thought it was a glowing ember!"
read_en.key: 도둑: "앗, 따가워! 불씨인 줄 알았는데!"

read_en.text: By the door, the dog nipped at his leg.
read_en.key: 문 앞에서는 강아지가 다리를 덥석 물었어요.

read_en.text: Robber: "Ow! Something poked my leg!"
read_en.key: 도둑: "아얏! 다리를 콕 찔렸어!"

read_en.text: In the pile of straw, the donkey gave him a big kick with its back legs.
read_en.key: 짚더미에서는 당나귀가 뒷발로 뻥 찼어요.

read_en.text: Robber: "Yikes! Something kicked me, boom!"
read_en.key: 도둑: "으악! 누가 쿵 찼어!"

read_en.text: And up on the beam, the rooster crowed, cock-a-doodle-doo!
read_en.key: 그리고 들보 위에서 닭이 꼬끼오! 하고 크게 울었어요.

read_en.text: Robber: "Help me~!"
read_en.key: 도둑: "살려 줘~!"

read_en.text: The robber ran into the woods and told the other robbers.
read_en.key: 도둑은 숲으로 달아나 다른 도둑들에게 말했어요.

read_en.text: Robber: "In that house, a ghost scratched me, someone poked my leg, a giant kicked me, and up on the roof a judge shouted, 'Catch the thief!'"
read_en.key: 도둑: "그 집엔 귀신이 할퀴고, 누가 다리를 콕 찌르고, 거인이 쿵 차고, 지붕에선 재판관이 도둑 잡아라! 소리쳤어!"

read_en.text: It was really a cat, a dog, a donkey, and a rooster! The robbers never came back.
read_en.key: 사실은 고양이, 강아지, 당나귀, 닭이었는데 말이에요! 도둑들은 다시는 오지 않았어요.

read_en.text: Morning came. The four friends loved this house.
read_en.key: 아침이 밝았어요. 친구 넷은 이 집이 참 좋았어요.

read_en.text: Together in the house, the four friends decided to stay.
read_en.key: 집 안에 모인 친구 넷은 여기서 살기로 했어요.

read_en.text: The four friends were so happy they hopped and hopped for joy.
read_en.key: 친구 넷은 신이 나서 폴짝폴짝 뛰었어요.

read_en.text: "We never got to Bremen, but this is our home!"
read_en.key: "브레멘은 못 갔지만, 여기가 우리 집이야!"

read_en.text: Donkey: "With all of us together, nothing is scary at all!"
read_en.key: 당나귀: "다 같이 있으니까 하나도 안 무서워!"

read_en.text: Rooster: "Now let's sing our song of joy! Cock-a-doodle-doo!"
read_en.key: 닭: "자, 이제 기쁨의 노래를 부르자! 꼬끼오!"

read_en.text: Together, the Bremen Town Musicians were so happy.
read_en.key: 함께라서 행복한 브레멘 음악대였답니다.

read_en.text: Old or small, when friends stick together, they can do anything at all.
read_en.key: 나이 들어도, 작아도, 함께라면 무엇이든 해낼 수 있답니다.

ko.text: 깊고 깊은 바다 밑에 용궁이 있어요.

뭍에서도 걸을 수 있는 친구를 톡 눌러 봐요.
저는 물 밖에선 숨을 못 쉬어요…
저는 물에서도 뭍에서도 걸을 수 있어요.
자라가 가거라. 화공은 토끼를 그려 주어라.
화공이 토끼 그림을 그렸어요. 귀는 길쭉, 꼬리는 짧게.
자라는 바다 위로 올라왔어요. 햇빛이 눈부셔요.
토끼네! 저 산에 살아. 왼쪽으로 가시오.
토끼는 저 바위 뒤에. 가운데로 가시오.

en.text: Deep, deep under the sea, there is a sea palace.
The Dragon King is sick. Cough, cough.
Oh dear, my whole body aches.
If you eat the liver of a rabbit that lives on land, you will get better.
Who will bring me a rabbit's liver?
Me! I have eight legs, so I am the fastest!
Mr. Octopus, on land your legs are too slippery to walk.
I can too walk!
The octopus puffs and puffs inside his ink cloud. And fish cannot breathe on land.
Tap the friend who can walk on land too.
I cannot breathe out of the water...
M-me... I am all slippery...
I can walk in the water and on land.
Terrapin, you go. Painter, draw a rabbit for him.
The painter drew a rabbit. Long ears, and a short tail.
I will take this picture and find the rabbit!
The terrapin came up out of the sea. The sunlight is dazzling.
The land is so bright!
Mr. Seagull, where is this animal?
That is a rabbit! It lives on that mountain. Go left.
Tap the path on the left.
Huh? Not this way.
Left, left.
The terrapin crawled slowly, slowly up the mountain.
Miss Squirrel, where is this animal?
A rabbit? Go right.
Tap the path on the right.
Mr. Boar, where is this animal?
The rabbit is behind that rock. Go straight up the middle.
Tap the path in the middle.
Who is looking for me?
Long ears, a short tail... the same! You are the rabbit.
Mr. Rabbit, come to the sea palace and you will get a high post.
And there are lots of tasty treats.
A high post? Tasty treats? Yes, I will go!
The rabbit followed right away. He only thought about the good things.
Climb on my back. Hold on tight!
Tap the terrapin's back.
The terrapin carried the rabbit down into the sea.
Wow, fish! It is so blue under the sea.
Here is the sea palace. The doors open, one by one.
Welcome!
Wow, pearls and coral, all sparkly!
Now, let us go to the Dragon King.
Rabbit, welcome. Give me your liver.
What face did the rabbit make? Tap the surprised face.
This is no time to smile.
What?! My liver?
Only then did the rabbit understand. The terrapin had told a lie.
What do I do... Do not be scared. Think.
Your Majesty, I took my liver out and left it drying on a rock in the mountains.
The terrapin did not tell me before. I will go and get it!
Is that so? Then go and bring it quickly.
The Dragon King believed the rabbit.
I will take him there and back.
The terrapin carried the rabbit back to land.
Mr. Terrapin, what animal takes its liver out and leaves it behind? Ha ha!
I will never be fooled by sweet words again!
Oh dear... I was tricked.
Tap the rabbit.
Bye-bye!
The terrapin lay down on the beach and sighed.
What will I tell the Dragon King...
Just then, the mountain spirit appeared.
Terrapin, you tried so hard for your king. Take this medicine to the Dragon King.
Thank you, mountain spirit!
The terrapin hugged the medicine and went back to the sea.
Ah, now I am all better!
Laughter came back to the sea palace.

read_en.key: 잉어 의원이 약탕기를 들고 곰곰이 생각했어요.

read_en.text: If you eat the liver of a rabbit that lives on land, you will get better.

read_en.text: The Dragon King called all his courtiers into the great hall.
read_en.key: 용왕님은 신하들을 모두 큰 방으로 불렀어요.

read_en.text: Who will bring me a rabbit's liver?
read_en.key: 누가 토끼 간을 가져오겠느냐?

read_en.text: Me! I have eight legs, so I am the fastest!
read_en.key: 제가요! 다리가 여덟이니 제일 빨라요!

read_en.text: Mr. Octopus, on land your legs are too slippery to walk.
read_en.key: 문어님, 뭍에서는 다리가 미끌미끌해서 못 걸어요.

read_en.text: I can too walk!
read_en.key: 걸을 수 있다니까!

read_en.text: The octopus puffs and puffs inside his ink cloud. And fish cannot breathe on land.
read_en.key: 문어는 먹물 속에서 뻐끔뻐끔. 물고기들은 뭍에 가면 숨을 못 쉬어요.

read_en.text: Of all the courtiers, only the terrapin could walk both in the water and on land.
read_en.key: 신하들 가운데 물에서도 뭍에서도 걸을 수 있는 건 자라뿐이었어요.

read_en.text: I can walk in the water and on land.
read_en.key: 저는 물에서도 뭍에서도 걸을 수 있어요.

read_en.text: Terrapin, you go. Painter, draw a rabbit for him.
read_en.key: 자라가 가거라. 화공은 토끼를 그려 주어라.

read_en.text: The painter drew a rabbit. Long ears, and a short tail.
read_en.key: 화공이 토끼 그림을 그렸어요. 귀는 길쭉, 꼬리는 짧게.

read_en.text: I will take this picture and find the rabbit!
read_en.key: 이 그림을 들고 토끼를 찾겠습니다!

read_en.text: The terrapin came up out of the sea. The sunlight is dazzling.
read_en.key: 자라는 바다 위로 올라왔어요. 햇빛이 눈부셔요.

read_en.text: The land is so bright!
read_en.key: 뭍은 이렇게 환하구나!

read_en.text: On this new land, the terrapin looked this way and that for the path.
read_en.key: 처음 보는 뭍에서 자라는 두리번두리번 길을 찾았어요.

read_en.text: Mr. Seagull, where is this animal?
read_en.key: 갈매기님, 이 동물 어디 있소?

read_en.text: That is a rabbit! It lives on that mountain. Go left.
read_en.key: 토끼네! 저 산에 살아. 왼쪽으로 가시오.

read_en.text: Left, left.
read_en.key: 왼쪽, 왼쪽.

read_en.text: The terrapin crawled slowly, slowly up the mountain.
read_en.key: 자라는 엉금엉금 산으로 올라갔어요.

read_en.text: Miss Squirrel, where is this animal?
read_en.key: 다람쥐님, 이 동물 어디 있소?

read_en.text: A rabbit? Go right.
read_en.key: 토끼? 오른쪽으로 가시오.

read_en.text: The terrapin took the path on the right, deep into the forest.
read_en.key: 자라는 오른쪽 길로 숲 속 깊이 들어갔어요.

read_en.text: Mr. Boar, where is this animal?
read_en.key: 멧돼지님, 이 동물 어디 있소?

read_en.text: The rabbit is behind that rock. Go straight up the middle.
read_en.key: 토끼는 저 바위 뒤에. 가운데로 가시오.

read_en.text: At the end of the middle path, something rustled behind a big rock.
read_en.key: 가운데 길 끝, 커다란 바위 뒤에서 무언가 바스락거렸어요.

read_en.text: Who is looking for me?
read_en.key: 누가 나를 찾아?

read_en.text: Long ears, a short tail... the same! You are the rabbit.
read_en.key: 귀는 길쭉, 꼬리는 짧고… 똑같다! 토끼님이구나.

read_en.text: The terrapin bowed politely and began to say sweet things.
read_en.key: 자라는 공손하게 인사하고 달콤한 말을 꺼냈어요.

read_en.text: Mr. Rabbit, come to the sea palace and you will get a high post.
read_en.key: 토끼님, 용궁에 가면 높은 벼슬을 드려요.

read_en.text: And there are lots of tasty treats.
read_en.key: 맛있는 것도 잔뜩 있어요.

read_en.text: The rabbit pictured a fine official's hat and rice cakes, and grinned and grinned.
read_en.key: 토끼는 벼슬 모자와 떡을 떠올리며 싱글벙글 웃었어요.

read_en.text: A high post? Tasty treats? Yes, I will go!
read_en.key: 벼슬? 맛있는 것? 좋아, 갈래!

read_en.text: The rabbit followed right away. He only thought about the good things.
read_en.key: 토끼는 덥석 따라나섰어요. 좋은 것만 생각했거든요.

read_en.text: As the sun was setting, the two of them reached the seashore.
read_en.key: 해가 뉘엿뉘엿 질 무렵, 둘은 바닷가에 닿았어요.

read_en.text: Climb on my back. Hold on tight!
read_en.key: 제 등에 타세요. 꼭 잡으세요!

read_en.text: The rabbit climbed onto the terrapin's back and held on tight. Splash!
read_en.key: 토끼가 자라 등에 올라 등딱지를 꼭 잡자, 풍덩!

read_en.text: The terrapin carried the rabbit down into the sea.
read_en.key: 자라는 토끼를 업고 바다 속으로 들어갔어요.

read_en.text: Shiny fish swam by, and the seaweed swayed, swish, swish.
read_en.key: 물고기 떼가 반짝반짝 지나가고, 미역이 살랑살랑 흔들렸어요.

read_en.text: Wow, fish! It is so blue under the sea.
read_en.key: 우와, 물고기다! 바다 속은 파랗구나.

read_en.text: Here is the sea palace. The doors open, one by one.
read_en.key: 용궁에 다 왔어요. 문이 차례로 열려요.

read_en.text: Welcome!
read_en.key: 어서 오세요!

read_en.text: The terrapin and the rabbit went through the second door and the third door.
read_en.key: 자라와 토끼는 둘째 문, 셋째 문을 지나 안으로 들어갔어요.

read_en.text: Wow, pearls and coral, all sparkly!
read_en.key: 우와, 진주랑 산호가 반짝반짝!

read_en.text: Now, let us go to the Dragon King.
read_en.key: 자, 용왕님께 가요.

read_en.text: The Dragon King, on his great throne, looked down at the rabbit.
read_en.key: 커다란 옥좌에 앉은 용왕님이 토끼를 내려다보았어요.

read_en.text: Rabbit, welcome. Give me your liver.
read_en.key: 토끼야, 잘 왔다. 너의 간을 다오.

read_en.text: The rabbit was so surprised, he fell right over backwards.
read_en.key: 토끼는 깜짝 놀라 뒤로 벌러덩 넘어졌어요.

read_en.text: What?! My liver?
read_en.key: 네?! 제 간을요?

read_en.text: Only then did the rabbit understand. The terrapin had told a lie.
read_en.key: 토끼는 그제야 알았어요. 자라가 거짓말을 한 거예요.

read_en.text: What do I do... Do not be scared. Think.
read_en.key: 어떡하지… 겁먹지 말고 생각하자.

read_en.text: Your Majesty, I took my liver out and left it drying on a rock in the mountains.
read_en.key: 용왕님, 저는 간을 꺼내서 산속 바위에 널어 두고 왔어요.

read_en.text: The terrapin did not tell me before. I will go and get it!
read_en.key: 자라님이 미리 말을 안 해 줬어요. 가서 가져올게요!

read_en.text: Is that so? Then go and bring it quickly.
read_en.key: 그래? 그럼 얼른 가져오너라.

read_en.text: The Dragon King believed the rabbit.
read_en.key: 용왕님은 토끼 말을 믿었어요.

read_en.text: Inside, the rabbit let out a quiet sigh of relief.
read_en.key: 토끼는 속으로 휴, 하고 숨을 내쉬었어요.

read_en.text: I will take him there and back.
read_en.key: 제가 모시고 다녀오겠습니다.

read_en.text: The terrapin carried the rabbit back to land.
read_en.key: 자라는 토끼를 업고 다시 뭍으로 갔어요.

read_en.text: Standing on top of a rock, the rabbit looked down at the terrapin and laughed.
read_en.key: 바위 위에 올라선 토끼가 자라를 내려다보며 웃었어요.

read_en.text: Mr. Terrapin, what animal takes its liver out and leaves it behind? Ha ha!
read_en.key: 자라님, 간을 꺼내 놓고 다니는 동물이 어디 있어요? 하하!

read_en.text: I will never be fooled by sweet words again!
read_en.key: 이제 달콤한 말엔 안 속을 거야!

read_en.text: Oh dear... I was tricked.
read_en.key: 아이고… 속았구나.

read_en.text: Bye-bye!
read_en.key: 안녕!

read_en.text: The rabbit hopped away, hop, hop, into the forest.
read_en.key: 토끼는 숲으로 깡충깡충 달아났어요.

read_en.text: The terrapin lay down on the beach and sighed.
read_en.key: 자라는 바닷가에 엎드려 한숨을 쉬었어요.

read_en.text: What will I tell the Dragon King...
read_en.key: 용왕님께 뭐라고 하지…

read_en.text: Just then, the mountain spirit appeared.
read_en.key: 그때, 산신령이 나타났어요.

read_en.text: Terrapin, you tried so hard for your king. Take this medicine to the Dragon King.
read_en.key: 자라야, 애쓴 마음이 갸륵하구나. 이 약을 용왕님께 드려라.

read_en.text: Thank you, mountain spirit!
read_en.key: 고맙습니다, 산신령님!

read_en.text: The terrapin hugged the medicine and went back to the sea.
read_en.key: 자라는 약을 안고 바다로 돌아갔어요.

read_en.text: The terrapin came back to the sea palace and gave the medicine to the Dragon King.
read_en.key: 자라는 용궁으로 돌아와 용왕님께 약을 드렸어요.

read_en.text: Ah, now I am all better!
read_en.key: 아, 이제 다 나았다!

read_en.text: Laughter came back to the sea palace.
read_en.key: 용궁에 웃음이 돌아왔어요.

read_en.text: Do not follow sweet words right away, and when things are hard, stay calm and think.
read_en.key: 달콤한 말에 덥석 따라가지 않고, 어려울 땐 차분히 생각하면 돼요.

en.text: Once upon a time, there lived a kind-hearted girl.
You work in the kitchen!
Ashy girl! Ashy girl!
So the girl was called Cinderella.
One day, a letter came from the palace. There was a ball!
Cinderella, do my hair nicely!
Yes, I will make it pretty.
Tap your sister's hair!
Oh, how pretty!
The sisters happily went off to the ball.
Cinderella, left all alone, sobbed and sobbed.
I wish I could go to the ball, too.
Then her fairy godmother appeared.
Don't cry, dear. You want to go to the ball, don't you? I will help you.
Bring me the biggest pumpkin from the garden.
Tap the pumpkin!
The pumpkin turned into a golden coach!
There are mice in the trap. How many are there?
Tap the mousetrap!
Six mice! They became six white horses.
The big rat became the coachman, and the lizards became footmen.
Now it is your turn, dear.
Cinderella wore a silver gown and glass slippers.
Oh, thank you so much!
Remember, dear. At midnight, the magic will end.
Yes, I will remember!
When she arrived at the palace, everyone stared at Cinderella.
Please, dance with me.
Cinderella shared oranges with her sisters, too.
Oh, thank you!
The sisters did not know who she was.
The clock said it was almost midnight. Cinderella went home, just as she promised.
The next night, there was another ball.
Cinderella was dancing so happily that she forgot the time.
When the long hand and the short hand both point to twelve, it is twelve o'clock. Find the clock that says twelve!
Find the clock that says twelve!
That is three o'clock.
That is six o'clock.
When both hands point straight up, it is twelve o'clock.
That's right, twelve o'clock!
Oh no, it's twelve o'clock!
Cinderella ran down the stairs and lost one glass slipper.
I will find the person this slipper fits.
The prince carried the glass slipper from house to house.
My foot will fit!
My foot will fit, too!
The sisters' feet were too big, and the slipper would not fit.
May I try it on, too?
Find the foot that is the same size as the slipper!
That foot is bigger than the slipper.
That's right, the small foot!
The slipper fit perfectly!
Cinderella took the other slipper out of her pocket.
Her fairy godmother dressed her in a beautiful gown again.
Cinderella, we are sorry for all that time. We are truly sorry.
It's all right. Let's be happy together.
Tap to say hello to Cinderella!
Everyone laughed together.
A kind heart can forgive even those who were unkind to us.

read_en.text: Yes, I will remember!
read_en.key: 네, 꼭 기억할게요!

read_en.text: Cinderella climbed into the coach.
read_en.key: 신데렐라는 마차에 올라탔어요.

read_en.text: The golden coach rattled off to the palace, clip-clop, clip-clop.
read_en.key: 황금 마차가 달그락달그락, 궁전으로 달려갔어요.

read_en.text: Cinderella stepped into the palace ballroom.
read_en.key: 신데렐라는 궁전의 무도회장 안으로 들어갔어요.

read_en.text: When she arrived at the palace, everyone stared at Cinderella.
read_en.key: 궁전에 가니 모두 신데렐라를 바라보았어요.

read_en.text: The prince strode right over, step, step, step, and held out his hand.
read_en.key: 왕자님이 성큼성큼 다가와 손을 내밀었어요.

read_en.text: Please, dance with me.
read_en.key: 함께 춤춰요.

read_en.text: Round and round they twirled, light as feathers, dancing to the music.
read_en.key: 둘은 음악에 맞춰 빙글빙글, 사뿐사뿐 춤을 추었어요.

read_en.text: Cinderella shared oranges with her sisters, too.
read_en.key: 신데렐라는 언니들에게도 오렌지를 나눠 주었어요.

read_en.text: Oh, thank you!
read_en.key: 어머, 고마워요!

read_en.text: The sisters did not know who she was.
read_en.key: 언니들은 신데렐라를 알아보지 못했어요.

read_en.text: The clock said it was almost midnight. Cinderella went home, just as she promised.
read_en.key: 시계를 보니 열두 시가 가까워요. 신데렐라는 약속대로 집에 돌아왔어요.

read_en.text: The next night, there was another ball.
read_en.key: 다음 날 밤에도 무도회가 열렸어요.

read_en.text: Cinderella went back to the palace and danced with the prince.
read_en.key: 신데렐라는 다시 궁전으로 가서 왕자님과 춤을 추었어요.

read_en.text: Cinderella was dancing so happily that she forgot the time.
read_en.key: 신데렐라는 춤추느라 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어요.

read_en.text: Just then the great big clock began to ring. Dong! Dong!
read_en.key: 그때 커다란 시계가 뎅, 뎅, 울리기 시작했어요.

read_en.text: Oh no, it's twelve o'clock!
read_en.key: 앗, 열두 시예요!

read_en.text: Cinderella let go of the prince's hand and dashed away, pitter-patter, as fast as she could.
read_en.key: 신데렐라는 왕자님의 손을 놓고 후다닥 달려 나갔어요.

read_en.text: The prince called after Cinderella as she ran away.
read_en.key: 왕자님이 달려가는 신데렐라를 불렀어요.

read_en.text: Wait! Please do not go!
read_en.key: "잠깐만요! 가지 마세요!"

read_en.text: The prince followed her out to the palace steps.
read_en.key: 궁전 밖 계단까지 왕자님이 뒤따라왔어요.

read_en.text: Cinderella ran down the stairs and lost one glass slipper.
read_en.key: 신데렐라는 계단을 달려 내려가다 유리 구두 한 짝을 떨어뜨렸어요.

read_en.text: When midnight passed, the golden coach went poof! and turned back into a pumpkin.
read_en.key: 열두 시가 지나자 황금 마차는 펑! 다시 호박이 되었어요.

read_en.text: Cinderella went home in her old, ashy clothes.
read_en.key: 신데렐라는 재 묻은 옷차림으로 집에 돌아갔어요.

read_en.text: The prince gently picked up the glass slipper left on the stairs.
read_en.key: 왕자님은 계단에 남은 유리 구두를 살며시 주워 들었어요.

read_en.text: The slipper twinkled and sparkled in the moonlight.
read_en.key: 구두는 달빛에 반짝반짝 빛났지요.

read_en.text: I will find the person this slipper fits.
read_en.key: 이 구두가 꼭 맞는 사람을 찾을 거예요.

read_en.text: The prince carried the glass slipper from house to house.
read_en.key: 왕자님이 유리 구두를 들고 집집마다 찾아다녔어요.

read_en.text: At last, the prince reached Cinderella’s home.
read_en.key: 마침내 왕자님은 신데렐라의 집에 도착했어요.

read_en.text: In the sitting room, both sisters stepped forward to try on the slipper.
read_en.key: 응접실에서 두 언니가 구두를 신어 보겠다고 나섰어요.

read_en.text: My foot will fit!
read_en.key: 내 발이 들어갈 거야!

read_en.text: My foot will fit, too!
read_en.key: 내 발도 들어갈 거야!

read_en.text: The sisters' feet were too big, and the slipper would not fit.
read_en.key: 언니들의 발은 너무 커서 들어가지 않았어요.

read_en.text: May I try it on, too?
read_en.key: 저도 신어 봐도 될까요?

read_en.text: The sisters snickered, tee-hee, but the prince nodded his head.
read_en.key: 언니들은 피식 코웃음을 쳤지만, 왕자님은 고개를 끄덕였어요.

read_en.text: The prince knelt down, and her little foot slipped right into the glass slipper. Slip!
read_en.key: 왕자님이 무릎을 꿇자, 작은 발이 유리 구두에 쏙 들어갔어요.

read_en.text: The slipper fit perfectly!
read_en.key: 구두가 꼭 맞았어요!

read_en.text: Cinderella took the other slipper out of her pocket.
read_en.key: 신데렐라는 주머니에서 다른 한 짝을 꺼냈어요.

read_en.text: Her fairy godmother appeared in the sitting room where everyone had gathered.
read_en.key: 모두가 모인 응접실에 요정 대모가 나타났어요.

read_en.text: Her fairy godmother dressed her in a beautiful gown again.
read_en.key: 요정 대모가 다시 고운 옷을 입혀 주었어요.

read_en.text: The two sisters told Cinderella they were sorry.
read_en.key: 두 언니는 신데렐라에게 미안하다고 말했어요.

read_en.text: Cinderella, we are sorry for all that time. We are truly sorry.
read_en.key: 신데렐라, 그동안 미안해. 정말 미안해.

read_en.text: Cinderella gave her sisters a great big hug, squeeze, squeeze.
read_en.key: 신데렐라는 언니들을 꼬옥 안아 주었어요.

read_en.text: It's all right. Let's be happy together.
read_en.key: 괜찮아요. 우리 함께 행복해요.

read_en.text: Sisters, from now on, let us be kind to one another.
read_en.key: "언니들, 이제 우리 사이좋게 지내요."

read_en.text: Everyone laughed together.
read_en.key: 모두 함께 웃었어요.

read_en.text: A kind heart can forgive even those who were unkind to us.
read_en.key: 착한 마음은 나를 괴롭힌 사람도 용서할 수 있어요.

en.text: In the forest lived a fox and a crane.
Fox brought an invitation.
Tap the invitation and give it to Crane!
"Wow, thank you!" Crane hopped up on those long legs.
Fox is cooking some yummy soup.
Shall we tap the pot and stir it?
Tap the pot and stir, stir, stir!
Fox giggles. "I'll serve it on a flat plate~"
Crane came to visit. But the plate is very flat!
Tap Crane's beak to help Crane eat!
Tap Crane's beak!
Oh dear, only the tip of the beak goes clack, clack. Crane can't eat the soup.
Fox licked, lick lick, and ate it all up. Crane's tummy rumbled, and Crane felt sad.
A few days later, Crane invited Fox over.
"Fox, come over to my house too~"
Fox was so excited. "Yay! I'm going to eat something yummy!"
Wow, the bottle is as tall as a tower! The neck is so long.
Tap Fox's nose to help Fox eat!
Tap Fox's nose!
Tap Fox's nose one more time!
Tap Fox's nose! Let's hop!
Oh no! Fox's nose got stuck in the bottle!
Pop! The nose came out. Fox landed with a thump!
Crane sipped with that long beak, sip, sip. Fox's tummy rumbled, and Fox felt sad.
Neither of them could eat. Why was that?
Crane has a long, thin beak. Which dish is best?
Find the dish where a long beak fits right in!
Fox has a short mouth and licks food up. Which dish is best?
Find a flat dish that's good for licking!
Fox and Crane are having a feast together. The guests are coming too!
Look at each mouth, and pick the right dish!
Fox has a short mouth. Which dish is best?
Duck has a wide, flat beak. Which dish is best?
Butterfly has a mouth like a straw. What is best?
Find the one where a long beak fits right in!
Find a flat one that's good for licking!
Find one that's good for scooping with a wide beak!
Find one to sip from with a straw mouth!
Crane is here!
Fox is here!
Duck is here!
Butterfly is here!
It's the flat plate! Tap the sparkly one!
It's the tall bottle! Tap the sparkly one!
It's the wide bowl! Tap the sparkly one!
It's the flower! Tap the sparkly one!
That's right! Crane likes the tall bottle.
That's right! Fox likes the flat plate.
That's right! Duck likes the wide bowl.
That's right! Butterfly likes the flower.
The lanterns twinkle, and everyone gathers for the feast.
Fox said, "I'm sorry, Crane."
Crane said, "I'm sorry too, Fox."
"It's okay!" The two became good friends again.
Tap your friends. Eat up, nom nom, yummy!
They ate until they were full, and everyone smiled happily.

en.text: Morning came to the pond. The baby frogs are still fast asleep, zzz.
Shall we tap the baby frogs to wake them up?
Tap a sleeping baby frog!
Mama Frog said. "Children, don't go far away~"
The baby frogs sneaked out to the meadow. Shall we tap and hop along?
Tap the screen to hop, hop, hop!
Oh? Something huge is right in front of us!
What could this be? A tail or a tree?
Pick the one that looks just like the picture in the middle!
It's a tail! Tap the sparkly one!
That's right, it's a tail!
What is it this time? A hoof or a pebble?
It's a hoof! Tap the sparkly one!
That's right, it's a hoof!
What could this be? A horn or a branch?
It's a horn! Tap the sparkly one!
That's right, it's a horn!
It was a big, big ox! The baby frogs were so startled, they ran away.
"Mama! I saw a monster as big as a mountain!"
Mama Frog said. "Hmph, how big was it?"
Shall we see who is bigger?
Who is bigger, the frog or the tadpole?
Who is bigger, the tadpole or the frog?
Who is bigger? Tap the bigger friend!
They're standing side by side. Whose head is higher?
The frog is bigger! Tap the sparkly friend!
That's right! The frog is bigger!
Who is bigger, the duck or the frog?
Who is bigger, the frog or the duck?
The duck is bigger! Tap the sparkly friend!
That's right! The duck is bigger!
Who is bigger, the sheep or the duck?
Who is bigger, the duck or the sheep?
The sheep is bigger! Tap the sparkly friend!
That's right! The sheep is bigger!
Who is bigger, the ox or the sheep?
Who is bigger, the sheep or the ox?
The ox is bigger! Tap the sparkly friend!
That's right! The ox is bigger!
"I can be as big as an ox!" Mama Frog took a deep breath.
Shall we tap, tap, and puff up Mama Frog?
Tap, tap, tap Mama Frog!
"The ox is still bigger!"
"Wow, as big as a sheep! But the ox is still bigger!"
Mama Frog is trembling and wobbling. Uh-oh... what happens if we tap one more time?
Fshhhhh~ Mama Frog is flying around like a balloon! Tap to catch her!
Tap Mama Frog as she flies!
Mama Frog was back to her normal size. Dizzy as she was, she laughed ha ha ha.
The ox bent down low and said kindly. "It's okay not to be big. You're a hopping champion!"
Tap Mama Frog to hop!
Shall the ox try hopping too? One, two...
Thud! The ox couldn't hop. Who can jump farther? The frog!
Night came. Uncle Frog, wearing a bow tie, came to visit. The frog family sings a song. Listen first!
This time, tap the frogs and sing along!
Ribbit, ribbit~ The song faded away, and the frog family fell fast asleep.

en.text: Once upon a time, in a castle, there lived a princess who loved her golden ball more than anything.
What shape is the golden ball? Pick one!
That's a square. Find the shape of the golden ball again.
That's a triangle. Find the shape of the golden ball again.
That's right, a circle! The golden ball is round like a circle.
Bounce, bounce! My golden ball is the prettiest in the whole world.
One day, the princess played with her ball beside a spring in the forest.
The ball went up high, and higher... oh my!
Splash! The ball fell into the spring and sank deep down into the water.
Boo-hoo, my golden ball... my golden ball is gone.
Just then, a green frog poked his head up out of the water.
Princess, why are you crying?
My golden ball fell into the spring. Sniff, sniff.
I'll get your ball for you. But in return, will you be my friend, eat with me, and let me sleep in your bed?
Okay, I promise!
The frog dived into the water, splash, and came back up with the golden ball in his mouth.
My ball!
The princess grabbed the ball and ran straight home to the castle.
Wait! You promised!
At supper time, there came a hop, hop sound outside the door. Knock, knock!
Princess, you promised. Please open the door.
No! Go away!
The king saw this and asked the princess.
My princess, what did you promise?
I said that if the frog found my golden ball... I would be his friend.
A promise must be kept. Even more so to a friend who helped you.
...Yes, Father.
The princess brought the frog to the table.
I promised, so let's eat together.
How many buns are on the plate? Tap the plate!
Three buns! One for you, one for me, and we'll share the last one.
Yum yum, delicious!
When night came, the frog followed the princess all the way to her room.
Princess, you said I could sleep in your bed.
Ugh, that's enough!
The princess tossed the frog toward the bed. Plop! He landed softly on the fluffy pillow!
Thank you. I was a prince under a spell. Because you kept your promise, the spell is broken.
Oh my, the frog... was a prince!
The next day, the princess and the prince played together in the castle garden.
Now we are true friends.
Yes! Let's play ball together!
And the two of them tossed the golden ball back and forth and were the best of friends for a long, long time.

read_en.text: Just then, a green frog poked his head up out of the water.
read_en.key: 그때 샘물 위로 초록 개구리가 고개를 내밀었어요.

read_en.text: Princess, why are you crying?
read_en.key: 공주님, 왜 울어요?

read_en.text: My golden ball fell into the spring. Sniff, sniff.
read_en.key: 내 금공이 샘에 빠졌어. 흑흑.

read_en.text: I'll get your ball for you. But in return, will you be my friend, eat with me, and let me sleep in your bed?
read_en.key: 내가 공을 찾아 줄게. 대신 나랑 친구가 되고, 같이 먹고, 한 침대에서 자 줄래?

read_en.text: The princess wiped away her tears, swipe, swipe, and nodded, nod, nod.
read_en.key: 공주는 눈물을 쓱쓱 닦고 고개를 끄덕끄덕했어요.

read_en.text: Okay, I promise!
read_en.key: 좋아, 약속할게!

read_en.text: The frog dived into the water, splash, and came back up with the golden ball in his mouth.
read_en.key: 개구리는 풍덩 물속으로 들어가 금공을 물고 올라왔어요.

read_en.text: The frog swam this way and that through the water, and found the shiny golden ball.
read_en.key: 개구리는 물속을 요리조리 헤엄쳐 반짝이는 금공을 찾아냈어요.

read_en.text: My ball!
read_en.key: 내 공이다!

read_en.text: The princess grabbed the ball and ran straight home to the castle.
read_en.key: 공주는 공을 받아 안고 성으로 쌩 달려갔어요.

read_en.text: Wait! You promised!
read_en.key: 기다려, 약속했잖아!

read_en.text: The frog was left all alone by the spring, blinking, blink, blink.
read_en.key: 개구리는 샘가에 혼자 남아 눈만 끔뻑끔뻑했어요.

read_en.text: The frog followed the princess all the way to the castle.
read_en.key: 혼자 남았던 개구리도 공주를 따라 성까지 찾아왔어요.

read_en.text: At supper time, there came a hop, hop sound outside the door. Knock, knock!
read_en.key: 저녁 식사 때, 문 밖에서 폴짝폴짝 소리가 났어요. 똑똑!

read_en.text: The sound came from outside the castle dining room.
read_en.key: 그 소리는 성의 식당 문 앞에서 났어요.

read_en.text: Hop, hop! The frog came hopping in over the doorstep.
read_en.key: 개구리가 폴짝폴짝, 문턱을 넘어 들어왔어요.

read_en.text: Princess, you promised. Please open the door.
read_en.key: 공주님, 약속했잖아요. 문 좀 열어 줘요.

read_en.text: No! Go away!
read_en.key: 싫어! 저리 가!

read_en.text: The princess folded her arms and turned away with a huff.
read_en.key: 공주는 팔짱을 끼고 홱 돌아섰어요.

read_en.text: The king came over in the castle dining room.
read_en.key: 성의 식당으로 임금님이 다가왔어요.

read_en.text: The king saw this and asked the princess.
read_en.key: 그 모습을 본 임금님이 공주에게 물었어요.

read_en.text: My princess, what did you promise?
read_en.key: 공주야, 무슨 약속을 했느냐?

read_en.text: I said that if the frog found my golden ball... I would be his friend.
read_en.key: 개구리가 금공을 찾아 주면… 친구가 되겠다고 했어요.

read_en.text: A promise must be kept. Even more so to a friend who helped you.
read_en.key: 약속은 지켜야 한단다. 도와준 친구에게는 더욱 그렇지.

read_en.text: ...Yes, Father.
read_en.key: …알겠어요, 아버지.

read_en.text: The princess pouted, but she turned around to face the frog.
read_en.key: 공주는 입을 삐죽 내밀었지만, 개구리 쪽으로 돌아섰어요.

read_en.text: The princess brought the frog to the table.
read_en.key: 공주는 개구리를 식탁으로 데려갔어요.

read_en.text: Now the princess and the frog sat at the same table.
read_en.key: 이제 공주와 개구리는 식당의 같은 식탁 앞에 앉았어요.

read_en.text: I promised, so let's eat together.
read_en.key: 약속했으니까 같이 먹자.

read_en.text: On the plate sat buns, baked golden brown, crisp and toasty.
read_en.key: 접시에는 노릇노릇 구운 빵이 놓여 있었어요.

read_en.text: Three buns! One for you, one for me, and we'll share the last one.
read_en.key: 빵이 세 개! 너 하나, 나 하나, 남은 하나는 나눠 먹자.

read_en.text: The frog took a bite of bread. Munch!
read_en.key: 개구리가 빵을 한 입 냠 베어 물었어요.

read_en.text: Yum yum, delicious!
read_en.key: 냠냠, 맛있다!

read_en.text: The princess took a bite of her bun too, and a little giggle slipped out, tee-hee.
read_en.key: 공주도 빵을 한 입 베어 물고, 피식 웃음이 나왔어요.

read_en.text: When night came, the frog followed the princess all the way to her room.
read_en.key: 밤이 되자 개구리가 공주의 방까지 따라왔어요.

read_en.text: Princess, you said I could sleep in your bed.
read_en.key: 공주님, 같은 침대에서 자기로 했잖아요.

read_en.text: Ugh, that's enough!
read_en.key: 으, 이제 그만!

read_en.text: The princess tossed the frog toward the bed. Plop! He landed softly on the fluffy pillow!
read_en.key: 공주는 개구리를 침대 쪽으로 휙 던졌어요. 개구리는 푹신한 베개 위에 포옥!

read_en.text: At that very moment, pop! A dazzling light filled the whole room.
read_en.key: 그 순간 팡! 눈부신 빛이 방 안을 가득 채웠어요.

read_en.text: As the light faded, a prince stood where the frog had been.
read_en.key: 빛이 걷히자 개구리 대신 왕자가 서 있었어요.

read_en.text: Thank you. I was a prince under a spell. Because you kept your promise, the spell is broken.
read_en.key: 고마워요. 나는 마법에 걸린 왕자였어요. 약속을 지켜 줘서 마법이 풀렸어요.

read_en.text: Oh my, the frog... was a prince!
read_en.key: 어머, 개구리가… 왕자님이었구나!

read_en.text: The next day, the princess and the prince played together in the castle garden.
read_en.key: 다음 날, 공주와 왕자는 성 뜰에서 함께 놀았어요.

read_en.text: Now we are true friends.
read_en.key: 이제 우리는 진짜 친구예요.

read_en.text: Yes! Let's play ball together!
read_en.key: 응! 우리 같이 공놀이하자!

read_en.text: The golden ball bounced, boing, boing, back and forth between the two of them.
read_en.key: 금공이 통통, 두 사람 사이를 오락가락했어요.

read_en.text: And the two of them tossed the golden ball back and forth and were the best of friends for a long, long time.
read_en.key: 둘은 금공을 주고받으며 오래오래 사이좋게 지냈답니다.

read_en.text: A promise made must always be kept. Then your heart will sparkle, twinkle, twinkle.
read_en.key: 한 약속은 꼭 지켜야 한답니다. 그러면 마음도 반짝반짝 빛나요.

김이 펄펄 나면 뜨겁고, 얼음이 있으면 차가워요.

아기 곰: "내 죽을 다 먹어 버렸어!"

아기 곰이 살금살금 가 보니, 누가 자고 있어요!
골디락스와 곰 세 마리 눈이 딱 마주쳤어요!

엄마 곰이 새 죽을 끓였어요. 다 함께 먹어요!
가장 작은 그릇부터 차례대로 톡 눌러요.
작은 그릇, 중간 그릇, 큰 그릇! 차례대로 담았어요.
골디락스 그릇도 하나 더! 다 함께 냠냠.
골디락스와 곰 가족은 사이좋은 친구가 되었답니다.

en.text: A family of three bears lived in a log cabin in the woods.
Tap the bear family to say hello!
Tap a bear and say hi!
Papa Bear has a deep voice, and Baby Bear has a tiny voice.
Mama Bear cooked some yummy porridge. But it's too hot!
Tap once and blow on it for me!
Tap the porridge and blow! Whoo!
The steam is going down, but it's still hot.
Papa Bear: "Let's go for a walk while the porridge cools!"
In the woods lived a girl with golden hair, named Goldilocks.
Tap, tap the screen and walk along with her!
Tap, tap! Walk with Goldilocks.
She picked three flowers. Oh? Look, a log cabin!
Wow, what a big door! Give it a knock.
Tap the door! Knock, knock.
Goldilocks: "Hello? Is anyone home?"
There is no answer.
The door creaked open. Goldilocks tiptoed inside.
There are three bowls of porridge on the table.
Which porridge is just right?
Hot, hot! It's way too hot!
It's way too cold, like ice!
Porridge with lots of steam is hot, and porridge with ice is cold.
It's the small bowl with just a little steam!
Just right! Yum, yum! She ate up the whole small bowl.
Now there are three chairs.
Which chair is just right?
It's too high! Her legs dangle, dangle.
It's so squishy, she sank right in!
It's the chair that's not too big and not too squishy.
It's the small chair! Tap the sparkling chair.
Just right! But then...
Crack! The little chair broke, and she plopped down on her bottom.
Yaaawn, I'm sleepy. There are three beds upstairs.
Which bed is just right?
It's too hard!
It's too soft!
It's the bed that's not too hard and not too soft.
It's the small bed! Tap the sparkling bed.
Just right! Let's hear a lullaby. Listen closely.
This time, tap the bed. The lullaby keeps going!
Goldilocks fell fast asleep. Zzz.
Just then, the bear family came home from their walk.
Papa Bear: "Who ate my porridge?"
The bowls are all mixed up. Help find each bowl's owner!
Whose is this big bowl?
The big bowl belongs to the biggest bear.
It's Papa Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.
Mama Bear: "My bowl is smaller~"
Baby Bear: "My bowl is smaller~"
Whose is this medium bowl?
The medium bowl belongs to the middle bear.
It's Mama Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.
Papa Bear: "My bowl is bigger~"
Whose is this small bowl?
The small bowl belongs to the smallest bear.
It's Baby Bear! Tap the sparkling bear.
Mama Bear: "My bowl is bigger~"
Baby Bear: "Someone ate up all my porridge!"
Who could it have been?
Now help find whose chair is whose.
Whose is this big chair?
The big chair belongs to the biggest bear.
Mama Bear: "My chair is smaller~"
Baby Bear: "My chair is smaller~"
Whose is this medium chair?
The medium chair belongs to the middle bear.
Papa Bear: "My chair is bigger~"
Baby Bear: "Waaah, my chair is broken!"
Mama Bear gave Baby Bear a big, tight hug.
But then they heard a snoring sound upstairs.
Baby Bear tiptoed over, and someone was sleeping there!
Tap the blanket.
Tap the blanket with Baby Bear!
Goldilocks and the three bears looked straight at each other!
She tried to climb out the window, but her skirt got caught!
Goldilocks turned around and said, "I'm sorry."
Goldilocks: "I'm sorry I came in without asking."
Papa Bear: "It's okay. Next time, knock and wait for us."
Goldilocks: "Shall we fix Baby Bear's chair together?"
Tap, tap to hammer and fix it!
Tap the chair! Bang, bang.
Ta-da! The chair is all fixed.
Baby Bear: "Thank you! Let's be friends!"
Mama Bear cooked fresh porridge. Let's all eat together!
Tap the bowls in order, starting with the smallest.
Which is the smallest bowl?
Next is the medium bowl!
Last is the biggest bowl!
Find the big bowl.
Find the medium bowl.
Find the small bowl.
The big bowl is sparkling! Tap it.
The medium bowl is sparkling! Tap it.
The small bowl is sparkling! Tap it.
"I'm next~"
Small bowl, medium bowl, big bowl! All filled in order.
One more bowl for Goldilocks! Yum, yum, all together.
Goldilocks and the bear family became good friends.
