read_en.key: 골디락스와 곰 가족은 아래층 거실로 내려왔어요.

read_en.text: Goldilocks: "I'm sorry I came in without asking."
read_en.key: 골디락스: "허락 없이 들어와서 미안해요."

read_en.text: Papa Bear: "It's okay. Next time, knock and wait for us."
read_en.key: 아빠 곰: "괜찮아. 다음엔 똑똑 하고 기다려 줘."

read_en.text: Goldilocks: "Shall we fix Baby Bear's chair together?"
read_en.key: 골디락스: "아기 곰 의자, 같이 고칠래?"

read_en.text: Bang, bang! Tap, tap! Goldilocks and the bears fixed the chair together.
read_en.key: 뚝딱뚝딱, 쿵쿵! 골디락스와 곰 가족이 함께 의자를 고쳤어요.

read_en.text: Ta-da! The chair is all fixed.
read_en.key: 짠! 의자가 다 고쳐졌어요.

read_en.text: Baby Bear: "Thank you! Let's be friends!"
read_en.key: 아기 곰: "고마워! 우리 친구 하자!"

read_en.text: After fixing the chair, everyone gathered at the table again.
read_en.key: 의자를 고친 뒤, 모두 다시 식탁에 모였어요.

read_en.text: Mama Bear cooked fresh porridge. Let's all eat together!
read_en.key: 엄마 곰이 새 죽을 끓였어요. 다 함께 먹어요!

read_en.text: Small bowl, medium bowl, big bowl! All filled in order.
read_en.key: 작은 그릇, 중간 그릇, 큰 그릇! 차례대로 담았어요.

read_en.text: One more bowl for Goldilocks! Yum, yum, all together.
read_en.key: 골디락스 그릇도 하나 더! 다 함께 냠냠.

read_en.text: Slurp, slurp, yum, yum! The four of them sat around the table and ate happily.
read_en.key: 호록호록, 냠냠! 식구 넷이 둘러앉아 맛있게 먹었어요.

read_en.text: Goldilocks and the bear family became good friends.
read_en.key: 골디락스와 곰 가족은 사이좋은 친구가 되었답니다.

read_en.text: Say "I'm sorry," and you can be friends again.
read_en.key: "미안해요" 하면 다시 친구가 될 수 있답니다.

ko.text: 옛날 옛날에 숲 옆 작은 집에 헨젤과 그레텔이 살았어요.
그런데 집에는 먹을 것이 점점 떨어져, 찬장이 텅텅 비었지요.
헨젤과 그레텔은 밤마다 배가 꼬르륵꼬르륵 울었어요.
어느 날 밤, 헨젤은 문틈으로 엿들었어요.
헨젤은 가슴이 콩닥콩닥 뛰었어요. 그래도 꼭 참고 생각했지요.
헨젤은 살금살금 밖으로 나왔어요. 달빛에 조약돌이 반짝반짝!
헨젤은 하얀 조약돌을 하나, 또 하나, 주머니에 쏙쏙 넣었어요.
다음 날, 아빠는 둘을 데리고 숲 깊은 곳으로 갔어요.
뚜벅뚜벅, 셋은 숲속 깊이 들어갔어요. 나뭇잎이 바스락바스락 소리를 냈지요.
아빠는 둘을 숲에 남겨 두고 돌아갔어요.
밤이 되자 조약돌이 달빛에 반짝반짝 빛났어요. 둘은 조약돌을 따라 집으로 돌아왔어요.
하지만 얼마 뒤, 새엄마가 또 아이들을 숲에 두고 오자고 했어요.
이번엔 밤에 문이 잠겨서, 조약돌을 주울 수 없었어요.
헨젤은 빵 부스러기로 길을 표시하기로 했어요.
헨젤이 빵 부스러기를 하나씩 떨어뜨려요. 같이 세어 봐요!
빵 부스러기가 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯! 길이 생겼어요.
빈터에는 빨간 산딸기가 가득했어요. 둘은 냠냠 따 먹었어요.
배가 부르니 졸려서 둘은 나무 밑에서 깜빡 잠이 들었어요.
눈을 떠 보니 아빠가 보이지 않았어요. 둘은 길을 잃었어요.
그런데 이상해요. 빵 부스러기가 하나도 없어요!
작은 새가 빵 부스러기를 물고 있어요.
헨젤은 눈물이 글썽했지만 그레텔의 손을 꼭 잡고 걸었어요.
그때 달콤한 냄새가 솔솔 났어요. 앗, 과자 집이에요!
헨젤은 쿠키 벽을 와삭, 그레텔은 사탕 지붕을 오도독 깨물었어요.
지붕에 사탕이 빠진 곳이 있어요. 헨젤이 하나씩 붙여 줘요. 같이 세어 봐요!
사탕이 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯! 지붕이 예뻐졌어요.
그때 문이 열리고 마녀 할머니가 나왔어요.
그레텔은 마녀가 낮잠을 자는 사이에 열쇠 세 개를 가져왔어요.
동그라미, 세모, 별 모양. 그레텔은 자물쇠 구멍을 요리조리 살펴보았어요.
새장 자물쇠에는 별 모양 구멍이 있어요. 별 모양 열쇠를 톡!
찰칵! 새장이 열렸어요. 헨젤이 폴짝 뛰어나왔어요!
그때 마녀가 일어나 쿵쿵 걸어왔어요. 눈이 나빠서 더듬더듬 찾았어요.
마녀가 화덕 안을 들여다봐요. 그레텔을 톡! 화덕 문을 쾅 밀어요.
쾅! 마녀는 깜짝 놀라 모자가 휙 날아갔어요.
집으로 가는 길에 넓은 강이 나왔어요. 다리가 없어요!
둘은 오리 등에 폴짝 올라탔어요. 오리는 둥실둥실 강을 건넜지요.
저 멀리 집이 보여요. 아빠가 숲에서 둘을 애타게 찾고 있었어요.
헨젤과 그레텔은 마음이 따뜻하고 행복했어요. 여러분은 기분이 어때요? 헨젤을 톡! 만세!
그날 밤, 둘은 포근한 이불 속에서 새근새근 잠이 들었답니다.
우리 집이 제일 포근해요. 헨젤과 그레텔 이야기는 이렇게 끝났어요.

en.text: Once upon a time, Hansel and Gretel lived in a little house beside the forest.
But the food at home was running out, and the cupboard was bare, empty as could be.
Every night, Hansel's and Gretel's tummies went grumble, grumble.
One night, Hansel listened at the crack of the door.
"There's no food left. Tomorrow, let's leave the children in the forest," said the stepmother.
"Hmm... the poor children..." Father hesitated.
Hansel's heart went thump, thump, thump. But he stayed quiet and thought hard.
"Yes, I have an idea!" Hansel whispered softly.
Hansel tiptoed outside. Pebbles twinkled in the moonlight!
Tap Hansel! Pick up the pebbles.
Hansel picked up the white pebbles, one, and another, and tucked them into his pockets, plop, plop.
Hansel filled his pockets with pebbles. "Now we'll be fine."
The next day, Father took the two of them deep into the forest.
Tramp, tramp, the three went deep into the forest. The leaves rustled, rustle, rustle.
Hansel quietly dropped the pebbles one by one.
Father left the two of them in the forest and went back.
"Papa? Papa!" Gretel called, but the forest was silent.
When night came, the pebbles twinkled in the moonlight. The two followed them all the way home.
"There is our house!" Hansel shouted. Gretel hopped up and down with joy.
But not long after, the stepmother said again to leave the children in the forest.
This time the door was locked at night, so Hansel could not gather pebbles.
Children, let's go pick berries in the forest! said Papa.
Hansel decided to mark the way with bread crumbs.
Hansel drops the crumbs one by one. Let's count them together!
Tap Hansel, tap tap tap tap tap! Count the crumbs.
One, two, three, four, five crumbs! Now there is a trail.
The crumbs made a long, long trail behind him, dot, dot, dot.
The clearing was full of red berries. The two of them munched away.
Crunch, crunch, sweet and sour! Their fingers turned bright red with berry juice.
"Hansel, try this one too!" Gretel handed him the biggest berry of all.
With full tummies, they got sleepy and dozed off under a tree.
When they woke up, Papa was nowhere to be seen. They were lost.
Gretel felt a little scared.
"Hansel, I am scared..." Gretel held his hand tight.
It's okay, let's follow the crumb trail! said Hansel.
But how strange! There were no crumbs left at all!
They looked all around, this way and that, searching every inch of the ground.
A little bird has a crumb in its beak.
Tweet tweet! They were so yummy, I ate them all! said the bird.
"Oh no, our trail is gone!" Gretel's face crumpled.
The bird fluttered off into the sky, flap, flap.
Hansel's eyes got teary, but he held Gretel's hand tight and kept walking.
Then a sweet smell drifted by. Oh! A candy house!
The walls are cookies and the roof is candy.
Hansel bit into the cookie wall, crunch, and Gretel nibbled the candy roof, crackle, crackle.
It was so yummy that their tummies got round and full.
Some candies are missing from the roof. Hansel sticks them on one by one. Let's count!
Tap Hansel, tap tap tap tap tap! Count the candies.
One, two, three, four, five candies! The roof looks lovely.
Then the door opened, and a witch granny came out.
Who ate my candy house? grumbled the witch.
The witch was a grumpy granny who kept all her sweets to herself.
"My candy! My cookies! Oh, what a waste!" The witch stamped her feet, stomp, stomp.
"We are sorry. We were so very hungry." Hansel said in a small voice.
The witch popped Hansel into a cage. Stay there until you pay for the candy!
Gretel's eyes filled with tears. "Hansel, I will get you out, I promise!"
While the witch napped, Gretel fetched three keys.
A circle, a triangle, and a star. Gretel peered at the keyhole this way and that.
The cage lock has a star-shaped hole. Tap the star key!
Tap the star key!
Look closely at the shape of the key's head.
Tap the sparkly star key!
Click! The cage opened. Hansel hopped out!
Thank you, Gretel! said Hansel.
Then the witch woke up and stomped over. She could not see well, so she felt around for them.
Gretel had a clever idea. Witch, there is something sparkly in the oven!
"Something shiny? Where, where?" The witch strode over to the oven, stomp, stomp.
The witch peeks into the oven. Tap Gretel and give the oven door a big push!
Tap Gretel! Push with a bang.
Bang! The witch jumped in fright, and her hat flew off.
The witch hopped on her broom and whooshed up the chimney. I won't come back again!
"Phew! Now let us go home!" Hansel took Gretel's hand.
On the way home, they came to a wide river. There was no bridge!
The river rushed and roared, splash, splash, swift and strong.
"What do we do? We cannot swim." Gretel stamped her feet, worried.
Then a white duck came swimming.
Quack quack! Hop on my back! said the duck.
The two hopped onto the duck's back. The duck bobbed and paddled, bob, bob, across the river.
The duck carried them across the river. Thank you, Duck!
They could see their house far away. Papa had been searching the forest for them, so worried.
"Papa! It is Papa!" Gretel ran ahead first.
Hansel! Gretel! Papa came running.
Found you! I missed you so much! said Papa.
"Papa, please never leave us again," said Hansel.
"I never will. I promise." Papa hugged them both tight.
Hansel and Gretel felt warm and happy. How do you feel? Tap Hansel and cheer!
Tap Hansel! Hooray!
That night, the two of them snuggled under their cozy blankets and fell fast asleep, zzz.
Home is the coziest place. That is how the story of Hansel and Gretel ended.

read_en.key: 헨젤은 지붕에 빠진 사탕을 하나씩 다시 콕콕 붙여 주었지요.

read_en.text: Then the door opened, and a witch granny came out.
read_en.key: 그때 문이 열리고 마녀 할머니가 나왔어요.

read_en.text: Who ate my candy house? grumbled the witch.
read_en.key: "내 과자 집을 누가 먹었니!" 마녀가 투덜거렸어요.

read_en.text: The witch was a grumpy granny who kept all her sweets to herself.
read_en.key: 마녀는 과자를 아끼는 심술쟁이 할머니였어요.

read_en.text: "My candy! My cookies! Oh, what a waste!" The witch stamped her feet, stomp, stomp.
read_en.key: "내 사탕! 내 쿠키! 으으, 아까워라!" 마녀는 발을 쿵쿵 굴렀어요.

read_en.text: The witch popped Hansel into a cage. Stay there until you pay for the candy!
read_en.key: 마녀는 헨젤을 새장에 쏙 넣어 버렸어요. "과자 값을 낼 때까지 여기 있어!"

read_en.text: Beside Hansel’s cage, Gretel looked for a way to get him out.
read_en.key: 새장에 갇힌 헨젤 곁에서 그레텔은 빠져나갈 방법을 찾았어요.

read_en.text: While the witch napped, Gretel fetched three keys.
read_en.key: 그레텔은 마녀가 낮잠을 자는 사이에 열쇠 세 개를 가져왔어요.

read_en.text: A circle, a triangle, and a star. Gretel peered at the keyhole this way and that.
read_en.key: 동그라미, 세모, 별 모양. 그레텔은 자물쇠 구멍을 요리조리 살펴보았어요.

read_en.text: "It is the star!" Gretel gently slid the star key into the lock.
read_en.key: "별 모양이야!" 그레텔은 별 열쇠를 살며시 꽂았어요.

read_en.text: Click! The cage opened. Hansel hopped out!
read_en.key: 찰칵! 새장이 열렸어요. 헨젤이 폴짝 뛰어나왔어요!

read_en.text: Thank you, Gretel! said Hansel.
read_en.key: "고마워, 그레텔!" 헨젤이 말했어요.

read_en.text: Out of the cage, Hansel stood with Gretel by the oven.
read_en.key: 새장에서 나온 헨젤은 그레텔과 화덕 곁에 있었어요.

read_en.text: Then the witch woke up and stomped over. She could not see well, so she felt around for them.
read_en.key: 그때 마녀가 일어나 쿵쿵 걸어왔어요. 눈이 나빠서 더듬더듬 찾았어요.

read_en.text: Gretel had a clever idea. Witch, there is something sparkly in the oven!
read_en.key: 그레텔은 꾀가 났어요. "마녀님, 화덕 안에 반짝이는 게 있어요!"

read_en.text: When the witch leaned in to peek inside the oven, Gretel gave the oven door a mighty push.
read_en.key: 마녀가 화덕 안을 기웃기웃 들여다보자, 그레텔이 화덕 문을 힘껏 밀었어요.

read_en.text: Bang! The witch jumped in fright, and her hat flew off.
read_en.key: 쾅! 마녀는 깜짝 놀라 모자가 휙 날아갔어요.

read_en.text: The witch hopped on her broom and whooshed up the chimney. I won't come back again!
read_en.key: 마녀는 빗자루를 타고 굴뚝으로 휘리릭 날아갔어요. "다시는 안 올게~!"

read_en.text: "Phew! Now let us go home!" Hansel took Gretel's hand.
read_en.key: "휴, 이제 집으로 가자!" 헨젤이 그레텔의 손을 잡았어요.

read_en.text: On the way home, they came to a wide river. There was no bridge!
read_en.key: 집으로 가는 길에 넓은 강이 나왔어요. 다리가 없어요!

read_en.text: The river rushed and roared, splash, splash, swift and strong.
read_en.key: 강물이 콸콸, 세차게 흘렀어요.

read_en.text: Then a white duck came swimming.
read_en.key: 그때 흰 오리가 헤엄쳐 왔어요.

read_en.text: Quack quack! Hop on my back! said the duck.
read_en.key: "꽥꽥! 내 등에 타!" 오리가 말했어요.

read_en.text: The two hopped onto the duck's back. The duck bobbed and paddled, bob, bob, across the river.
read_en.key: 둘은 오리 등에 폴짝 올라탔어요. 오리는 둥실둥실 강을 건넜지요.

read_en.text: The duck carried them across the river. Thank you, Duck!
read_en.key: 오리가 둘을 태우고 강을 건너 주었어요. "고마워, 오리야!"

read_en.text: Gretel gently stroked the duck's soft, fluffy feathers.
read_en.key: 그레텔은 오리의 보드라운 깃털을 살살 쓰다듬어 주었어요.

read_en.text: Across the river, the children kept walking along the forest path.
read_en.key: 강을 건넌 두 아이는 숲길을 따라 계속 걸었어요.

read_en.text: They could see their house far away. Papa had been searching the forest for them, so worried.
read_en.key: 저 멀리 집이 보여요. 아빠가 숲에서 둘을 애타게 찾고 있었어요.

read_en.text: Hansel! Gretel! Papa came running.
read_en.key: "헨젤! 그레텔!" 아빠가 달려왔어요.

read_en.text: Papa scooped up both children and spun them round and round.
read_en.key: 아빠는 두 아이를 번쩍 안아 올려 빙글빙글 돌았어요.

read_en.text: Found you! I missed you so much! said Papa.
read_en.key: "찾았다! 보고 싶었어!" 아빠가 말했어요.

read_en.text: Hansel and Gretel felt warm and happy.
read_en.key: 헨젤과 그레텔은 마음이 따뜻하고 행복했어요.

read_en.text: That night, the two of them snuggled under their cozy blankets and fell fast asleep, zzz.
read_en.key: 그날 밤, 둘은 포근한 이불 속에서 새근새근 잠이 들었답니다.

read_en.text: Home is the coziest place. That is how the story of Hansel and Gretel ended.
read_en.key: 우리 집이 제일 포근해요. 헨젤과 그레텔 이야기는 이렇게 끝났어요.

ko.text: 옛날 옛날에 마음씨 착한 동생 흥부와 욕심쟁이 형 놀부가 살았어요.
흥부는 배가 고파서 형 집으로 밥을 얻으러 갔어요.
형수가 주걱을 휘두르자 흥부 볼에 밥알이 붙었어요. 흥부는 그 밥알을 맛있게 먹었어요.
흥부네 초가집 처마에는 제비 가족이 살았어요.
아기 제비는 몇 마리일까요? 둥지를 톡톡톡 눌러서 세어 봐요!
둥지를 톡톡톡! 아기 제비를 세어 봐요.
아기 제비가 하나, 둘, 셋! 세 마리예요.
앗! 아기 제비 한 마리가 둥지에서 떨어졌어요!
흥부를 톡! 눌러서 아기 제비를 받아 줘요.
흥부는 아기 제비의 다친 다리에 천을 감아 주었어요. 아기 제비는 금방 나았어요.
가을이 되자 제비 가족은 따뜻한 남쪽 나라로 떠났어요.
봄이 되자 제비가 돌아와서 박씨 하나를 떨어뜨렸어요.
쑥쑥 자란 줄기에 박이 열렸어요. 줄기를 톡톡톡 눌러서 박을 세어 봐요!
박이 하나, 둘, 셋! 세 통이에요.
흥부 부부는 톱으로 박을 탔어요. 박을 톡! 눌러서 슬근슬근 타 봐요.
첫 번째 박에서 하얀 쌀이 쏟아졌어요! 아이들이 신나서 소리쳤어요.
쌀자루가 하나, 둘, 셋! 이제 배불리 먹을 수 있어요.
두 번째 박에서는 반짝반짝 금은보화가 나왔어요!
세 번째 박에서는 작은 박 요정들이 나와 멋진 새집을 지어 주었어요!
놀부는 제비집을 마구 흔들었어요. 아기 제비가 떨어졌어요!
놀부네 마당에도 박이 세 통 열렸어요.
박이 하나, 둘, 셋! 놀부는 기대에 부풀었어요.
콸콸콸! 박에서 흙탕물이 쏟아져서 놀부가 흠뻑 젖었어요.
와르르! 놀부의 집이 무너졌어요. 다행히 아무도 다치지 않았어요.
놀부는 흙투성이가 되어 흥부네 집을 찾아왔어요.
쌀자루를 톡! 눌러서 형님네 집으로 보내 줘요.
쌀자루가 하나, 둘, 셋! 놀부는 눈물이 핑 돌았어요.
흥부를 톡! 눌러서 모두 함께 만세!
흥부와 놀부는 그 뒤로 사이좋게 오래오래 살았대요. 착한 마음은 복이 되어 돌아와요.

en.text: Once upon a time, there lived a kind younger brother, Heungbu, and his greedy older brother, Nolbu.
Tap Heungbu to say hello!
Tap Heungbu! Say hello.
Heungbu smiled and said hello.
Heungbu was hungry, so he went to his brother's house to ask for some rice.
His sister-in-law said with an angry face. "There is no rice here! Go away!"
She waved her rice paddle, and a few grains of rice stuck to Heungbu's cheek. Heungbu ate them happily.
Heungbu said with a smile. "It's okay. Even these grains are yummy!"
A swallow family lived under the eaves of Heungbu's little house.
How many baby swallows are there? Tap the nest, tap tap tap, to count!
Tap the nest, tap tap tap! Count the baby swallows.
One, two, three! There are three baby swallows.
Oh no! One baby swallow fell out of the nest!
Tap Heungbu to catch the baby swallow.
Tap Heungbu! Catch the swallow.
Heungbu wrapped a cloth around the baby swallow's hurt leg. The baby swallow got better soon.
When autumn came, the swallow family flew away to a warm country in the south.
When spring came, the swallow flew back and dropped one gourd seed.
Heungbu planted the seed in his yard.
The vine grew and grew, and gourds appeared. Tap the vine, tap tap tap, to count the gourds!
Tap the vine, tap tap tap! Count the gourds.
One, two, three! There are three gourds.
Heungbu and his wife cut the gourds with a saw. Tap a gourd to saw it, back and forth!
Tap the gourd! Saw, saw, saw.
White rice poured out of the first gourd! The children shouted with joy.
Tap the rice sacks, tap tap tap, to count them!
Tap the rice sacks, tap tap tap! Count them.
One, two, three rice sacks! Now they can eat until they are full.
Sparkling gold and jewels came out of the second gourd!
Tiny gourd fairies came out of the third gourd and built a wonderful new house!
When Nolbu heard the news, he felt jealous. "I will be rich too!"
Nolbu shook the swallow's nest hard. A baby swallow fell!
Nolbu hurriedly wrapped a cloth around it. "Now bring me a gourd seed!" The swallow was not hurt and flew away.
Three gourds grew in Nolbu's yard too.
One, two, three gourds! Nolbu was full of hope.
Tap the first gourd!
Splash! Muddy water poured out of the gourd and Nolbu got soaked.
This time, a Dokkaebi with a club popped out. "You greedy man!" The Dokkaebi gave Nolbu a fright and then disappeared.
Crash! Nolbu's house fell down. Luckily, nobody was hurt.
Nolbu, covered in mud, came to Heungbu's house.
Nolbu bowed his head. "Brother, I was wrong. I am sorry I was so greedy."
Heungbu smiled and said. "Brother, it's okay. Let's live together!"
Tap a rice sack to send it to your brother's house.
Tap a rice sack! Send it to your brother.
One, two, three rice sacks! Tears filled Nolbu's eyes.
Tap Heungbu for a big cheer together!
Tap Heungbu! Hooray, everyone!
After that, Heungbu and Nolbu lived happily together for a very long time. A kind heart brings good fortune back.

구름이 쏙! 토끼, 물고기, 자동차로 바뀌어요.
꿀떡이가 문틈에 코를 쏙 밀어 넣어요.
기다란 벨트 위로 물방울이 똑, 똑, 똑.
이현이가 물방울에 손을 살짝 대 봐요.
퐁! 토끼 구름. 퐁! 고래 구름.
구석에 아기 먹구름 하나가 혼자 웅크리고 있어요.
혼자 웅크리고 있어요. 슬픈 것 같아요.
슈웅— 아기 먹구름이 굴뚝으로 올라가요. 퐁!
삼남매도 손을 흔들며 밖으로 달려 나가요.
하늘에서 아기 먹구름이 큰 먹구름과 쿵!
무지개를 톡톡톡… 일곱 색을 세어 봐요!
비를 다 내린 아기 먹구름은 하얗게 변했어요.
하얀 아기 구름이 방긋 웃어요. 퐁!
꿀떡이는 젖은 흙에 코를 대고 킁킁.
삼남매는 꿀떡이랑 왔던 길로 집에 가요.
멀리 굴뚝에서 작은 구름이 퐁! 퐁!
꿀떡이는 굴뚝 쪽 바람을 마지막으로 킁킁.

en.text: On a sunny day, Dahyun, Ihyun, and Eunwoo go for a walk with Kkulddeok.
Clouds float across the sky.
Where do clouds come from?
Tap Kkulddeok! Let's sniff together.
Kkulddeok puts his nose to the ground. Sniff, sniff.
Sniff sniff sniff! Kkulddeok smells something.
Tap Kkulddeok! Follow the smell.
He runs off, following the smell.
Kkulddeok, wait for us!
Heave-ho, heave-ho! The three kids climb the hill.
Over the hill, there is a big chimney.
White steam puffs out of the chimney.
Tap the chimney!
The steam rolls together, and together... Pong! It turns into a cloud.
So this is where clouds come from!
Pong! Eunwoo says it too.
Tap a cloud in the sky! What will it become?
The clouds change! A rabbit, a fish, and a car.
Under the chimney, there is a big door.
What kind of factory... could this be?
Kkulddeok pokes his nose into the gap in the door.
Tap the gap in the door!
Creeeak... the door swings open.
The three kids tiptoe in after him.
Water drops fall onto a long belt. Drip, drip, drip.
Tap the water drops!
Ihyun gently touches a water drop.
Dahyun blows a big breath. Whoooo!
Tap the wind horn!
Puff, puff puff, puff puff puff! Pong!
This is a cloud factory!
Ihyun pushes the shape press. Push!
Tap the shape press, tap tap tap!
Pong! A bunny cloud. Pong! A whale cloud.
Pong! And now, a puppy cloud.
Kkulddeok touches noses with the puppy cloud.
Achoo! Little bits of cloud float away.
In the corner, there is a big red button.
Can we press it?
Tap the red button!
Eunwoo presses it. Push!
Whoosh! The puppy cloud zooms up the chimney.
Pong! Out into the sky it goes.
The next room is dark. It is the rain cloud room.
The rain clouds drink water from a big tank.
Tap the rain clouds, tap tap tap!
Gulp, gulp, gulp. Their tummies get big and round.
I think they're making rain.
Kkulddeok sniffs the wet floor.
Tap the bell!
Ding, ding, ding! The bell rings.
The rain clouds line up and go outside.
In the corner, one baby rain cloud is curled up all alone.
I don't want to go. Everybody hates rain.
How does the baby rain cloud feel right now?
It is curled up all alone. It looks sad.
Tap sad!
Kkulddeok tiptoes closer.
Eunwoo gently pats the baby rain cloud.
Pat the baby rain cloud, tap tap tap!
We love rain! We put on our boots and splash!
Splash, splash! Ihyun jumps too.
Kkulddeok licks the baby cloud's cheek. Lick!
The baby rain cloud's eyes go big and round.
Really? Then I'll go!
Tap the baby rain cloud! You can do it!
Whoosh! The baby rain cloud zooms up the chimney. Pong!
The three kids wave and run outside.
Kkulddeok looks up at the sky. Woof! Woof!
Up in the sky, the baby rain cloud bumps into a big rain cloud. Bump!
Tap the lightning!
Flash! Rumble, BOOM!
Eek! The three kids hug each other tight.
Sorry, sorry! We were just saying hello!
Kkulddeok wags his tail, wiggle wiggle.
Tap the raindrop!
It's raining!
Tap the puddles, tap tap tap! Splash, splash!
The three kids and Kkulddeok splash in the puddles!
Splash! Eunwoo jumps the highest.
Tap the ground!
Kkulddeok sniffs the strawberry.
The baby rain cloud looks down. Oh? Everyone is smiling!
A big rainbow in the sky! Wow!
Tap the rainbow... let's count all seven colors!
Tap the baby rain cloud!
After raining all its rain, the baby rain cloud turns white.
The little white cloud smiles. Pong!
So this is where clouds come from!
Kkulddeok puts his nose to the wet dirt. Sniff, sniff.
The three kids and Kkulddeok walk home the way they came.
Tap the chimney! Bye-bye!
Far away, little clouds pop out of the chimney. Pong! Pong!
Eunwoo looks back and waves. Pong!
Kkulddeok takes one last sniff of the wind from the chimney.
Plip.
Plip, plop.
Plip, plop, plop.
From the rainy ground, a little sprout pops up!
A flower opens wide!
A strawberry turns red!
Red!
Orange!
Yellow!
Green!
Blue!
Indigo!
Purple!

콩쥐는 아쉬웠지만 한 짝만 신고 잔치로 갔어요.

콩쥐와 원님은 혼례를 올렸어요. 콩쥐는 곱게 차린 신부가 되었어요.
모두 둘러앉아 맛있게 먹었어요. 콩쥐를 톡! 모두 함께 만세!
착한 마음은 도움을 불러와요. 콩쥐팥쥐 이야기는 이렇게 끝났어요.

en.text: Once upon a time, there lived a kind girl named Kongjwi.
She lived with her stepmother and Patjwi.
Kongjwi, sweep the yard! said her stepmother.
Tap Kongjwi to sweep the yard!
The yard was clean. Kongjwi smiled.
Plow this whole field! said her stepmother.
The field was so big that Kongjwi sighed.
Then a black ox appeared. Moo! I will help you!
The ox plowed the field fast. Thank you, ox!
Fill this big jar with water! said her stepmother.
Tap the bucket, tap tap tap, to pour water three times!
Tap the bucket, tap tap tap! Pour the water.
Oh no! There was a hole in the jar, and the water leaked out.
Then a toad hopped over. I will plug the hole!
Tap the toad! Plug the hole.
The toad slipped into the hole! Now the water does not leak.
The jar was full of water. Thank you, toad!
Peel the husks and bring me the rice! said her stepmother.
There was so much grain that Kongjwi felt worried.
Then sparrows flew in. Tweet tweet! We will help!
The sparrows pecked and peeled the husks. Let's count the sparrows one by one!
Tap the sparrows, tap tap tap tap tap! Count them one by one.
One, two, three, four, five sparrows! The rice soon turned white.
Now Kongjwi had to weave cloth. She wove very hard.
Then a fairy came down from the sky. Kind Kongjwi, I have a gift for you!
Kongjwi got a beautiful dress and butterfly shoes. Thank you, fairy!
Kongjwi crossed the stream to go to the feast. Tap to cross the stepping stones!
Splash! One shoe fell into the stream and floated away.
Kongjwi felt sad, but she went to the feast with one shoe.
At the feast, drums and gongs rang out. Tap the drum!
Tap the drum! Boom boom!
Everyone danced happily. Her stepmother and Patjwi came in fancy clothes too.
When they saw Kongjwi, her stepmother and Patjwi felt shy and hid their faces behind fans.
The lost shoe reached the magistrate. Let's find who owns this shoe!
Of the three pairs of shoes, the butterfly shoe is Kongjwi's. Tap the butterfly shoe!
Tap the butterfly shoe!
Look for the shoe with butterflies on it.
Tap the sparkling shoe!
The magistrate put the shoe on Kongjwi. It fit perfectly!
Kongjwi and the magistrate got married. Kongjwi became a lovely bride.
Kongjwi, I am sorry for everything. Her stepmother and Patjwi bowed their heads.
Kongjwi smiled and said, It's okay. Let's live together.
Everyone shares rice cakes.
Everyone sat around and ate happily. Tap Kongjwi! Hooray together!
Tap Kongjwi! Hooray together!
A kind heart brings help. And that is how the story of Kongjwi and Patjwi ended.
Tap Kongjwi! Sweep the yard.
Tap Kongjwi! Cross the stepping stones.

read_en.key: 사자가 웃다가 앞발이 스르르 열렸어요.

read_en.text: The mouse slipped right out. "Thank you, Lion!"
read_en.key: 생쥐가 쏙 빠져나왔어요. "고맙습니다, 사자님!"

read_en.text: The mouse waved his tail and scurried off into the grass, pitter-patter, pitter-patter.
read_en.key: 생쥐는 꼬리를 흔들며 다다다, 풀숲으로 달려갔어요.

read_en.text: Now that the mouse has left, shall we think about their sizes?
read_en.key: 생쥐가 떠난 뒤, 두 친구의 크기를 떠올려 볼까요?

read_en.text: One lion toe is as big as a whole mouse!
read_en.key: 사자 발가락 하나가 생쥐 한 마리만 해요!

read_en.text: The lion's footprints are great big thumps, and the mouse's footprints are teeny tiny taps.
read_en.key: 사자 발자국은 쿵쿵 커다랗고, 생쥐 발자국은 콩콩 조그마해요.

read_en.text: The mouse's teeth are small, but very strong. Nibble, nibble! They can gnaw anything.
read_en.key: 생쥐 이빨은 작지만 아주 튼튼해요. 사각사각 뭐든 갉을 수 있지요.

read_en.text: Big or small, everyone is useful.
read_en.key: 크면 큰 대로, 작으면 작은 대로 다 쓸모가 있어요.

read_en.text: Night came. Oh no, the lion is caught in a net!
read_en.key: 밤이 되었어요. 앗, 사자가 그물에 걸렸어요!

read_en.text: A trap’s net had wrapped tightly around the lion in the grass.
read_en.key: 풀밭에 놓인 덫의 그물이 사자를 꽁꽁 감쌌어요.

read_en.text: The lion wiggles and wriggles, but the net won't come loose.
read_en.key: 사자가 버둥버둥, 그래도 그물이 풀리지 않아요.

read_en.text: The net was tied up tight, and the lion could not move an inch.
read_en.key: 그물은 꽁꽁, 사자는 꼼짝달싹할 수 없었어요.

read_en.text: Roar, roar! The lion cried out in a sad, loud voice.
read_en.key: 어흥, 어흥! 사자가 슬픈 목소리로 크게 울었어요.

read_en.text: Ears up! The mouse heard the lion's voice.
read_en.key: 쫑긋! 생쥐가 사자 목소리를 들었어요.

read_en.text: Pitter-patter! The mouse ran up to the net.
read_en.key: 생쥐가 다다다 달려와 그물 앞에 섰어요.

read_en.text: "Lion, I'll help you!"
read_en.key: "사자님, 제가 도와 드릴게요!"

read_en.text: In the moonlight, the mouse clung to the net around the lion.
read_en.key: 달빛 아래, 생쥐가 사자를 감싼 그물에 매달렸어요.

read_en.text: The mouse gnaws the net with tiny teeth. Nibble, nibble, one rope at a time!
read_en.key: 생쥐가 작은 이빨로 그물을 갉아요. 사각사각, 한 줄씩 끊어요!

read_en.text: Nibble, nibble, nibble, nibble. One by one, the ropes went snap, snap.
read_en.key: 사각사각, 사각사각. 그물 줄이 하나씩 툭, 툭 끊어졌어요.

read_en.text: One, two, three... ten! All ten ropes are cut!
read_en.key: 하나, 둘, 셋… 열! 그물 줄 열 개를 다 끊었어요!

read_en.text: Snap! went the last rope, and the net slid loose, sliiide.
read_en.key: 마지막 줄이 툭! 끊어지자 그물이 스르르 풀렸어요.

read_en.text: Hooray! The lion is free!
read_en.key: 와아! 사자가 풀려났어요!

read_en.text: The free lion spoke kindly to the mouse.
read_en.key: 풀려난 사자가 생쥐에게 다정하게 말했어요.

read_en.text: "Thank you, little friend. Your tiny teeth saved me!"
read_en.key: "고마워, 작은 친구. 작은 이빨이 나를 구해 줬구나!"

read_en.text: "Didn't I say I'd pay you back?"
read_en.key: "제가 은혜 갚는다고 했지요?"

read_en.text: The night passed, and the sun rose over the two friends on the plain.
read_en.key: 밤이 지나고, 두 친구가 있는 초원에 해가 떴어요.

read_en.text: The next morning, the lion put the mouse on its back. "Hold tight!"
read_en.key: 다음 날 아침, 사자가 생쥐를 등에 태웠어요. "꽉 잡아!"

read_en.text: Thump, thump, thump! The lion ran like the wind, and the mouse held on tight to his mane.
read_en.key: 다다다! 사자가 바람처럼 달리고, 생쥐는 갈기를 꼭 붙잡았어요.

read_en.text: They race across the meadow through the wind! Yippee!
read_en.key: 바람을 가르며 초원을 달려요! 신난다!

read_en.text: They giggled and laughed, tee-hee, ha-ha, as they ran one big loop around the meadow.
read_en.key: 둘은 깔깔, 하하 웃으며 초원을 한 바퀴 빙 돌았어요.

read_en.text: From that day on, the lion and the mouse were the best of friends.
read_en.key: 그날부터 사자와 생쥐는 둘도 없는 친구가 되었답니다.

read_en.text: Even someone small can help a big friend.
read_en.key: 작아도 큰 친구를 도울 수 있답니다.

ko.text: 깊고 깊은 바다 밑에 인어 나라가 있었어요. 바다 왕님과 할머니, 여섯 공주가 살았지요.
막내 인어공주는 조용하고 생각이 많았어요. 정원에는 배에서 떨어진 물건을 모았어요.
무거운 것은 가라앉고, 가벼운 것은 떠요. 어느 것이 바다 밑까지 내려올까요?
언니들은 열다섯 살이 되면 바다 위로 올라갔어요. 드디어 막내 차례예요!
커다란 배가 있었어요. 오늘은 왕자님 생일이래요.
밤이 깊자 바람이 세졌어요. 배가 기우뚱!
인어공주는 왕자님의 머리를 물 위로 받쳐 주었어요.
인어공주는 왕자님을 모래밭에 눕히고, 바위 뒤에 숨었어요.
왕자님은 아가씨에게 웃어 주었어요. 인어공주는 보지 못했지요.
사람은 땅 위에서 살고, 우리는 바다에서 살지. 사람에겐 별처럼 영원히 남는 마음이 있단다.
나도 왕자님 곁에서 그런 마음을 갖고 싶어요.
인어공주는 소용돌이 너머 바다 마녀를 찾아갔어요.
다리를 갖고 싶다고? 좋아. 대신 네 고운 목소리를 다오.
다리는 조금 흔들흔들할 거야. 그리고 왕자가 다른 사람과 결혼하면, 너는 바다 거품이 된단다.
마녀가 목소리를 진주처럼 가져갔어요. 이제 인어공주는 말을 할 수 없어요.
새벽, 궁전 계단에서 인어공주는 약을 마셨어요.
꼬리가 사라지고 다리가 생겼어요! 걸음은 흔들흔들.
인어공주는 말을 못 해요. 그저 웃었지요.
정원에 바다 친구가 섞였네. 바다에 사는 친구를 찾아봐요.
바다에서 온 아이 같아요. 내 귀여운 동생처럼 지내요.
당신이 모래밭에서 저를 구해 준 분이군요!
왕자님은 이웃 나라 공주님과 결혼했어요. 인어공주는 말없이 웃었어요. 마음은 아팠지요.
새벽, 배 옆에 언니들이 올라왔어요. 긴 머리가 짧아졌어요.
인어공주는 잠든 왕자님과 공주님을 보았어요. 그리고 고개를 저었지요.
인어공주는 단검을 칼집째 바다에 던졌어요. 물결이 붉은 금빛으로 반짝였어요. 해가 떠올랐어요.
인어공주는 반짝이는 거품이 되어 하늘로 둥실 올라갔어요.
인어공주는 부드러운 바닷바람이 되었어요. 길 잃은 배의 돛을 밀어 주고, 더운 날엔 시원한 바람을 보내지요.
사랑하는 마음은 사라지지 않아요. 안녕, 또 만나요!
사랑하는 마음으로 양보하면, 그 마음은 좋은 일이 되어 남아요.

en.text: Deep, deep under the sea there was a kingdom of merfolk. The Sea King, the grandmother and six princesses lived there.
The youngest, the little mermaid, was quiet and thoughtful. In her garden she collected things that had fallen from ships.
Heavy things sink, and light things float. Which one will come all the way down to the sea floor?
The piece of wood is light, so it floats.
The heavy stone sank!
This time, which one will sink?
The cork bottle is light, so it floats.
The heavy anchor sank too!
When each sister turned fifteen, she was allowed to swim up above the sea. At last it was the youngest one's turn!
Be careful, and come back safely.
Yes, Grandmother. I will be back soon!
There was a great big ship. Today was the prince's birthday.
Tap the sky!
Pop! Pop! Fireworks bloomed in the sky.
So that is the prince.
Late at night the wind grew strong. The ship tipped over!
The prince fell into the sea.
I will help you!
The little mermaid held the prince's head above the water.
The little mermaid laid the prince on the sand and hid behind a rock.
Oh my, are you all right?
The prince smiled at the young lady. He never saw the little mermaid.
The prince is awake. I am so glad.
Grandmother, how do people live?
People live on the land, and we live in the sea. But people have a heart that lasts forever, like a star.
I want to have a heart like that too, beside the prince.
The little mermaid swam past the whirlpool to find the sea witch.
You want legs? Very well. But in return, give me your lovely voice.
Your legs will wobble a little. And if the prince marries someone else, you will turn into sea foam.
I will go anyway.
Tap the cauldron!
The witch took her voice away like a little pearl. Now the little mermaid could not speak.
At dawn, on the palace steps, the little mermaid drank the potion.
Her tail was gone and she had legs! Her steps went wobble, wobble.
Who are you? Where did you come from?
The little mermaid could not speak. She only smiled.
Come and stay at our palace.
Some sea friends got mixed into the garden. Let's find the friends that live in the sea.
Which friend lives in the sea?
The fish lives in the sea!
The shell lives in the sea!
The starfish lives in the sea!
The butterfly flies in the sky. It is a land friend.
The rabbit hops on the land. It is a land friend.
The flower blooms on the land. It is a land friend.
The bird flies in the sky. It is a land friend.
The tree grows on the land. It is a land friend.
The puppy runs on the land. It is a land friend.
You seem like a child from the sea. Stay with me like my sweet little sister.
Even with wobbly steps, the little mermaid danced with the prince.
You are the one who saved me on the beach!
The prince married the princess of the neighbouring kingdom. The little mermaid smiled without a word. But her heart ached.
At dawn, the sisters came up beside the ship. Their long hair had been cut short.
The little mermaid looked at the sleeping prince and princess. Then she shook her head.
The little mermaid threw the dagger, still in its sheath, into the sea. The waves sparkled red and gold. The sun rose.
The little mermaid turned into shining bubbles and floated up into the sky.
The little mermaid became a soft sea breeze. She pushes the sails of lost ships, and sends a cool wind on hot days.
Tap the bubble light to say hello!
A loving heart never disappears. Goodbye, see you again!
When you give way with a loving heart, that heart stays behind as something good.

read_en.key: 인어공주가 할머니 곁에 앉아 물었어요.

read_en.text: Grandmother, how do people live?
read_en.key: 할머니, 사람은 어떻게 살아요?

read_en.text: People live on the land, and we live in the sea. But people have a heart that lasts forever, like a star.
read_en.key: 사람은 땅 위에서 살고, 우리는 바다에서 살지. 사람에겐 별처럼 영원히 남는 마음이 있단다.

read_en.text: The little mermaid's eyes sparkled, twinkle, twinkle, like stars.
read_en.key: 인어공주의 눈이 별처럼 반짝반짝 빛났어요.

read_en.text: I want to have a heart like that too, beside the prince.
read_en.key: 나도 왕자님 곁에서 그런 마음을 갖고 싶어요.

read_en.text: The little mermaid swam past the whirlpool to find the sea witch.
read_en.key: 인어공주는 소용돌이 너머 바다 마녀를 찾아갔어요.

read_en.text: The whirlpool spun round and round, and the cauldron went bubble, bubble.
read_en.key: 소용돌이가 빙글빙글 돌고, 가마솥이 보글보글 끓고 있었어요.

read_en.text: The witch spoke to the little mermaid who had come to see her.
read_en.key: 마녀가 찾아온 인어공주에게 말했어요.

read_en.text: You want legs? Very well. But in return, give me your lovely voice.
read_en.key: 다리를 갖고 싶다고? 좋아. 대신 네 고운 목소리를 다오.

read_en.text: Your legs will wobble a little. And if the prince marries someone else, you will turn into sea foam.
read_en.key: 다리는 조금 흔들흔들할 거야. 그리고 왕자가 다른 사람과 결혼하면, 너는 바다 거품이 된단다.

read_en.text: I will go anyway.
read_en.key: 그래도 갈래요.

read_en.text: The witch stirred the cauldron, swirl, swirl, and a sparkling potion appeared.
read_en.key: 마녀가 가마솥을 휘휘 젓자, 반짝반짝 약이 생겼어요.

read_en.text: The witch took her voice away like a little pearl. Now the little mermaid could not speak.
read_en.key: 마녀가 목소리를 진주처럼 가져갔어요. 이제 인어공주는 말을 할 수 없어요.

read_en.text: With the potion, the little mermaid swam to the human palace.
read_en.key: 인어공주는 약을 가지고 사람들의 궁전으로 헤엄쳐 갔어요.

read_en.text: At dawn, on the palace steps, the little mermaid drank the potion.
read_en.key: 새벽, 궁전 계단에서 인어공주는 약을 마셨어요.

read_en.text: Her tail was gone and she had legs! Her steps went wobble, wobble.
read_en.key: 꼬리가 사라지고 다리가 생겼어요! 걸음은 흔들흔들.

read_en.text: Clomp, clomp, someone came down the steps. It was the prince!
read_en.key: 뚜벅뚜벅, 누군가 계단을 내려왔어요. 왕자님이었어요!

read_en.text: The prince saw the little mermaid on the steps and asked a question.
read_en.key: 계단에서 인어공주를 발견한 왕자님이 물었어요.

read_en.text: Who are you? Where did you come from?
read_en.key: 누구세요? 어디서 왔어요?

read_en.text: The little mermaid could not speak. She only smiled.
read_en.key: 인어공주는 말을 못 해요. 그저 웃었지요.

read_en.text: Come and stay at our palace.
read_en.key: 우리 궁전에서 지내요.

read_en.text: The little mermaid toddled along behind the prince, wobble, wobble.
read_en.key: 인어공주는 왕자님 뒤를 아장아장 따라갔어요.

read_en.text: In the palace garden the flowers bloomed wide open, and butterflies fluttered, flit, flit.
read_en.key: 궁전 정원에는 꽃이 활짝활짝 피고, 나비가 팔랑팔랑 날았어요.

read_en.text: Every day the little mermaid strolled softly through the garden with the prince.
read_en.key: 인어공주는 날마다 왕자님과 정원을 사붓사붓 거닐었어요.

read_en.text: The prince spoke gently to the little mermaid.
read_en.key: 왕자님이 인어공주에게 다정하게 말했어요.

read_en.text: You seem like a child from the sea. Stay with me like my sweet little sister.
read_en.key: 바다에서 온 아이 같아요. 내 귀여운 동생처럼 지내요.

read_en.text: Even with wobbly steps, the little mermaid danced with the prince.
read_en.key: 인어공주는 흔들흔들해도 왕자님과 함께 춤추었어요.

read_en.text: Every time she twirled round and round, her feet hurt, but the little mermaid smiled sweetly.
read_en.key: 빙글빙글 돌 때마다 발이 아팠지만, 인어공주는 방긋 웃었어요.

read_en.text: One day, the great ship was hung with flowers, bunches and bunches of them.
read_en.key: 어느 날, 커다란 배에 꽃이 주렁주렁 걸렸어요.

read_en.text: The prince, the little mermaid, and a princess from a nearby kingdom were on the ship.
read_en.key: 그 배에 왕자님과 인어공주, 이웃 나라 공주님이 모였어요.

read_en.text: The prince spoke to the princess from the nearby kingdom.
read_en.key: 왕자님이 이웃 나라 공주님에게 말했어요.

read_en.text: You are the one who saved me on the beach!
read_en.key: 당신이 모래밭에서 저를 구해 준 분이군요!

read_en.text: The prince looked at the young lady from the white house and smiled a big, wide smile.
read_en.key: 왕자님은 하얀 집 아가씨를 보고 활짝 웃었어요.

read_en.text: The prince married the princess of the neighbouring kingdom. The little mermaid smiled without a word. But her heart ached.
read_en.key: 왕자님은 이웃 나라 공주님과 결혼했어요. 인어공주는 말없이 웃었어요. 마음은 아팠지요.

read_en.text: The bells rang, ding, dong, and the little mermaid stood all alone at the front of the ship.
read_en.key: 종소리가 댕댕 울리고, 인어공주는 혼자 뱃머리에 서 있었어요.

read_en.text: At dawn, the sisters came up beside the ship. Their long hair had been cut short.
read_en.key: 새벽, 배 옆에 언니들이 올라왔어요. 긴 머리가 짧아졌어요.

read_en.text: The sisters whispered to the little mermaid on the ship.
read_en.key: 언니들이 배 위의 인어공주에게 속삭였어요.

read_en.text: We gave the witch our hair and got this dagger.
read_en.key: 마녀에게 머리카락을 주고 이 단검을 받았어.

read_en.text: If you use this on the prince before the sun rises, you will be a mermaid again. If you do not, you will turn into foam.
read_en.key: 해가 뜨기 전에 이걸 왕자에게 쓰면 너는 다시 인어가 돼. 그러지 않으면 거품이 되는 거야.

read_en.text: The little mermaid took the dagger her sister held out.
read_en.key: 언니가 내민 단검을 인어공주가 받아 들었어요.

read_en.text: The little mermaid looked at the sleeping prince and princess. Then she shook her head.
read_en.key: 인어공주는 잠든 왕자님과 공주님을 보았어요. 그리고 고개를 저었지요.

read_en.text: In her heart, ever so quietly, the little mermaid wished for the prince to be happy.
read_en.key: 인어공주는 왕자님이 행복하기를 마음속으로 조용조용 빌었어요.

read_en.text: The little mermaid threw the dagger, still in its sheath, into the sea. The waves sparkled red and gold. The sun rose.
read_en.key: 인어공주는 단검을 칼집째 바다에 던졌어요. 물결이 붉은 금빛으로 반짝였어요. 해가 떠올랐어요.

read_en.text: The little mermaid turned into shining bubbles and floated up into the sky.
read_en.key: 인어공주는 반짝이는 거품이 되어 하늘로 둥실 올라갔어요.

read_en.text: The bubbles caught the sunlight and shimmered in all the colors of the rainbow.
read_en.key: 거품은 햇살을 받아 알록달록 무지개빛으로 빛났어요.

read_en.text: The ship sailed gently across the morning sea.
read_en.key: 아침 바다 위로 배가 조용히 흘러갔어요.

read_en.text: The little mermaid became a soft sea breeze. She pushes the sails of lost ships, and sends a cool wind on hot days.
read_en.key: 인어공주는 부드러운 바닷바람이 되었어요. 길 잃은 배의 돛을 밀어 주고, 더운 날엔 시원한 바람을 보내지요.

read_en.text: Whoosh! The wind blew, the sails flapped, flap, flap, and the ship sailed on and on.
read_en.key: 휘잉~ 바람이 불자 돛이 펄럭펄럭, 배가 쑥쑥 나아갔어요.

read_en.text: The seagulls cried, squawk, squawk, and danced along with the wind.
read_en.key: 갈매기들이 끼룩끼룩, 바람을 따라 춤을 추었어요.

read_en.text: A loving heart never disappears. Goodbye, see you again!
read_en.key: 사랑하는 마음은 사라지지 않아요. 안녕, 또 만나요!

read_en.text: When you give way with a loving heart, that heart stays behind as something good.
read_en.key: 사랑하는 마음으로 양보하면, 그 마음은 좋은 일이 되어 남아요.

ko.text: 옛날 옛날에 마음씨 착한 농부가 살았어요.
농부는 밭을 열심히 갈았어요. 농부를 톡! 눌러서 밭을 갈아 봐요!
쨍! 괭이 끝에 뭔가 딱딱한 게 닿았어요.
쑥! 커다란 항아리가 나왔어요. 농부는 눈이 동그래졌어요.
농부는 항아리를 집 마당에 놓았어요. 아내도 구경하러 나왔어요.
농부가 괭이를 항아리 옆에 두려다 그만 항아리 속에 떨어뜨렸어요.
항아리를 세 번 톡톡 눌러서 괭이를 세 개 세어 봐요!
항아리를 세 번 톡톡! 괭이를 세어 봐요.
괭이가 하나, 둘, 셋! 농부와 아내는 손뼉을 쳤어요.
항아리를 네 번 톡톡 눌러서 괭이를 네 개 세어 봐요!
항아리를 네 번 톡톡! 괭이를 세어 봐요.
괭이가 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷! 농부와 아내는 손뼉을 쳤어요.
항아리를 다섯 번 톡톡 눌러서 괭이를 다섯 개 세어 봐요!
항아리를 다섯 번 톡톡! 괭이를 세어 봐요.
괭이가 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯! 농부와 아내는 손뼉을 쳤어요.
항아리를 여섯 번 톡톡 눌러서 괭이를 여섯 개 세어 봐요!
항아리를 여섯 번 톡톡! 괭이를 세어 봐요.
괭이가 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯, 여섯! 농부와 아내는 손뼉을 쳤어요.
이번에는 엽전 하나를 넣어 봤어요. 와르르! 엽전이 쏟아져 나왔어요.
항아리를 네 번 톡톡 눌러서 엽전을 네 개 세어 봐요!
항아리를 네 번 톡톡! 엽전을 세어 봐요.
엽전이 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷! 이제 쌀도 사고 옷도 살 수 있어요.
항아리를 다섯 번 톡톡 눌러서 엽전을 다섯 개 세어 봐요!
항아리를 다섯 번 톡톡! 엽전을 세어 봐요.
엽전이 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯! 이제 쌀도 사고 옷도 살 수 있어요.
항아리를 여섯 번 톡톡 눌러서 엽전을 여섯 개 세어 봐요!
항아리를 여섯 번 톡톡! 엽전을 세어 봐요.
엽전이 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯, 여섯! 이제 쌀도 사고 옷도 살 수 있어요.
항아리를 일곱 번 톡톡 눌러서 엽전을 일곱 개 세어 봐요!
항아리를 일곱 번 톡톡! 엽전을 세어 봐요.
엽전이 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯, 여섯, 일곱! 이제 쌀도 사고 옷도 살 수 있어요.
항아리를 여덟 번 톡톡 눌러서 엽전을 여덟 개 세어 봐요!
항아리를 여덟 번 톡톡! 엽전을 세어 봐요.
엽전이 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯, 여섯, 일곱, 여덟! 이제 쌀도 사고 옷도 살 수 있어요.
착한 농부는 혼자만 쓰지 않았어요. 이웃 다섯 집에 쌀을 나눠 주러 갔어요.
다섯 집 모두 쌀을 받고 활짝 웃었어요. 마을이 함께 행복해졌어요.
부자를 톡! 금 더미에서 꺼내 줘요.
풍덩! 아버지가 항아리에 거꾸로 쏙 빠졌어요. 다치지는 않았어요.
항아리를 여덟 번 톡톡! 아버지를 세어 봐요.
아버지가 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯, 여섯, 일곱, 여덟! 여덟 명이나 되었어요.
쨍그랑! 항아리가 깨지자 일곱 명은 사라지고, 진짜 아버지만 남았어요.
부자는 농부를 찾아가 사과하고, 가진 것을 마을 사람들과 나누기로 했어요. 함께 잔치를 열어요!
나누면 기쁨이 커져요. 요술 항아리 이야기는 이렇게 끝났어요.

en.text: Once upon a time, a kind farmer lived in a village.
The farmer worked hard in his field. Tap the farmer to dig!
Clang! The hoe hit something hard.
A round lid is showing in the ground.
Pop! A big jar came out. The farmer's eyes went wide.
The farmer put the jar in his yard. His wife came out to look, too.
The farmer tried to put his hoe beside the jar, but it fell inside.
Oh my! There are two hoes now! His wife was so surprised.
Tap the jar three times and count three hoes!
Tap the jar three times! Count the hoes.
One, two, three hoes! The farmer and his wife clapped their hands.
Tap the jar four times and count four hoes!
Tap the jar four times! Count the hoes.
One, two, three, four hoes! The farmer and his wife clapped their hands.
Tap the jar five times and count five hoes!
Tap the jar five times! Count the hoes.
One, two, three, four, five hoes! The farmer and his wife clapped their hands.
Tap the jar six times and count six hoes!
Tap the jar six times! Count the hoes.
One, two, three, four, five, six hoes! The farmer and his wife clapped their hands.
This time they dropped in one coin. Whoosh! Coins poured out.
Tap the jar four times and count four coins!
Tap the jar four times! Count the coins.
One, two, three, four coins! Now they could buy rice and clothes.
Tap the jar five times and count five coins!
Tap the jar five times! Count the coins.
One, two, three, four, five coins! Now they could buy rice and clothes.
Tap the jar six times and count six coins!
Tap the jar six times! Count the coins.
One, two, three, four, five, six coins! Now they could buy rice and clothes.
Tap the jar seven times and count seven coins!
Tap the jar seven times! Count the coins.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven coins! Now they could buy rice and clothes.
Tap the jar eight times and count eight coins!
Tap the jar eight times! Count the coins.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight coins! Now they could buy rice and clothes.
The kind farmer did not keep it all for himself. He went to share rice with five neighbors.
Tap a house! Share the rice.
All five houses got rice and smiled wide. The whole village was happy.
A rich man heard the news and called the farmer. Lend me that jar!
The kind farmer said with a smile. "Please use it, and bring it back!"
Thank you! I will take it right away, hee hee. The rich man hugged the jar and ran off.
The rich man put the jar in his room. If I put in a gold bar, I will get a mountain of gold!
Gold bars tumbled out! The rich man was buried in a pile of gold. Help me!
Tap the rich man to pull him out.
Tap the rich man! Pull him out of the gold.
Pop! The rich man got out. He was not hurt.
Then the rich man's father came and peeked into the jar. What is this?
Splash! The father fell headfirst into the jar. He was not hurt.
Where is Father? Tap the jar eight times and count the fathers!
Tap the jar eight times! Count the fathers.
One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight fathers! There were eight of them.
I am the real father! No, I am the real one! Each one insisted he was the real father.
I am hungry! Give me food! The rich man ran around with a tray.
The rich man was worn out and shouted. It is all because of this jar! Stop!
Crash! The jar broke. Seven fathers vanished, and only the real father was left.
Father, I am sorry. I was greedy, and it made a big mess.
The rich man went to the farmer and said sorry. He decided to share what he had with the village. Let us have a party together!
Thank you, everyone! They all sat together and ate happily.
Tap the farmer! Hooray, everyone!
Sharing makes joy grow. And that is how the story of the magic jar ended.
Tap the farmer! Dig with the hoe.

read_en.text: The farmer and his wife stayed beside the jar in the yard.
read_en.key: 농부와 아내는 마당의 항아리 곁에 그대로 있었어요.

read_en.text: Shall we try putting something else in? said the farmer with a big grin.
read_en.key: "이번에는 다른 것도 넣어 볼까?" 농부가 싱글벙글 웃으며 말했어요.

read_en.text: This time they dropped in one coin. Whoosh! Coins poured out.
read_en.key: 이번에는 엽전 하나를 넣어 봤어요. 와르르! 엽전이 쏟아져 나왔어요.

read_en.text: Jingle, jingle! The coins rolled round and round across the yard.
read_en.key: 짤랑짤랑, 엽전이 마당에 데굴데굴 굴렀어요.

read_en.text: One, two, three, four, five coins! Now they could buy rice and clothes.
read_en.key: 엽전이 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯! 이제 쌀도 사고 옷도 살 수 있어요.

read_en.text: The farmer and his wife looked at each other and laughed, ha-ha, ho-ho.
read_en.key: 농부와 아내는 서로 마주 보고 하하 호호 웃었어요.

read_en.text: With the extra coins, the farmer bought rice for his neighbors.
read_en.key: 농부는 늘어난 돈으로 이웃에게 줄 쌀을 샀어요.

read_en.text: The kind farmer did not keep it all for himself. He went to share rice with five neighbors.
read_en.key: 착한 농부는 혼자만 쓰지 않았어요. 이웃 다섯 집에 쌀을 나눠 주러 갔어요.

read_en.text: The farmer slung the rice sacks over his shoulder and tramped, tromp-tromp, from house to house.
read_en.key: 농부는 쌀자루를 둘러메고 뚜벅뚜벅 이 집 저 집 찾아갔어요.

read_en.text: From every house came the words, Thank you, farmer!
read_en.key: 집집마다 "고마워요, 농부님!" 하는 소리가 들렸어요.

read_en.text: All five houses got rice and smiled wide. The whole village was happy.
read_en.key: 다섯 집 모두 쌀을 받고 활짝 웃었어요. 마을이 함께 행복해졌어요.

read_en.text: The children hopped up and down, and even the puppy barked, woof-woof, with joy.
read_en.key: 아이들은 깡충깡충 뛰고, 강아지도 멍멍 짖으며 좋아했어요.

read_en.text: But in that village there also lived a rich man whose greed was as big as a mountain.
read_en.key: 그런데 마을에는 욕심이 산더미 같은 부자가 살고 있었어요.

read_en.text: The farmer went to the rich man’s gate.
read_en.key: 농부가 부잣집 대문 앞으로 찾아갔어요.

read_en.text: A rich man heard the news and called the farmer. Lend me that jar!
read_en.key: 소문을 들은 부잣집 주인이 농부를 불렀어요. "그 항아리를 나한테 빌려주게!"

read_en.text: The kind farmer said with a smile. Please use it, and bring it back!
read_en.key: 마음씨 착한 농부는 웃으며 말했어요. "필요하시면 쓰세요. 잘 쓰고 돌려주세요!"

read_en.text: Thank you! I will take it right away, hee hee. The rich man hugged the jar and ran off.
read_en.key: "고맙네! 얼른 가져가야지, 헤헤." 부자는 항아리를 꼭 안고 달려갔어요.

read_en.text: The rich man did not look back once. He ran home, huffing and puffing.
read_en.key: 부자는 뒤도 돌아보지 않고 헐레벌떡 집으로 내달렸어요.

read_en.text: The rich man put the jar in his room. If I put in a gold bar, I will get a mountain of gold!
read_en.key: 부자는 방에 항아리를 놓고 말했어요. "금덩이를 넣으면 금이 산더미가 되겠지!"

read_en.text: The rich man dropped gold bars into the jar, one, then another, plop, plop.
read_en.key: 부자는 금덩이를 하나, 또 하나, 퐁당퐁당 항아리에 넣었어요.

read_en.text: Gold bars tumbled out! The rich man was buried in a pile of gold. Help me!
read_en.key: 금덩이가 와르르! 부자는 금 더미에 폭 파묻혔어요. "사람 살려~"

read_en.text: The rich man flailed his arms and legs, wriggle-wriggle, and just barely crawled out, huffing and puffing.
read_en.key: 부자는 팔다리를 버둥버둥, 낑낑대며 겨우겨우 기어 나왔어요.

read_en.text: Pop! The rich man got out. He was not hurt.
read_en.key: 쏙! 부자가 빠져나왔어요. 다치지는 않았어요.

read_en.text: Hearing the noise, the rich man’s father came into the room.
read_en.key: 소동을 듣고 부자의 아버지가 방으로 들어왔어요.

read_en.text: Then the rich man's father came and peeked into the jar. What is this?
read_en.key: 그때 부자의 아버지가 다가와 항아리 속을 들여다보았어요. "이게 뭐냐?"

read_en.text: Father stood on his tiptoes to peek inside, wobbling this way and that.
read_en.key: 아버지는 항아리 속을 들여다보려고 발꿈치를 들고 기우뚱기우뚱했어요.

read_en.text: Splash! The father fell headfirst into the jar. He was not hurt.
read_en.key: 풍덩! 아버지가 항아리에 거꾸로 쏙 빠졌어요. 다치지는 않았어요.

read_en.text: Where is Father?
read_en.key: "아버지가 어디 계시지?"

read_en.text: Then out of the jar popped Father, pop, and another, pop, again and again.
read_en.key: 그러자 항아리에서 아버지가 쑥, 또 쑥, 자꾸자꾸 나왔어요.

read_en.text: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight fathers! There were eight of them.
read_en.key: 아버지가 하나, 둘, 셋, 넷, 다섯, 여섯, 일곱, 여덟! 여덟 명이나 되었어요.

read_en.text: I am the real father! No, I am the real one! Each one insisted he was the real father.
read_en.key: "내가 진짜 아버지다!" "아니야, 내가 진짜야!" 모두 서로 자기가 진짜라고 우겼어요.

read_en.text: I am hungry! Give me food! The rich man ran around with a tray.
read_en.key: "배고프다! 밥 줘라!" 부자는 쟁반을 들고 이리저리 뛰어다녔어요.

read_en.text: In the rich man’s room, he was still carrying food to the fathers.
read_en.key: 부잣집 방 안에서 부자는 아직도 밥을 나르고 있었어요.

read_en.text: Eight fathers bustled about all together, chattering and clattering.
read_en.key: 아버지 여덟 명이 우르르 몰려다니며 왁자지껄 떠들었어요.

read_en.text: The rich man was worn out and shouted. It is all because of this jar! Stop!
read_en.key: 부자는 지쳐서 외쳤어요. "이게 다 항아리 때문이야! 이제 그만!"

read_en.text: The rich man lifted the jar high up over his head.
read_en.key: 부자는 항아리를 번쩍 들어 올렸어요.

read_en.text: The rich man brought the jar down on the floor.
read_en.key: 부자는 항아리를 바닥에 내리쳤어요.

read_en.text: Crash! The jar broke. Seven fathers vanished, and only the real father was left.
read_en.key: 쨍그랑! 항아리가 깨지자 일곱 명은 사라지고, 진짜 아버지만 남았어요.

read_en.text: Suddenly the room fell silent. The rich man hung his head low.
read_en.key: 방 안이 갑자기 조용해졌어요. 부자는 고개를 푹 숙였어요.

read_en.text: Father, I am sorry. I was greedy, and it made a big mess.
read_en.key: "아버지, 죄송해요. 욕심을 부려서 소동이 났어요."

read_en.text: Father gave the rich man's shoulder a gentle pat, pat.
read_en.key: 아버지는 부자의 어깨를 토닥토닥 두드려 주었어요.

read_en.text: After all the fuss, the rich man went to the farmer’s home.
read_en.key: 소동이 끝난 뒤, 부자는 농부네 집으로 갔어요.

read_en.text: The rich man went to the farmer and said sorry. He decided to share what he had with the village. Let us have a party together!
read_en.key: 부자는 농부를 찾아가 사과하고, 가진 것을 마을 사람들과 나누기로 했어요. 함께 잔치를 열어요!

read_en.text: Tables were set in the yard, and a yummy smell drifted through the air.
read_en.key: 마당에 상이 차려지고, 맛있는 냄새가 솔솔 풍겼어요.

read_en.text: The jar may be broken, but now we all share, and that is what matters, said the farmer with a gentle smile.
read_en.key: "항아리는 깨졌지만, 함께 나누게 되었으니 됐어요." 농부가 빙그레 웃었어요.

read_en.text: Thank you, everyone! They all sat together and ate happily.
read_en.key: "모두 고맙네!" 모두 둘러앉아 맛있게 먹었어요.

read_en.text: Yum-yum, munch-munch! The laughter rang out all the way to the edge of the village.
read_en.key: 냠냠, 쩝쩝! 웃음소리가 마을 끝까지 울려 퍼졌어요.

read_en.text: Sharing makes joy grow. And that is how the story of the magic jar ended.
read_en.key: 나누면 기쁨이 커져요. 요술 항아리 이야기는 이렇게 끝났어요.

ko.text: 옛날 옛날, 마음씨 고운 선비가 과거를 보러 먼 길을 떠났어요.
저벅저벅. 산 넘고 물 건너, 선비는 깊은 산속으로 들어갔어요.
큰 소나무 위 둥지에 아기 까치들이 있어요. 그런데 구렁이가 스르르 올라가고 있어요!
안 돼! 내가 아기 까치들을 지켜 줄게.
선비가 활을 꺼냈어요. 선비를 톡 눌러 봐요.
쉬익, 탁! 화살이 구렁이 바로 옆 나무에 꽂혔어요.
깜짝 놀란 구렁이는 스르르 숲으로 달아났어요.
둥지 안에서 아기 까치들이 고개를 쏙 내밀었어요.
아기 까치가 몇 마리일까요? 맞는 숫자를 골라요.
선비는 빙긋 웃으며 다시 길을 떠났어요.
오늘 밤은 어디서 자지? …어, 저기 불빛이!
깊은 산속 외딴집에서 한 여인이 나왔어요.
어서 오세요, 나그네님. 하룻밤 쉬어 가세요.
선비는 따뜻한 방에서 금세 잠이 들었어요.
한밤중, 선비는 으스스한 기운에 눈을 떴어요.
문 앞에 그 여인이 서 있었어요. 그런데… 치마 밑으로 꼬리가 삐죽!
나는 낮에 네가 활로 쫓아낸, 그 구렁이의 아내다.
내 남편을 놀라게 한 벌로, 너를 이대로 보내 줄 수는 없어.
저는 그저 아기 까치들을 지키려 했을 뿐이에요. 제발 보내 주세요.
좋아. 새벽이 오기 전에 저 산 위 절의 종이 세 번 울리면, 너를 놓아주마.
하지만 이 깊은 밤에, 누가 종을 치겠니? 후후…
그때, 큰 소나무 둥지의 까치 가족은 잠들지 못하고 있었어요.
여보, 선비님이 큰일 났어요! 외딴집의 구렁이 아내가…
종! 절의 종을 울리면 돼요. 우리가 날아가요!
까치 엄마 아빠와 숲속 까치 친구들이 밤하늘로 날아올랐어요.
달빛을 가르며, 산 위 절을 향해 쌩쌩!
절은 고요했어요. 커다란 종이 달빛 아래 걸려 있었어요.
종을 쳐야 해. 우리 머리로, 온 힘을 다해!
댕—. 깊고 큰 종소리가 산을 넘어 퍼져 갔어요.
까치들은 온 힘을 다해 종을 울렸어요.
그리고 힘이 다 빠진 까치들은, 종 아래에 스르르 쓰러져 잠이 들었어요.
여인은 스르르 구렁이로 변하더니, 새벽 숲으로 사라졌어요.
종소리… 누가 종을 울렸을까? 가 봐야겠어!
종 아래에, 까치 엄마 아빠가 눈을 감은 채 누워 있었어요.
선비는 까치들을 품에 안고, 시원한 물을 한 모금씩 먹여 주었어요.
그때 아기 까치들이 짹짹 울며 날아왔어요.
고마워, 까치들아. 너희 마음, 평생 잊지 않을게.
은혜를 잊지 않고 갚는 마음은, 이렇게 따뜻해요.

en.text: Once upon a time, a kind young scholar set off on a long journey to take the royal exam.
Step, step. Over hills and across streams, the scholar walked deep into the mountains.
Caw, caw! Please help us!
High in the big pine tree was a nest of baby magpies. And a big snake was slithering up toward it!
Oh no! I will keep the baby magpies safe.
The scholar took out his bow. Tap the scholar.
Whoosh, thunk! The arrow struck the tree right beside the snake.
The startled snake slithered away into the forest.
Thank you, kind scholar! We will repay your kindness, we promise.
The baby magpies popped their heads up out of the nest.
How many baby magpies are there? Pick the right number.
That card says one. Let's count again.
That card says two. Let's count again.
That card says three. Let's count again.
That card says four. Let's count again.
That card says five. Let's count again.
That's right! One baby magpie.
That's right! Two baby magpies.
That's right! Three baby magpies.
That's right! Four baby magpies.
That's right! Five baby magpies.
Chirp chirp! Thank you, scholar!
The scholar smiled and went on his way.
Soon the sun went down, and the mountain path grew dark.
Where will I sleep tonight? ...Oh, a light over there!
A woman came out of a lonely house deep in the mountains.
Welcome, traveler. Come in and rest for the night.
Thank you. Just for one night, if I may.
In the warm room, the scholar soon fell asleep.
In the middle of the night, the scholar woke with a shiver.
The woman was standing by the door. But... a tail was peeking out from under her skirt!
I am the wife of the snake you chased away with your arrow today.
You frightened my husband. I cannot let you go just like that.
I only wanted to protect the baby magpies. Please, let me go.
Very well. If the temple bell on the mountain rings three times before dawn, I will let you go.
But in the deep of night, who would ring the bell? Hmm hmm...
The bell... the bell has to ring. What can I do...
Meanwhile, in the nest in the big pine tree, the magpie family could not sleep.
Dear, the scholar is in danger! The snake's wife at the lonely house...
The bell! We just have to ring the temple bell. Let's fly!
Little ones, wait right here in the nest.
Mama and Papa Magpie and their magpie friends rose into the night sky.
Through the moonlight, swish, swish, toward the temple on the mountain!
The temple was silent. A great bell hung in the moonlight.
We must strike the bell. With our heads, with all our might!
Tap the bell.
Dong... The deep, great sound of the bell rolled over the mountains.
Dong... The second ring.
Dong... The third ring sounded.
The magpies had rung the bell with all their might.
And then, with no strength left, the magpies sank down beneath the bell and fell asleep.
From far away came the sound of the bell.
The bell... it rang. One, two, three.
A promise is a promise. I will let you go.
The woman turned back into a snake and slipped away into the dawn forest.
The bell... who could have rung it? I must go and see!
The scholar ran up to the temple on the mountain.
Beneath the bell, Mama and Papa Magpie lay with their eyes closed.
Magpies... it was you. You did this to save me...
The scholar held the magpies gently and gave them each a sip of cool water.
Scholar... you are safe.
We have repaid your kindness. That is enough.
Just then, the baby magpies came flying, chirping all the way.
Mama! Papa!
Tap the scholar.
Thank you, magpies. I will never forget what you did for me.
A heart that remembers kindness and gives it back is as warm as this.

read_en.text: Step, step. Over hills and across streams, the scholar walked deep into the mountains.
read_en.key: 저벅저벅. 산 넘고 물 건너, 선비는 깊은 산속으로 들어갔어요.

read_en.text: The trees grew thick, and the tweet-tweet of birds came closer and closer.
read_en.key: 나무가 빽빽해지고, 짹짹 새소리가 점점 가까워졌어요.

read_en.text: Then, from somewhere, came a frantic caw-caw, the cry of a magpie.
read_en.key: 그때 어디선가 까악까악, 다급한 까치 소리가 들렸어요.

read_en.text: The scholar followed the cries and ran to a big pine tree.
read_en.key: 선비가 소리를 따라 큰 소나무 아래로 달려갔어요.

read_en.text: Up at the nest, Mother Magpie called out in a hurry.
read_en.key: 둥지 위에서 엄마 까치가 다급하게 외쳤어요.

read_en.text: Caw, caw! Please help us!
read_en.key: 까악, 까악! 도와주세요!

read_en.text: High in the big pine tree was a nest of baby magpies. And a big snake was slithering up toward it!
read_en.key: 큰 소나무 위 둥지에 아기 까치들이 있어요. 그런데 구렁이가 스르르 올라가고 있어요!

read_en.text: Mama Magpie guarded the nest, while Papa Magpie circled round and round it, crying out.
read_en.key: 엄마 까치는 둥지를 지키고, 아빠 까치는 둥지 둘레를 빙빙 돌며 울었어요.

read_en.text: Oh no! I will keep the baby magpies safe.
read_en.key: 안 돼! 내가 아기 까치들을 지켜 줄게.

read_en.text: The scholar took out his bow.
read_en.key: 선비가 활을 꺼냈어요.

read_en.text: The scholar took a deep breath, whoo, and pulled the bowstring back, tight, tight.
read_en.key: 선비는 후우 숨을 고르고, 활시위를 팽팽 당겼어요.

read_en.text: Whoosh, thunk! The arrow struck the tree right beside the snake.
read_en.key: 쉬익, 탁! 화살이 구렁이 바로 옆 나무에 꽂혔어요.

read_en.text: The startled snake slithered away into the forest.
read_en.key: 깜짝 놀란 구렁이는 스르르 숲으로 달아났어요.

read_en.text: The scholar lowered his bow and let out a long, deep breath.
read_en.key: 선비는 활을 내려놓고, 후유 하고 긴 숨을 쉬었어요.

read_en.text: Feeling safe, the two magpies spoke to the scholar.
read_en.key: 안심한 까치 부부가 선비에게 말했어요.

read_en.text: Thank you, kind scholar! We will repay your kindness, we promise.
read_en.key: 고맙습니다, 선비님! 이 은혜는 꼭 갚을게요.

read_en.text: The magpie couple fluttered down, flap-flap, and bowed their heads low.
read_en.key: 까치 부부는 포르르 날아 내려와 고개를 꾸벅 숙였어요.

read_en.text: Before leaving, the scholar looked up at the nest in the pine tree.
read_en.key: 선비가 떠나기 전, 소나무 위 둥지를 올려다봤어요.

read_en.text: The baby magpies popped their heads up out of the nest.
read_en.key: 둥지 안에서 아기 까치들이 고개를 쏙 내밀었어요.

read_en.text: The baby magpies opened their little yellow beaks and sang, chirp, chirp.
read_en.key: 노란 부리를 벌리고, 아기 까치들이 짹짹 노래했어요.

read_en.text: Chirp chirp! Thank you, scholar!
read_en.key: 짹짹! 선비님, 고맙습니다!

read_en.text: Mama Magpie wrapped her babies snugly under her wings.
read_en.key: 엄마 까치는 아기들을 날개로 폭 감싸 주었어요.

read_en.text: The scholar looked at the baby magpies and smiled a gentle smile.
read_en.key: 선비는 아기 까치들을 보며 빙그레 웃었어요.

read_en.text: The scholar smiled and went on his way.
read_en.key: 선비는 빙긋 웃으며 다시 길을 떠났어요.

read_en.text: Step, step, the scholar walked away, and the magpie family watched him for a long, long time.
read_en.key: 선비는 저벅저벅 걸어가고, 까치 가족은 오래오래 바라보았어요.

read_en.text: Soon the sun went down, and the mountain path grew dark.
read_en.key: 어느새 해가 지고, 산길은 캄캄해졌어요.

read_en.text: The wind went whoosh, the leaves went rustle-rustle, and the scholar felt a little bit scared.
read_en.key: 바람이 쏴아 불고, 나뭇잎이 바스락바스락, 선비는 조금 무서웠어요.

read_en.text: Where will I sleep tonight? ...Oh, a light over there!
read_en.key: 오늘 밤은 어디서 자지? …어, 저기 불빛이!

read_en.text: Following the light, the scholar reached a lonely house.
read_en.key: 선비는 불빛을 따라 외딴집 앞에 도착했어요.

read_en.text: A woman came out of a lonely house deep in the mountains.
read_en.key: 깊은 산속 외딴집에서 한 여인이 나왔어요.

read_en.text: Welcome, traveler. Come in and rest for the night.
read_en.key: 어서 오세요, 나그네님. 하룻밤 쉬어 가세요.

read_en.text: Thank you. Just for one night, if I may.
read_en.key: 고맙습니다. 하룻밤만 신세 질게요.

read_en.text: In the warm room, the scholar soon fell asleep.
read_en.key: 선비는 따뜻한 방에서 금세 잠이 들었어요.

read_en.text: Even in his dreams, the baby magpies were chirping and laughing.
read_en.key: 꿈속에서도 아기 까치들이 짹짹 웃고 있었지요.

read_en.text: In the middle of the night, the scholar woke with a shiver.
read_en.key: 한밤중, 선비는 으스스한 기운에 눈을 떴어요.

read_en.text: The room was silent, and only the moonlight flickered, soft and faint, through the paper door.
read_en.key: 방 안은 조용하고, 창호문 너머로 달빛만 어른어른 비쳤어요.

read_en.text: The woman was standing by the door. But... a tail was peeking out from under her skirt!
read_en.key: 문 앞에 그 여인이 서 있었어요. 그런데… 치마 밑으로 꼬리가 삐죽!

read_en.text: I am the wife of the snake you chased away with your arrow today.
read_en.key: 나는 낮에 네가 활로 쫓아낸, 그 구렁이의 아내다.

read_en.text: You frightened my husband. I cannot let you go just like that.
read_en.key: 내 남편을 놀라게 한 벌로, 너를 이대로 보내 줄 수는 없어.

read_en.text: I only wanted to protect the baby magpies. Please, let me go.
read_en.key: 저는 그저 아기 까치들을 지키려 했을 뿐이에요. 제발 보내 주세요.

read_en.text: Very well. If the temple bell on the mountain rings three times before dawn, I will let you go.
read_en.key: 좋아. 새벽이 오기 전에 저 산 위 절의 종이 세 번 울리면, 너를 놓아주마.

read_en.text: But in the deep of night, who would ring the bell? Hmm hmm...
read_en.key: 하지만 이 깊은 밤에, 누가 종을 치겠니? 후후…

read_en.text: The bell... the bell has to ring. What can I do...
read_en.key: 종소리… 종이 울려야 해. 어떡하지…

read_en.text: The scholar hugged his knees, shivering, brr, and stared out at the pitch-dark night.
read_en.key: 선비는 무릎을 끌어안고 덜덜 떨며, 캄캄한 창밖만 바라보았어요.

read_en.text: That same night, shall we visit the nest in the pine tree?
read_en.key: 선비가 갇힌 그 밤, 소나무 둥지로 가 볼까요?

read_en.text: Meanwhile, in the nest in the big pine tree, the magpie family could not sleep.
read_en.key: 그때, 큰 소나무 둥지의 까치 가족은 잠들지 못하고 있었어요.

read_en.text: Dear, the scholar is in danger! The snake's wife at the lonely house...
read_en.key: 여보, 선비님이 큰일 났어요! 외딴집의 구렁이 아내가…

read_en.text: The bell! We just have to ring the temple bell. Let's fly!
read_en.key: 종! 절의 종을 울리면 돼요. 우리가 날아가요!

read_en.text: Little ones, wait right here in the nest.
read_en.key: 아기들아, 둥지에서 꼭 기다리렴.

read_en.text: The baby magpies snuggled close together in the nest and nodded, nod-nod, their little heads.
read_en.key: 아기 까치들은 둥지 안에서 몸을 꼭 붙이고 고개를 끄덕끄덕했어요.

read_en.text: Mama and Papa Magpie and their magpie friends rose into the night sky.
read_en.key: 까치 엄마 아빠와 숲속 까치 친구들이 밤하늘로 날아올랐어요.

read_en.text: The moon lit the way for the magpies, and the stars went twinkle, twinkle.
read_en.key: 달님이 까치들의 길을 환하게 비추고, 별들이 반짝반짝 빛났어요.

read_en.text: Through the moonlight, swish, swish, toward the temple on the mountain!
read_en.key: 달빛을 가르며, 산 위 절을 향해 쌩쌩!

read_en.text: The temple was silent. A great bell hung in the moonlight.
read_en.key: 절은 고요했어요. 커다란 종이 달빛 아래 걸려 있었어요.

read_en.text: At the bell, Father Magpie spoke.
read_en.key: 종 앞에 도착한 아빠 까치가 말했어요.

read_en.text: We must strike the bell. With our heads, with all our might!
read_en.key: 종을 쳐야 해. 우리 머리로, 온 힘을 다해!

read_en.text: Mama and Papa Magpie looked at each other, spread their wings wide, and flew, flap-flap!
read_en.key: 엄마 까치와 아빠 까치는 서로를 바라보고, 날개를 활짝 펴고 푸드덕 날았어요.

read_en.text: The magpies struck the bell hard with their heads.
read_en.key: 까치들이 머리로 종을 힘껏 쳤어요.

read_en.text: Dong... The deep, great sound of the bell rolled over the mountains.
read_en.key: 댕—. 깊고 큰 종소리가 산을 넘어 퍼져 갔어요.

read_en.text: Dong... The second ring.
read_en.key: 댕—. 두 번째 종소리.

read_en.text: Dong... The third ring sounded.
read_en.key: 댕—. 세 번째 종소리가 울렸어요.

read_en.text: The magpies had rung the bell with all their might.
read_en.key: 까치들은 온 힘을 다해 종을 울렸어요.

read_en.text: And then, with no strength left, the magpies sank down beneath the bell and fell asleep.
read_en.key: 그리고 힘이 다 빠진 까치들은, 종 아래에 스르르 쓰러져 잠이 들었어요.

read_en.text: The moonlight wrapped the magpies, sleeping softly, in its gentle glow.
read_en.key: 달빛이 새근새근 잠든 까치들을 포근히 감싸 주었어요.

read_en.text: While the magpies rang the bell, the scholar was in the lonely house.
read_en.key: 까치들이 종을 울리는 동안, 선비는 외딴집 방 안에 있었어요.

read_en.text: From far away came the sound of the bell.
read_en.key: 멀리서 종소리가 들려왔어요.

read_en.text: The bell... it rang. One, two, three.
read_en.key: 종이… 울렸어. 하나, 둘, 셋.

read_en.text: The woman let out a long sigh, whoo, and her voice grew just a little softer.
read_en.key: 여인은 후우 한숨을 쉬었고, 목소리가 조금 부드러워졌어요.

read_en.text: A promise is a promise. I will let you go.
read_en.key: 약속은 약속. 너를 놓아주마.

read_en.text: The woman turned back into a snake and slipped away into the dawn forest.
read_en.key: 여인은 스르르 구렁이로 변하더니, 새벽 숲으로 사라졌어요.

read_en.text: Outside, the sky slowly grew light, and the birds began to sing, tweet-tweet.
read_en.key: 창밖이 조금씩 환해지고, 새들이 짹짹 지저귀기 시작했어요.

read_en.text: The bell... who could have rung it? I must go and see!
read_en.key: 종소리… 누가 종을 울렸을까? 가 봐야겠어!

read_en.text: The scholar ran up to the temple on the mountain.
read_en.key: 선비는 산 위 절로 달려갔어요.

read_en.text: At the temple, the scholar went up to the bell.
read_en.key: 절에 도착한 선비가 종 아래로 다가갔어요.

read_en.text: Beneath the bell, Mama and Papa Magpie lay with their eyes closed.
read_en.key: 종 아래에, 까치 엄마 아빠가 눈을 감은 채 누워 있었어요.

read_en.text: The scholar's breath caught in his throat, and he stopped right where he stood.
read_en.key: 선비는 숨이 턱 막혀, 그 자리에 우뚝 멈춰 섰어요.

read_en.text: Magpies... it was you. You did this to save me...
read_en.key: 까치야… 너희였구나. 나를 구하려고…

read_en.text: The scholar held the magpies gently and gave them each a sip of cool water.
read_en.key: 선비는 까치들을 품에 안고, 시원한 물을 한 모금씩 먹여 주었어요.

read_en.text: The magpies' wings gave a little flutter, and slowly, they opened their eyes.
read_en.key: 까치들의 날개가 파르르 떨리더니, 살며시 눈을 떴어요.

read_en.text: Below the temple bell, Mother Magpie looked up at the scholar.
read_en.key: 절의 종 아래에서 엄마 까치가 선비를 올려다보았어요.

read_en.text: Scholar... you are safe.
read_en.key: 선비님… 무사하셨군요.

read_en.text: We have repaid your kindness. That is enough.
read_en.key: 은혜를 갚았으니, 이제 됐어요.

read_en.text: I am so glad that you are both safe.
read_en.key: "너희가 무사해서 정말 다행이야."

read_en.text: Just then, the baby magpies came flying, chirping all the way.
read_en.key: 그때 아기 까치들이 짹짹 울며 날아왔어요.

read_en.text: Mama! Papa!
read_en.key: 엄마! 아빠!

read_en.text: The scholar looked at the magpie family and laughed, ha-ha, with a big, bright smile.
read_en.key: 선비는 까치 가족을 보며 하하 환하게 웃었어요.

read_en.text: Thank you, magpies. I will never forget what you did for me.
read_en.key: 고마워, 까치들아. 너희 마음, 평생 잊지 않을게.

read_en.text: A heart that remembers kindness and gives it back is as warm as this.
read_en.key: 은혜를 잊지 않고 갚는 마음은, 이렇게 따뜻해요.

ko.text: 옛날 옛날, 깊은 산골에 팥죽을 아주 잘 쑤는 할멈이 살았어요.
드디어 동짓날이 되었어요. 할멈은 팥죽을 쑤면서 훌쩍훌쩍 울었어요.
깜깜한 밤이 되었어요. 어흥! 호랑이가 어슬렁어슬렁 찾아왔어요!
알밤이 아궁이에서 톡! 튀어나와 호랑이 눈을 딱 때렸어요!
알밤이 톡 튀어나왔지만, 호랑이는 아궁이 앞에 없었어요!
물독 속 자라가 호랑이 입을 앙! 물었어요!
자라가 물독에서 두리번두리번… 호랑이 얼굴이 없네요!
송곳이 콕! 찔렀지만, 호랑이는 저쪽에 있네요.
절구가 문 위에서 쿵! 호랑이 머리 위로 떨어졌어요!
절구가 쿵! 떨어졌지만 호랑이를 못 맞혔어요!
지게가 호랑이를 번쩍 지고 가서 바다에 풍덩! 던져 버렸어요!
지게가 낑낑… 힘센 호랑이를 들 수가 없어요!
미끌! 호랑이가 꽈당 넘어졌어요. 이번엔 누구일까요?
쿵! 절구에 맞은 호랑이가 마당으로 도망쳐 쭉 뻗어 버렸어요. 이제 누구 차례죠?
돌돌돌! 호랑이가 멍석에 꽁꽁 말렸어요. 마지막은 누구일까요?
만세! 호랑이를 물리쳤어요! 할멈은 친구들과 맛있는 팥죽을 나누어 먹었답니다.
호랑이는 아궁이 앞에 있어요. 아궁이 속에 누가 숨었지?
호랑이가 물독에 얼굴을 넣었어요. 물독 속에 누가 숨었지?
호랑이가 부엌 바닥으로 뒷걸음질! 바닥에 납작 숨은 친구는 누구지?
호랑이가 바닥에 꽈당 넘어졌어요. 바닥 틈에 뾰족 숨은 친구는 누구지?
호랑이는 문 앞에 있어요. 문 위에 누가 숨었지?
호랑이가 마당에 쭉 뻗었어요. 마당에 돌돌 말려 숨은 친구는 누구지?
호랑이가 멍석에 꽁꽁 말렸어요. 담벼락에 기대 숨은 친구는 누구지?

en.text: Once upon a time, deep in the mountains, there lived an old grandma who made the yummiest red bean porridge.
Roar! One day, a big tiger appeared. Grandma, I'm going to eat you up!
Tiger, on the longest night of the year, I'll cook you some yummy red bean porridge. Please wait until then. The tiger prowled away, slow and heavy.
At last, the longest night came. Grandma cooked the porridge, and she sniffled and cried.
It was a dark, dark night. Roar! The tiger came prowling back!
Friends, help me! Tap your friends, one after another, to give that tiger a lesson!
Roll, roll, roll! Chestnut came rolling in. Grandma, give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help you! Chestnut ate the porridge, then hid deep inside the hot fireplace.
Chestnut popped out of the fireplace — pop! — and bonked the tiger right in the eye!
Chestnut popped out — pop! — but the tiger wasn't by the fireplace!
Slow and steady! Turtle came crawling in. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too! Turtle ate the porridge, then slipped into the water jar to hide.
Turtle, hiding in the water jar, bit the tiger's mouth — chomp!
Turtle peeked out of the water jar, looking this way and that... no tiger face in sight!
Splat! Cow Plop arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too! Cow Plop ate the porridge, then lay flat on the kitchen floor to hide.
The tiger stepped on Cow Plop and slip-slid-slipped away!
The tiger hopped right over Cow Plop!
Poke, poke! Awl arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Awl ate the porridge, then hid, pointy and still, in a crack in the floor.
Awl gave the tiger's bottom a poke!
Awl poked — poke! — but the tiger was over there.
Thump-a-thump! Mortar arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Mortar ate the porridge, then climbed up above the door to hide.

read_en.text: In a trembling voice, Grandma said,
read_en.key: 할멈은 떨리는 목소리로 말했어요.

read_en.text: Tiger, on the longest night of the year, I'll cook you some yummy red bean porridge. Please wait until then. The tiger prowled away, slow and heavy.
read_en.key: "호랑이야, 동짓날에 맛있는 팥죽을 쑤어 줄게. 그때까지 기다려 다오." 호랑이는 어슬렁어슬렁 돌아갔어요.

read_en.text: Grandma stared down the mountain path long after the tiger was gone.
read_en.key: 할멈은 호랑이가 사라진 산길을 한참 바라보았어요.

read_en.text: Soon, winter came with a chilly whoosh of wind.
read_en.key: 어느덧 찬바람 부는 겨울이 왔어요.

read_en.text: At last, the longest night came. Grandma cooked the porridge, and she sniffled and cried.
read_en.key: 드디어 동짓날이 되었어요. 할멈은 팥죽을 쑤면서 훌쩍훌쩍 울었어요.

read_en.text: That winter evening, Granny was in her kitchen at home.
read_en.key: 동짓날 저녁, 할멈은 집 안 부엌에 있었어요.

read_en.text: Bubble, bubble. The sweet, nutty smell of porridge filled the whole kitchen.
read_en.key: 보글보글, 구수한 팥죽 냄새가 부엌에 가득했지요.

read_en.text: What will I do when the tiger comes tonight?
read_en.key: "오늘 밤 호랑이가 오면 나는 어떡하지."

read_en.text: Just then, a tiny sound came from outside the kitchen door.
read_en.key: 그때 부엌문 밖에서 작은 소리가 들렸어요.

read_en.text: Roll, roll, roll! Chestnut came rolling in. Grandma, give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help you! Chestnut ate the porridge, then hid deep inside the hot fireplace.
read_en.key: 데굴데굴~ 알밤이 굴러왔어요. "할멈, 팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 알밤은 팥죽을 얻어먹고 뜨거운 아궁이 속에 쏙 숨었어요.

read_en.text: Slow and steady! Turtle came crawling in. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too! Turtle ate the porridge, then slipped into the water jar to hide.
read_en.key: 엉금엉금~ 자라가 기어왔어요. "나도 팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 자라는 팥죽을 얻어먹고 물독 속에 퐁당 숨었어요.

read_en.text: More friends came to the kitchen where Chestnut and Turtle were hiding.
read_en.key: 알밤과 자라가 숨은 부엌으로 또 친구들이 왔어요.

read_en.text: Splat! Cow Plop arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too! Cow Plop ate the porridge, then lay flat on the kitchen floor to hide.
read_en.key: 철퍼덕! 쇠똥이 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 나도 도울게!" 쇠똥은 팥죽을 얻어먹고 부엌 바닥에 납작 엎드려 숨었어요.

read_en.text: Poke, poke! Awl arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Awl ate the porridge, then hid, pointy and still, in a crack in the floor.
read_en.key: 콕콕! 송곳이 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 송곳은 팥죽을 얻어먹고 바닥 틈에 뾰족 숨었어요.

read_en.text: Thump-a-thump! Mortar arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Mortar ate the porridge, then climbed up above the door to hide.
read_en.key: 쿵더쿵! 절구가 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 절구는 팥죽을 얻어먹고 문 위로 올라가 숨었어요.

read_en.text: Scoop, scoop! With every bowl she gave her friends, Grandma felt a little braver.
read_en.key: 할멈은 친구들에게 팥죽을 듬뿍듬뿍 떠 주며 조금씩 힘이 났어요.

read_en.text: Granny stepped out of the kitchen to the doorway by the yard.
read_en.key: 할멈은 부엌에서 마당 쪽 문가로 나갔어요.

read_en.text: Knock, knock, knock! Out in the yard, more friends came to help.
read_en.key: 똑똑똑! 마당에도 친구들이 찾아왔어요.

read_en.text: Flap, flap! Straw Mat arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Straw Mat ate the porridge, then rolled up tight in the yard to hide.
read_en.key: 펄럭펄럭~ 멍석이 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 멍석은 팥죽을 얻어먹고 마당에 돌돌 말려 숨었어요.

read_en.text: Stomp, stomp! Carrier came striding in. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Carrier ate the porridge, then leaned against the garden wall to hide.
read_en.key: 성큼성큼! 지게가 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 지게는 팥죽을 얻어먹고 담벼락에 기대어 숨었어요.

read_en.text: Grandma wiped her tears and whispered, psst, psst, to her friends,
read_en.key: 할멈은 눈물을 닦고 친구들에게 소곤소곤 속삭였어요.

read_en.text: Friends, help me!
read_en.key: "얘들아, 도와줘!"

read_en.text: When the tiger comes, let us all work together.
read_en.key: "호랑이가 오면 모두 힘을 모아 주렴."

read_en.text: Granny went back into the kitchen to wait for Tiger with her friends.
read_en.key: 할멈은 다시 부엌으로 들어가 친구들과 호랑이를 기다렸어요.

read_en.text: It was a dark, dark night. Roar! The tiger came prowling back!
read_en.key: 깜깜한 밤이 되었어요. 어흥! 호랑이가 어슬렁어슬렁 찾아왔어요!

read_en.text: Grandma, I am here, just like I promised. First the porridge, and then I will eat you up!
read_en.key: "할멈, 약속대로 왔다. 팥죽을 먹고 나서 너를 잡아먹겠다!"

read_en.text: Tiger, before we eat the porridge, please watch the fire for me. At Grandma's words, the tiger squatted down by the fireplace.
read_en.key: "호랑아, 팥죽 먹기 전에 아궁이 불 좀 봐주렴." 할멈의 말에 호랑이가 아궁이 앞에 쪼그려 앉았어요.

read_en.text: Granny tiptoed back into a corner of the kitchen.
read_en.key: 할멈은 부엌 구석으로 살금살금 물러났어요.

read_en.text: Chestnut popped out of the fireplace — pop! — and bonked the tiger right in the eye!
read_en.key: 알밤이 아궁이에서 톡! 튀어나와 호랑이 눈을 딱 때렸어요!

read_en.text: Ow, hot! My eyes! The tiger dunked its face into the water jar to wash its eyes.
read_en.key: "앗, 뜨거워! 눈이야!" 호랑이가 눈을 씻으려고 물독에 얼굴을 쏙 넣었어요.

read_en.text: Turtle, hiding in the water jar, bit the tiger's mouth — chomp!
read_en.key: 물독 속 자라가 호랑이 입을 앙! 물었어요!

read_en.text: Tiger shivered in the kitchen after dipping his mouth into the water jar.
read_en.key: 물독에 입을 넣었던 호랑이가 부엌에서 몸을 부르르 떨었어요.

read_en.text: Yowch! The tiger jumped in surprise and stumbled backward.
read_en.key: "아야야!" 호랑이가 깜짝 놀라 뒷걸음질을 쳤어요.

read_en.text: The tiger stepped on Cow Plop and slip-slid-slipped away!
read_en.key: 호랑이가 쇠똥을 밟고 쭈르륵~ 미끄러졌어요!

read_en.text: Slip! The tiger went crash — flat on the floor!
read_en.key: 미끌! 호랑이가 꽈당 넘어졌어요.

read_en.text: Awl gave the tiger's bottom a poke!
read_en.key: 송곳이 호랑이 엉덩이를 콕! 찔렀어요!

read_en.text: Boo-hoo, that hurts! The tiger ran away toward the door.
read_en.key: "엉엉, 아파!" 호랑이가 문 쪽으로 도망가요.

read_en.text: Mortar fell from above the door — thump! — right on the tiger's head!
read_en.key: 절구가 문 위에서 쿵! 호랑이 머리 위로 떨어졌어요!

read_en.text: Everything was spinning round and round, and the tiger wobbled on his feet.
read_en.key: 호랑이는 눈앞이 빙글빙글 돌아 비틀비틀 걸었어요.

read_en.text: Thump! Hit by the Mortar, the tiger ran out into the yard and stretched out flat.
read_en.key: 쿵! 절구에 맞은 호랑이가 마당으로 도망쳐 쭉 뻗어 버렸어요.

read_en.text: Straw Mat rolled the tiger up, round and round and round!
read_en.key: 멍석이 호랑이를 돌돌돌 말아 버렸어요!

read_en.text: Round and round! The tiger got rolled up tight in the Straw Mat.
read_en.key: 돌돌돌! 호랑이가 멍석에 꽁꽁 말렸어요.

read_en.text: Help! It is so tight in here! Let me out!
read_en.key: "으악, 답답해! 꺼내 줘!"

read_en.text: Carrier hoisted the tiger up, carried the tiger off, and — splash! — tossed the tiger into the sea!
read_en.key: 지게가 호랑이를 번쩍 지고 가서 바다에 풍덩! 던져 버렸어요!

read_en.text: The tiger paddled and splashed and swam far, far away. And he never came back to Grandma's house again.
read_en.key: 호랑이는 허우적허우적 헤엄쳐 멀리멀리 달아났어요. 다시는 할멈 집에 오지 않았답니다.

read_en.text: Once Tiger was gone, the friends gathered in the yard.
read_en.key: 호랑이가 떠나자 친구들이 마당으로 모였어요.

read_en.text: Hooray! The tiger was beaten! Grandma shared yummy red bean porridge with all her friends.
read_en.key: 만세! 호랑이를 물리쳤어요! 할멈은 친구들과 맛있는 팥죽을 나누어 먹었답니다.

read_en.text: Grandma hurried out, pitter-patter, and hugged her friends tight, squeeze!
read_en.key: 할멈은 마당으로 총총 나와 친구들을 꼬옥 안아 주었어요.

read_en.text: Thank you, my dear friends. You saved me.
read_en.key: "고맙다, 얘들아. 너희 덕분에 살았구나."

read_en.text: The chestnut, the turtle, the dung, the awl, the mortar, the mat and the carrier all went slurp, slurp, until their tummies were full.
read_en.key: 알밤도, 자라도, 쇠똥도, 송곳도, 절구도, 멍석도, 지게도 모두 후루룩 배불리 먹었지요.

read_en.text: When little friends work together, they can even send a great big tiger away.
read_en.key: 작은 친구들이 힘을 모으면 커다란 호랑이도 물리칠 수 있답니다.

ko.text: 옛날에 진짜 공주와 결혼하고 싶은 왕자가 있었어요.
왕자는 배를 타고 온 세상을 돌아다녔어요.
온 세상을 다 가 봤지만, 진짜 공주인지 알 수 없었어요.
그날 밤, 비가 쏟아지고 천둥이 우르릉!
비를 맞았지만 괜찮아요. 저는 진짜 공주예요!
왕비님은 손님방에 완두콩 한 알, 베개, 매트리스 한 장을 가져왔어요.
셋 중에서 제일 작은 것은 뭘까요? 눌러 봐요.
그건 베개예요. 더 작은 걸 찾아봐요.
그건 매트리스예요. 더 작은 걸 찾아봐요.
그럼 제일 큰 것은 뭘까요? 눌러 봐요.
그건 완두콩이에요. 더 큰 걸 찾아봐요.
그건 베개예요. 더 큰 걸 찾아봐요.
요 조그만 완두콩 한 알을 침대 판자에 톡. 아무도 못 본 척!
완두콩 위에 매트리스를 쌓아 볼까? 몇 장일까요? 톡 눌러 봐요.
열! 아직 더 있어요. 한 번 더 톡!
완두콩은 어디 있을까요? 탑의 위? 아래?
거긴 탑의 위예요. 완두콩은 맨 아래에 있어요. 아래를 눌러 봐요.
거긴 탑의 아래예요. 공주님은 맨 위에서 자요. 위를 눌러 봐요.
완두콩은 맨 아래, 공주님은 맨 위에서 자요.
밤이 깊었는데… 공주는 이리 뒤척, 저리 뒤척.
뭔가 딱딱한 게 있는 것 같아…
아니요, 솔직히 한숨도 못 잤어요. 뭔가 딱딱한 게 있어서 몸이 뻐근하고 졸려요.
매트리스 스무 장 아래 완두콩을 느끼다니! 진짜 공주로구나!

en.text: Once upon a time, there was a prince who wanted to marry a true princess.
Tap the boat.
The prince sailed all around the world on his boat.
I went all around the world, but I could never tell if a princess was a true princess.
That night, the rain poured down and the thunder went rumble, rumble!
Someone was knocking at the castle gate. Knock, knock.
Tap the gate.
Who could it be at this hour?
I got caught in the rain, but I'm all right. I am a true princess!
Come in, dear, and dry yourself off.
A true princess, hmm? Let's find out... just a little.
The queen brought one pea, a pillow and a mattress into the guest room.
Which of the three is the smallest? Tap it.
That's the pillow. Look for something smaller.
That's the mattress. Look for something smaller.
That's right, the pea is the smallest!
Then which one is the biggest? Tap it.
That's the pea. Look for something bigger.
That's the pillow. Look for something bigger.
That's right, the mattress is the biggest!
This tiny little pea goes on the bed board, tap. Nobody saw a thing!
Shall we pile mattresses on top of the pea? How many will there be? Tap!
Ten! And there are still more. Tap once more!
Twenty! That makes twenty mattresses.
And twenty feather quilts on top, soft and fluffy!
Where is the pea? At the top of the tower, or at the bottom?
That's the top of the tower. The pea is at the very bottom. Tap the bottom.
That's right! The pea is at the very bottom.
Where will the princess sleep? At the top, or at the bottom?
That's the bottom of the tower. The princess sleeps at the very top. Tap the top.
That's right! The princess sleeps at the very top.
The pea at the very bottom, and the princess at the very top.
Wow, it's so high! Good night.
Late into the night... the princess tossed this way, and turned that way.
I think there's something hard in here...
Morning came. The princess climbed down the ladder.
Did you sleep well?
No. To be honest, I didn't sleep a wink. Something hard was in the bed, and now I'm stiff and sleepy.
She felt the pea through twenty mattresses! She is a true princess!
The prince and the princess held hands tight.
At last, I have found a true princess!
And the pea was sent to a museum.
Tap the glass case.
Bye-bye!
