read_en.text: Morning has come to the forest village.
read_en.key: 숲속 마을에 아침이 왔어요.

read_en.text: The sun peeked up with a smile, and the birds sang tweet, tweet.
read_en.key: 해님이 방긋 떠오르고, 새들이 짹짹 노래했어요.

read_en.text: The turtle takes a slow, slow walk.
read_en.key: 거북이가 엉금엉금 산책해요.

read_en.text: "Hi! I'm Turtle."
read_en.key: "안녕! 나는 거북이야."

read_en.text: Hop, hop! Here comes the rabbit too.
read_en.key: 깡충깡충 토끼도 왔어요.

read_en.text: "Hi! I'm Rabbit, the hoppy one!"
read_en.key: "안녕! 나는 깡충 토끼야!"

read_en.text: Rabbit and Tortoise stood face to face on the forest path.
read_en.key: 숲속 길에서 토끼와 거북이가 마주 섰어요.

read_en.text: The rabbit looked at the turtle's short little legs and giggled.
read_en.key: 토끼는 거북이의 짧은 다리를 보고 킥킥 웃었어요.

read_en.text: The rabbit said, "Hey, slowpoke! Want to race me?"
read_en.key: 토끼가 말했어요. "느림보야, 나랑 달리기 할래?"

read_en.text: The turtle gave a big smile. "Okay!"
read_en.key: 거북이가 방긋 웃었어요. "좋아!"

read_en.text: Slow is fine. I will go all the way to the end.
read_en.key: "느려도 괜찮아. 나는 끝까지 갈 거야."

read_en.text: The turtle plodded along ever so slowly, but once he made up his mind, he never gave up.
read_en.key: 거북이는 느릿느릿 걸어도 한 번 마음먹으면 끝까지 하는 친구였거든요.

read_en.text: "Let's ask our forest friends to cheer for us!"
read_en.key: "숲속 친구들한테 응원해 달라고 하자!"

read_en.text: Owl flew from house to house to tell everyone about the race.
read_en.key: 경주 소식을 전하려고 부엉이가 마을 집집마다 날아갔어요.

read_en.text: The owl mail carrier brought the invitations.
read_en.key: 부엉이 우체부가 초대장을 가져왔어요.

read_en.text: Knock, knock! When the owl tapped on the doors, the duck, the cow, the pig and the puppy all peeked out.
read_en.key: 똑똑! 문을 두드리자 오리, 소, 돼지, 강아지가 얼굴을 쏙 내밀었어요.

read_en.text: The rooster, the sheep, and the cat got invitations too!
read_en.key: 닭이랑 양이랑 고양이도 초대장을 받았어요!

read_en.text: The invited friends went to the seats beside the race path.
read_en.key: 초대장을 받은 친구들은 경주 길 옆 응원석으로 갔어요.

read_en.text: The animal friends gathered to cheer!
read_en.key: 동물 친구들이 응원하러 모였어요!

read_en.text: All the friends jump up and cheer!
read_en.key: 친구들이 벌떡 일어나 응원해요!

read_en.text: Wow, what a happy cheer!
read_en.key: 와, 신나는 응원 소리!

read_en.text: Everyone snuggled up together in the cheering seats, hearts going pitter-patter, waiting for the race.
read_en.key: 모두 응원석에 옹기종기 앉아 두근두근 경주를 기다렸지요.

read_en.text: Rabbit and Tortoise lined up at the start in front of their friends.
read_en.key: 토끼와 거북이는 친구들 앞 출발선에 나란히 섰어요.

read_en.text: Before the race, let's do warm-up exercises.
read_en.key: 달리기 전에 준비 운동을 해요.

read_en.text: The rabbit stretches its ears, up, up!
read_en.key: 토끼가 귀를 쭉~

read_en.text: The turtle stretches its neck, long, long!
read_en.key: 거북이는 목을 쭉~

read_en.text: Wow, the turtle's neck stretched waaay long!
read_en.key: 와, 거북이 목이 쭈욱~ 길어졌어요!

read_en.text: The raccoon referee brought a big drum.
read_en.key: 너구리 심판이 커다란 북을 가져왔어요.

read_en.text: All the friends held their breath, hearts thumping, and stared at the drum.
read_en.key: 친구들은 모두 숨을 죽이고 두근두근 북을 바라보았어요.

read_en.text: Boom, boom! The drum thumped and thundered, and off they went, side by side.
read_en.key: 둥둥! 북소리가 쿵쿵 울리자 둘은 나란히 출발했어요.

read_en.text: The rabbit zooms off~ The turtle takes one slow step!
read_en.key: 토끼는 쌩~ 거북이는 엉금 한 발!

read_en.text: The rabbit zooms along!
read_en.key: 토끼는 쌩쌩 달려요!

read_en.text: Hop, hop! Over the rocks and across the stream, quick as a wink.
read_en.key: 돌멩이도 개울도 폴짝폴짝, 눈 깜짝할 사이에 지나갔지요.

read_en.text: Soon the rabbit reached the shady tree on the hill.
read_en.key: 금세 언덕 위 나무 그늘까지 왔어요.

read_en.text: Looking back... no turtle in sight!
read_en.key: 뒤를 돌아보니… 거북이는 안 보여요!

read_en.text: That turtle must still be way, way back. Hee hee.
read_en.key: "거북이는 아직 한참 멀었겠지? 히히."

read_en.text: "Yaaawn~ I can take a little nap~"
read_en.key: "하암~ 한숨 자고 가도 되겠다~"

read_en.text: The rabbit flopped down under the tree and let out a big yaaawn.
read_en.key: 토끼는 나무 아래에 벌렁 드러누워 하암~ 하품을 했어요.

read_en.text: Snuggle, snuggle~ The blanket is tucked in.
read_en.key: 포근포근~ 이불을 덮어 줬어요.

read_en.text: The owl sings a lullaby.
read_en.key: 부엉이가 자장가를 불러 줘요.

read_en.text: Hoo hoo~ The rabbit's eyes slowly close.
read_en.key: 부엉 부엉~ 토끼 눈이 스르르 감겨요.

read_en.text: A fluffy, puffy cloud drifted over, soft and slow, and covered up the sun.
read_en.key: 구름도 뭉게뭉게 다가와 해님을 살며시 가려 주었어요.

read_en.text: The rabbit fell fast asleep. Zzz.
read_en.key: 토끼가 쿨쿨 잠이 들었어요.

read_en.text: The rabbit is dreaming. In the dream, the rabbit came in first!
read_en.key: 토끼가 꿈을 꿔요. 꿈속에서 1등을 했어요!

read_en.text: As a prize, the rabbit got a giant carrot.
read_en.key: 상으로 커다란 당근을 받았어요.

read_en.text: "Crunch! Mmm, yummy!"
read_en.key: "아삭! 음~ 맛있다!"

read_en.text: But the real rabbit is under the tree, snoring, zzz~
read_en.key: 하지만 진짜 토끼는 나무 아래에서 드르렁 쿨쿨~

read_en.text: While Rabbit slept, Tortoise followed the race path through the forest.
read_en.key: 토끼가 자는 동안, 거북이는 숲속 경주 길을 따라갔어요.

read_en.text: Meanwhile, what about the turtle? Plod, plod, walking along.
read_en.key: 그동안 거북이는? 엉금엉금 걷고 있어요.

read_en.text: Plod, plod, one step, then another. The turtle never stopped, not even once.
read_en.key: 엉금엉금, 한 발 또 한 발. 거북이는 한 번도 쉬지 않았어요.

read_en.text: Oh! A big rock!
read_en.key: 어? 커다란 돌멩이예요!

read_en.text: Heave-ho! The turtle made it over the rock!
read_en.key: 영차! 돌멩이를 넘었어요!

read_en.text: Oh, a stream! The turtle is a good swimmer.
read_en.key: 앗, 개울이에요! 거북이는 헤엄을 잘 쳐요.

read_en.text: Splish, splash! The turtle paddled right through the rippling water.
read_en.key: 첨벙첨벙, 거북이는 물살을 가르며 헤엄쳤어요.

read_en.text: The turtle crossed the stream with the fish!
read_en.key: 물고기랑 같이 개울을 건넜어요!

read_en.text: Now there's a tall hill.
read_en.key: 이번엔 높은 언덕이에요.

read_en.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho. Slowly, slowly, but without stopping, the turtle climbed on up.
read_en.key: 영차, 영차. 거북이는 느릿느릿, 그래도 멈추지 않고 올라갔어요.

read_en.text: Heave-ho! The turtle reached the top of the hill.
read_en.key: 영차! 언덕 꼭대기에 올라왔어요.

read_en.text: At the top of the hill, Tortoise reached the tree where Rabbit slept.
read_en.key: 언덕을 오른 거북이가 토끼가 자는 나무 곁에 왔어요.

read_en.text: Up above, the rabbit sleeps. Down below, the turtle!
read_en.key: 위에는 쿨쿨 자는 토끼, 아래에는 거북이!

read_en.text: Shh, tiptoe past quietly~ sneak, sneak.
read_en.key: 쉿, 조용히 지나가요~ 살금살금.

read_en.text: Wow, the turtle passed the rabbit!
read_en.key: 와, 거북이가 토끼를 앞질렀어요!

read_en.text: The sun is slowly setting.
read_en.key: 해가 뉘엿뉘엿 지고 있어요.

read_en.text: Just then the rooster crowed as loud as he could. Cock-a-doodle-doo!
read_en.key: 그때 닭이 큰 소리로 울었어요. 꼬끼오!

read_en.text: The rabbit jumped right up! "Oh no, I fell asleep!"
read_en.key: 토끼가 벌떡 일어났어요! "앗, 내가 잠들었네!"

read_en.text: As Tortoise neared the finish line, the friends leaned forward to watch.
read_en.key: 거북이가 결승선 가까이 오자 친구들이 몸을 쭉 내밀었어요.

read_en.text: All the cheering friends stood up!
read_en.key: 응원하던 친구들이 모두 일어났어요!

read_en.text: The rabbit is zooming back! The turtle has just one step left.
read_en.key: 토끼가 쌩쌩 달려와요! 거북이는 딱 한 발 남았어요.

read_en.text: Heave-ho, just a little more. Just a little more and I am there.
read_en.key: "영차, 조금만 더. 조금만 더 가면 돼."

read_en.text: The turtle took a big, deep breath, whoosh, and stomped out one last step. Thump!
read_en.key: 거북이는 후우 숨을 크게 쉬고 마지막 한 발을 쿵 내디뎠어요.

read_en.text: Click! A photo caught the moment they reached the finish line.
read_en.key: 찰칵! 둘이 결승선에 닿는 순간이 사진에 담겼어요.

read_en.text: Look at the photo... the turtle's nose touched first!
read_en.key: 사진을 보니… 거북이 코끝이 먼저 닿았어요!

read_en.text: The turtle is number one!
read_en.key: 거북이가 1등이에요!

read_en.text: After the race, Tortoise climbed onto the prize stand.
read_en.key: 경주가 끝나고, 거북이는 시상대 위로 올라갔어요.

read_en.text: It's the award ceremony! The cheering friends do the wave.
read_en.key: 시상식이에요! 응원하던 친구들이 파도타기를 해요.

read_en.text: Sparkle, sparkle, a gold medal!
read_en.key: 반짝반짝, 금메달이에요!

read_en.text: The turtle wore the sparkly, twinkly medal around his neck and smiled a great big smile.
read_en.key: 거북이는 반짝반짝 메달을 목에 걸고 활짝 웃었어요.

read_en.text: The rabbit came over and said,
read_en.key: 토끼가 다가와 말했어요.

read_en.text: "Congratulations! Next time I'll work hard and never stop to rest."
read_en.key: "축하해! 다음엔 나도 쉬지 않고 열심히 할게."

read_en.text: The turtle said, "Thank you! Let's race together again!"
read_en.key: 거북이도 말했어요. "고마워! 우리 또 같이 달리자!"

read_en.text: Night came. The forest party began!
read_en.key: 밤이 되었어요. 숲속 잔치가 열렸어요!

read_en.text: The friends beat the drums, boom, boom, and shook the bells, jingle, jingle.
read_en.key: 친구들은 둥둥 북을 치고 딸랑딸랑 방울을 흔들었어요.

read_en.text: Everyone had a happy party together.
read_en.key: 모두 함께 신나는 잔치를 했답니다.

read_en.text: Even if you go slowly, you can make it if you keep going!
read_en.key: 천천히 가도 끝까지 하면 해낼 수 있어요!

ko.text: 옛날에 아기를 기다리는 부부가 살았어요. 아기가 곧 올 거예요.
담 너머 텃밭은 마녀 고텔의 마법 텃밭이라 아무도 들어가지 못했어요.
저 라푼젤 풀이 너무너무 먹고 싶어요.
밤이 되자, 아버지는 살금살금 담을 넘었어요.
아, 아내가 너무너무 먹고 싶어 해서요.
내 풀을 가져가도 좋다. 대신 아기가 태어나면 내가 키우마.
아기가 태어났어요. 마녀 고텔은 아기를 데려가 라푼젤이라고 이름 짓고 정성껏 키웠어요.
라푼젤이 열두 살이 되자, 마녀는 지팡이를 톡 두드렸어요.
숲속에 문도 계단도 없는 높은 탑이 쑥 솟았어요. 창문은 꼭대기에 하나뿐이에요.
자, 잠겨라. 밖은 위험하단다. 여기가 제일 안전해.
지붕 위에는 새 한 마리, 탑 아래에는 토끼 한 마리가 있어요.
탑 위에 있는 새를 톡, 눌러 봐요.
그건 탑 아래에 있는 토끼예요. 위를 봐요.
이번엔 탑 아래에 있는 토끼를 톡, 눌러 봐요.
그건 탑 위에 있는 새예요. 아래를 봐요.
스르르~ 금빛 머리가 탑 아래까지 닿았어요.
라푼젤은 혼자 있을 때면 창가에서 노래를 불렀어요.
바닥에 리본 세 개가 있어요. 길이가 다 달라요.
라푼젤 머리를 묶을 제일 긴 리본을 찾아봐요.
그건 중간 리본이에요. 더 긴 리본이 있어요.
그건 제일 짧은 리본이에요. 더 긴 리본이 있어요.
그럼 제일 짧은 리본은 어디 있을까요?
그건 중간 리본이에요. 더 짧은 리본이 있어요.
라푼젤은 리본을 묶은 머리를 창가에 늘어뜨리고 또 노래했어요.
어느 해질녘, 숲을 지나던 왕자가 노랫소리를 들었어요.
왕자는 탑을 한 바퀴 돌았지만 문이 없었어요.
그때 마녀 고텔이 왔어요. 왕자는 나무 뒤에 숨었어요.
다음 날 저녁, 왕자는 탑 아래에서 외쳤어요.
놀라게 해서 미안해요. 노래가 너무 고와서 왔어요. 저와 함께 성으로 가요.
할머니, 할머니는 왜 왕자님보다 훨씬 무거워요?
마녀는 가위 한 번으로 라푼젤의 머리를 자르고, 지팡이를 톡 두드려 먼 들판의 작은 오두막으로 데려갔어요.
그날 저녁, 왕자는 아무것도 모르고 탑에 왔어요.

라푼젤은 여기 없다. 다시는 못 볼 거다. 자, 내려가라.
휘익~ 마법 바람이 왕자를 탑 아래 풀숲에 사뿐 내려놓았어요.
왕자는 슬픈 얼굴로 숲을 걷고 또 걸었어요.
포기하지 않길 잘했어요. 이제 함께 가요.
두 사람은 손을 꼭 잡고 성으로 떠났어요.

en.text: Once upon a time, there lived a husband and wife who were waiting for a baby. The baby was coming soon.
Beyond the wall was the magic garden of the witch Gothel, and no one was allowed in.
Oh, I want to eat that rampion so, so much.
I'll go and get some for you.
When night came, the father quietly climbed over the wall.
Who's there! Pulling up my rampion!
Oh! My wife wanted it so, so much.
You may take my rampion. But when the baby is born, I shall raise it.
Yes... all right.
The baby was born. The witch Gothel took her away, named her Rapunzel, and raised her with care.
When Rapunzel turned twelve, the witch tapped her stick on the ground.
Up rose a tall tower in the forest, with no door and no stairs. There was only one window, right at the top.
Now, lock tight. The outside is dangerous. This is the safest place.
On top of the roof sits a bird, and down below the tower sits a rabbit.
Tap the bird on top of the tower.
That's the rabbit below the tower. Look up.
That's right, the bird on top!
Now tap the rabbit below the tower.
That's the bird on top of the tower. Look down.
That's right, the rabbit below!
Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!
Swish... the golden hair slid all the way down to the foot of the tower.
Gothel took hold of the hair and slowly climbed up.
Whenever Rapunzel was alone, she sang at the window.
I wish my song could reach the end of the forest.
There are three ribbons on the floor. They are all different lengths.
Find the longest ribbon to tie Rapunzel's hair.
That's the middle ribbon. There's a longer one.
That's the shortest ribbon. There's a longer one.
That's right, the longest ribbon!
Now, where is the shortest ribbon?
That's the middle ribbon. There's a shorter one.
That's right, the shortest ribbon!
Rapunzel let her ribboned hair hang at the window and sang again.
One evening at sunset, a prince riding through the forest heard the singing.
Where is that lovely song coming from?
The prince walked all the way around the tower, but there was no door.
Just then the witch Gothel came. The prince hid behind a tree.
Ah, so that's how you get up there!
The next evening, the prince called out from the foot of the tower.
Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!
Oh my, you're not Grandmother?
I'm sorry I startled you. Your song was so lovely that I came. Come with me to my castle.
All right. If you bring me silk thread, I'll weave a ladder.
From that day on, the prince brought silk thread every evening.
One day, Rapunzel said without thinking,
Grandmother, why are you so much heavier than the prince?
What? A prince!
With one snip of her scissors the witch cut off Rapunzel's hair, then tapped her stick and took her away to a little cottage in a faraway meadow.
That evening, the prince came to the tower, knowing nothing.
The witch hung the cut-off braid on the hook and let it down.
Rapunzel is not here. You will never see her again. Now, down you go.
Whoosh... a magic wind set the prince gently down in the grass below the tower.
Rapunzel... where could she be?
The prince walked and walked through the forest with a sad face.
Then, carried on the wind, came the sound of singing.
That song... Rapunzel!
Prince! You came and found me.
I'm glad I never gave up. Let's go together now.
The two held hands tightly and set off for the castle.
And the witch Gothel went back to her garden.

read_ko.key: 라푼젤은 그 오두막 곁에서 노래하고 있었어요.

read_ko.key: 그때, 바람을 타고 노랫소리가 들려왔어요.

read_ko.text: 왕자의 귀가 쫑긋, 발걸음이 점점 빨라졌어요.
read_ko.key: 왕자의 귀가 쫑긋, 발걸음이 점점 빨라졌어요.

read_ko.text: 이 노래는… 라푼젤!
read_ko.key: 이 노래는… 라푼젤!

read_ko.text: 왕자님! 찾아와 줬군요.

read_ko.key: 포기하지 않길 잘했어요. 이제 함께 가요.

read_ko.key: 꽃잎이 팔랑팔랑 날리고, 두 사람은 손을 꼭 잡았어요.

read_ko.text: 멀리 떨어져 있어도 포기하지 않으면, 사랑하는 사람을 다시 만날 수 있답니다.

read_en.text: Once upon a time, there lived a husband and wife who were waiting for a baby. The baby was coming soon.
read_en.key: 옛날에 아기를 기다리는 부부가 살았어요. 아기가 곧 올 거예요.

read_en.text: Beyond the wall was the magic garden of the witch Gothel, and no one was allowed in.
read_en.key: 담 너머 텃밭은 마녀 고텔의 마법 텃밭이라 아무도 들어가지 못했어요.

read_en.text: In the garden, green rampion grew fresh and tall, sprouting up, up, up.
read_en.key: 텃밭에는 초록 라푼젤 풀이 싱싱하게 쑥쑥 자라고 있었어요.

read_en.text: Mother spoke softly to Father.
read_en.key: 엄마가 아빠에게 나직이 말했어요.

read_en.text: Oh, I want to eat that rampion so, so much.
read_en.key: 저 라푼젤 풀이 너무너무 먹고 싶어요.

read_en.text: Mother gazed at the garden from the window and swallowed, gulp.
read_en.key: 엄마는 창가에서 텃밭을 보며 꿀꺽 침을 삼켰어요.

read_en.text: I'll go and get some for you.
read_en.key: 내가 가져올게요.

read_en.text: When night came, the father quietly climbed over the wall.
read_en.key: 밤이 되자, 아버지는 살금살금 담을 넘었어요.

read_en.text: The moment Father pulled up the rampion, pop, there was a flash, and the witch appeared!
read_en.key: 아버지가 풀을 쑥 뽑은 순간, 반짝! 마녀가 나타났어요.

read_en.text: Who's there! Pulling up my rampion!
read_en.key: 누구냐! 내 풀을 뽑다니!

read_en.text: Oh! My wife wanted it so, so much.
read_en.key: 아, 아내가 너무너무 먹고 싶어 해서요.

read_en.text: You may take my rampion. But when the baby is born, I shall raise it.
read_en.key: 내 풀을 가져가도 좋다. 대신 아기가 태어나면 내가 키우마.

read_en.text: Yes... all right.
read_en.key: 네… 알겠어요.

read_en.text: The baby was born. The witch Gothel took her away, named her Rapunzel, and raised her with care.
read_en.key: 아기가 태어났어요. 마녀 고텔은 아기를 데려가 라푼젤이라고 이름 짓고 정성껏 키웠어요.

read_en.text: Gothel patted the baby to sleep, pat, pat, and cooked her yummy porridge, bubble, bubble.
read_en.key: 고텔은 아기를 토닥토닥 재우고, 맛있는 죽도 보글보글 끓여 주었어요.

read_en.text: When Rapunzel turned twelve, the witch tapped her stick on the ground.
read_en.key: 라푼젤이 열두 살이 되자, 마녀는 지팡이를 톡 두드렸어요.

read_en.text: Up rose a tall tower in the forest, with no door and no stairs. There was only one window, right at the top.
read_en.key: 숲속에 문도 계단도 없는 높은 탑이 쑥 솟았어요. 창문은 꼭대기에 하나뿐이에요.

read_en.text: Gothel made Rapunzel live in the room at the top of the tower.
read_en.key: 고텔은 라푼젤을 탑 꼭대기 방에 살게 했어요.

read_en.text: Now, lock tight. The outside is dangerous. This is the safest place.
read_en.key: 자, 잠겨라. 밖은 위험하단다. 여기가 제일 안전해.

read_en.text: On top of the roof sits a bird, and down below the tower sits a rabbit.
read_en.key: 지붕 위에는 새 한 마리, 탑 아래에는 토끼 한 마리가 있어요.

read_en.text: The bird went tweet, tweet, the rabbit went hop, hop, and Rapunzel smiled from her window.
read_en.key: 새는 짹짹, 토끼는 깡충깡충, 라푼젤은 창가에서 빙긋 웃었어요.

read_en.text: After that, Gothel called from below the tower whenever she visited.
read_en.key: 그 뒤로 고텔은 찾아올 때마다 탑 아래에서 외쳤어요.

read_en.text: Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!
read_en.key: 라푼젤, 라푼젤, 머리를 내려 줘!

read_en.text: Rapunzel let her long braid tumble down from the window.
read_en.key: 라푼젤은 창가에서 길게 땋은 머리를 풀어 내렸어요.

read_en.text: Swish... the golden hair slid all the way down to the foot of the tower.
read_en.key: 스르르~ 금빛 머리가 탑 아래까지 닿았어요.

read_en.text: Gothel took hold of the hair and slowly climbed up.
read_en.key: 고텔은 머리를 잡고 천천히 올라가요.

read_en.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho! The braid swung to and fro, and Gothel huffed and puffed her way up.
read_en.key: 영차, 영차! 머리카락이 흔들흔들, 고텔은 끙끙 올라갔어요.

read_en.text: When Gothel reached the window, Rapunzel pulled her hair back up, swish.
read_en.key: 창문에 닿자, 라푼젤은 머리를 스르륵 끌어올렸어요.

read_en.text: When Gothel left, the room at the top of the tower grew quiet.
read_en.key: 고텔이 돌아가면 탑 꼭대기 방은 조용해졌어요.

read_en.text: Whenever Rapunzel was alone, she sang at the window.
read_en.key: 라푼젤은 혼자 있을 때면 창가에서 노래를 불렀어요.

read_en.text: La, la, la. Her lovely song floated out of the window and away, drifting on the air.
read_en.key: 라라라, 고운 노랫소리가 창밖으로 두둥실 퍼져 나갔어요.

read_en.text: I wish my song could reach the end of the forest.
read_en.key: 내 노래가 숲 끝까지 닿았으면.

read_en.text: Rapunzel tied her hair up neatly with the longest ribbon.
read_en.key: 라푼젤은 제일 긴 리본으로 머리를 곱게 묶었어요.

read_en.text: Rapunzel let her ribboned hair hang at the window and sang again.
read_en.key: 라푼젤은 리본을 묶은 머리를 창가에 늘어뜨리고 또 노래했어요.

read_en.text: One evening at sunset, a prince riding through the forest heard the singing.
read_en.key: 어느 해질녘, 숲을 지나던 왕자가 노랫소리를 들었어요.

read_en.text: The sun was sinking low, and the forest glowed rosy pink.
read_en.key: 해가 뉘엿뉘엿 지고, 숲이 발그레 물들었어요.

read_en.text: Where is that lovely song coming from?
read_en.key: 어디서 이렇게 고운 노래가 들리지?

read_en.text: The prince got off his horse and went toward the singing in the tower.
read_en.key: 왕자는 말에서 내려 노랫소리가 나는 탑으로 다가갔어요.

read_en.text: The prince walked all the way around the tower, but there was no door.
read_en.key: 왕자는 탑을 한 바퀴 돌았지만 문이 없었어요.

read_en.text: The prince tilted his head this way and that, and looked up at the tower.
read_en.key: 왕자는 고개를 갸웃갸웃, 탑을 올려다보았어요.

read_en.text: Just then the witch Gothel came. The prince hid behind a tree.
read_en.key: 그때 마녀 고텔이 왔어요. 왕자는 나무 뒤에 숨었어요.

read_en.text: Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!
read_en.key: 라푼젤, 라푼젤, 머리를 내려 줘!

read_en.text: Gothel climbed up the braid and in through the window.
read_en.key: 고텔이 머리카락을 타고 창문 안으로 올라갔어요.

read_en.text: Ah, so that's how you get up there!
read_en.key: 아, 저렇게 올라가는구나!

read_en.text: The next evening, the prince called out from the foot of the tower.
read_en.key: 다음 날 저녁, 왕자는 탑 아래에서 외쳤어요.

read_en.text: Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!
read_en.key: 라푼젤, 라푼젤, 머리를 내려 줘요!

read_en.text: The prince held the braid Rapunzel lowered and climbed up, heave-ho!
read_en.key: 라푼젤이 내린 머리를 붙잡고 왕자가 영차영차 올라갔어요.

read_en.text: When the prince popped in through the window, Rapunzel jumped in surprise.
read_en.key: 왕자가 창문으로 쑥 들어오자, 라푼젤은 깜짝 놀랐어요.

read_en.text: Oh my, you're not Grandmother?
read_en.key: 어머, 할머니가 아니네?

read_en.text: I'm sorry I startled you. Your song was so lovely that I came. Come with me to my castle.
read_en.key: 놀라게 해서 미안해요. 노래가 너무 고와서 왔어요. 저와 함께 성으로 가요.

read_en.text: All right. If you bring me silk thread, I'll weave a ladder.
read_en.key: 좋아요. 비단실을 가져오면 사다리를 엮을게요.

read_en.text: The prince chattered on and on about the big wide world outside.
read_en.key: 왕자는 바깥세상 이야기를 조잘조잘 들려주었어요.

read_en.text: From that day on, the prince brought silk thread every evening.
read_en.key: 그날부터 왕자는 저녁마다 비단실을 가져왔어요.

read_en.text: The silk piled up, neat and tidy, and every day the two chatted softly together.
read_en.key: 비단실이 차곡차곡 쌓이고, 두 사람은 날마다 도란도란 이야기를 나눴어요.

read_en.text: In the daytime, while the prince was away, Gothel and Rapunzel were in the tower.
read_en.key: 왕자가 없는 낮, 탑 안에는 고텔과 라푼젤이 있었어요.

read_en.text: One day, Rapunzel said without thinking,
read_en.key: 어느 날, 라푼젤이 무심코 말했어요.

read_en.text: Grandmother, why are you so much heavier than the prince?
read_en.key: 할머니, 할머니는 왜 왕자님보다 훨씬 무거워요?

read_en.text: What? A prince!
read_en.key: 뭐라고? 왕자라니!

read_en.text: Gothel shook with anger, tremble, tremble, and pulled out a great big pair of scissors.
read_en.key: 고텔은 부들부들 떨며 커다란 가위를 꺼냈어요.

read_en.text: With one snip of her scissors the witch cut off Rapunzel's hair, then tapped her stick and took her away to a little cottage in a faraway meadow.
read_en.key: 마녀는 가위 한 번으로 라푼젤의 머리를 자르고, 지팡이를 톡 두드려 먼 들판의 작은 오두막으로 데려갔어요.

read_en.text: Rapunzel touched her short hair and cried, sniff, sniff.
read_en.key: 라푼젤은 짧아진 머리를 만지며 훌쩍훌쩍 울었어요.

read_en.text: That evening, the prince came to the tower, knowing nothing.
read_en.key: 그날 저녁, 왕자는 아무것도 모르고 탑에 왔어요.

read_en.text: The tower stood empty, and only the wind blew past, whoo.
read_en.key: 탑은 텅 비고, 바람만 휘잉 지나갔어요.

read_en.text: Rapunzel, Rapunzel, let down your hair!
read_en.key: 라푼젤, 라푼젤, 머리를 내려 줘요!

read_en.text: The witch hung the cut-off braid on the hook and let it down.
read_en.key: 마녀는 잘린 머리를 고리에 걸어 내려 주었어요.

read_en.text: The prince climbed the braid and found Gothel waiting in the room.
read_en.key: 왕자는 머리카락을 타고 올라가 방 안의 고텔과 마주쳤어요.

read_en.text: Rapunzel is not here. You will never see her again. Now, down you go.
read_en.key: 라푼젤은 여기 없다. 다시는 못 볼 거다. 자, 내려가라.

read_en.text: Whoosh... a magic wind set the prince gently down in the grass below the tower.
read_en.key: 휘익~ 마법 바람이 왕자를 탑 아래 풀숲에 사뿐 내려놓았어요.

read_en.text: Rapunzel... where could she be?
read_en.key: 라푼젤… 어디로 갔을까.

read_en.text: The prince walked and walked through the forest with a sad face.
read_en.key: 왕자는 슬픈 얼굴로 숲을 걷고 또 걸었어요.

read_en.text: Plod, plod. The prince's steps were heavy and slow.
read_en.key: 터벅터벅, 왕자의 발걸음은 무겁기만 했어요.

read_en.text: The prince came out of the forest to a field with a little cottage.
read_en.key: 숲을 벗어난 왕자가 작은 오두막이 있는 들판에 이르렀어요.

read_en.text: Rapunzel was singing beside that cottage.
read_en.key: 라푼젤은 그 오두막 곁에서 노래하고 있었어요.

read_en.text: Then, carried on the wind, came the sound of singing.
read_en.key: 그때, 바람을 타고 노랫소리가 들려왔어요.

read_en.text: The prince's ears perked up, and his steps grew faster and faster.
read_en.key: 왕자의 귀가 쫑긋, 발걸음이 점점 빨라졌어요.

read_en.text: That song... Rapunzel!
read_en.key: 이 노래는… 라푼젤!

read_en.text: Prince! You came and found me.
read_en.key: 왕자님! 찾아와 줬군요.

read_en.text: I'm glad I never gave up. Let's go together now.
read_en.key: 포기하지 않길 잘했어요. 이제 함께 가요.

read_en.text: Petals fluttered down, flit, flit, and the two held hands tight.
read_en.key: 꽃잎이 팔랑팔랑 날리고, 두 사람은 손을 꼭 잡았어요.

read_en.text: The two held hands tightly and set off for the castle.
read_en.key: 두 사람은 손을 꼭 잡고 성으로 떠났어요.

read_en.text: And the witch Gothel went back to her garden.
read_en.key: 마녀 고텔은 텃밭으로 돌아갔어요.

read_en.text: Even when you are far apart, if you never give up, you can meet the one you love again.
read_en.key: 멀리 떨어져 있어도 포기하지 않으면, 사랑하는 사람을 다시 만날 수 있답니다.

ko.text: 그건 파란 블록이에요. 빨간 것을 찾아봐요.
그건 노란 오리예요. 빨간 것을 찾아봐요.
밥 먹을 때도 냠냠, 잠잘 때도 쌔근, 언제나 손에 꼭 쥐고 있었지요.
그러던 어느 날, 밖에서 놀고 있었어요.
노느라 그만 빨간 자동차를 톡, 놓고 말았어요.
정신을 차려 보니… 어라? 빨간 자동차가 보이지 않아요!
잉잉, 내 빨간 자동차 어디 갔지?
홀로 남은 빨간 자동차는 이현이를 찾기로 했어요. 용기 있게 출발!
부릉부릉! 이현이를 찾아 장난감 세상으로 가자!
조금 가다 보니, 삐뽀삐뽀 우렁찬 소리가 들렸어요.
경찰차 장난감이 도둑 장난감들을 쫓아 씽씽 달리고 있었어요.
어? 너는 이현이가 잃어버렸던 경찰차 형아?!
좋아! 도둑을 다 잡았으니 같이 가자!
가다 보니 이번엔 위이잉, 소리가 났어요.
소방차가 블록으로 만든 장난감 집에 난 불을 쉭쉭 끄고 있었어요.
어? 소방차 이모! 우리 같이 이현이 만나러 가요!
그래그래! 불을 다 껐으니 같이 가자!
셋이서 길을 가다 보니 삐용삐용, 바쁜 소리가 들렸어요.
구급차 삼촌이 아픈 인형들을 태우고 병원으로 가고 있었지요.
구급차 삼촌! 우리랑 같이 이현이한테 가요!
오냐오냐, 아픈 친구들을 다 데려다주었으니 이제 이현이에게 가자!
넷이서 나란히 달려요. 친구들이 소리로 인사했어요.
하지만 너무 오래 달린 빨간 자동차는 그만 툭, 멈춰 서고 말았어요.
그때, 저 멀리서 덜컹덜컹 든든한 소리가 들렸어요.

en.text: Ihyun loved the little red car very much.
Where is the red one? Find it!
That's the blue block. Find the red one.
That's the yellow duck. Find the red one.
That's right, the red car!
Munch munch at mealtime, snore snore at bedtime, the red car was always in Ihyun's hand.
Then one day, Ihyun was playing outside.
Oh! A butterfly!
Ihyun was so busy playing that the red car slipped out, plop, onto the grass.
And then... huh? The red car was nowhere to be seen!
Boo-hoo, where did my red car go?
The little red car, all alone, decided to go and find Ihyun. Off it went, brave and bold!
Vroom vroom! Let's go to Toy Land and find Ihyun!
A little way down the road, there came a loud wee-woo, wee-woo!
Stop right there!
A toy police car was zooming after some toy robbers.
Huh? You're the police car Ihyun lost! Big brother police car!
Let's go find Ihyun together!
Sure! I've caught all the robbers, so let's go together!
Big brother police car led the way.
A little farther on, there came a wee-ooo sound.
Stand back! I'm putting out the fire!
A fire truck was spraying water, whoosh whoosh, on a fire at a little block house.
Tap the flames to put them out!
Oh? Auntie fire truck! Come with us to find Ihyun!
Of course! The fire is out, so let's go together!
Auntie fire truck happily joined the group.
As the three drove on, there came a busy nee-naw, nee-naw!
Uncle ambulance was taking some sick dolls to the hospital.
Uncle ambulance! Come with us to find Ihyun!
All right, all right! I've brought the sick friends to the hospital, so now let's go to Ihyun!
Uncle ambulance came along too, strong and steady.
The four friends drove side by side. They said hello with their sounds.
Come on, everyone, let's go to Ihyun!
But the little red car had driven for so long that it stopped with a clunk.
Oh dear, I'm so tired. I can't go any farther...
Its wheels felt so heavy it couldn't move at all.
Just then, from far away, came a sturdy clatter, clatter sound.
Don't worry! I'll help you!
It was the orange tow truck Ihyun had lost long ago!
The tow truck hooked its strong hook onto the red car. Click!
Heave-ho, heave-ho!
The tow truck pulled the red car from the front, and the other cars followed close behind.
Who is pulling at the very front? Pick one!
That's the red car. Look at the very front again.
That's big brother police car. Look at the very front again.
That's auntie fire truck. Look at the very front again.
That's uncle ambulance. Look at the very front again.
That's right, the tow truck!
Who is in the middle? Pick one!
Who is at the very back? Pick one!
That's right, the police car is in the middle!
That's right, the fire truck is in the middle!
That's right, the ambulance is in the middle!
That's right, the police car is at the very back!
That's right, the fire truck is at the very back!
That's right, the ambulance is at the very back!
That's the red car. Let's look again!
That's the police car. Let's look again!
That's the fire truck. Let's look again!
That's the ambulance. Let's look again!
That's the tow truck. Let's look again!
Like a long train, all in a row: chugga-chugga, vroom vroom vroom!
At last, they found Ihyun at the playground!
Wow! My red car!
And the police car, the fire truck, the ambulance and the tow truck are all here too!
Ihyun hugged all the precious toy cars and jumped for joy.
Now let's all go home together!

read_ko.text: 덜컹덜컹, 부릉부릉, 삐뽀삐뽀! 신나는 소리가 길에 가득했어요.
read_ko.key: 덜컹덜컹, 부릉부릉, 삐뽀삐뽀! 신나는 소리가 길에 가득했어요.

read_ko.text: 마침내 놀이터에 있는 이현이를 만났어요!
read_ko.key: 마침내 놀이터에 있는 이현이를 만났어요!

read_ko.text: 와아! 내 빨간 자동차다!
read_ko.key: 와아! 내 빨간 자동차다!

read_ko.text: 경찰차랑 소방차, 구급차랑 견인차도 다 여기 있네!
read_ko.key: 경찰차랑 소방차, 구급차랑 견인차도 다 여기 있네!

read_ko.text: 이현이는 소중한 보물 자동차들을 모두 품에 안고 펄쩍펄쩍 기뻐했답니다.
read_ko.key: 이현이는 소중한 보물 자동차들을 모두 품에 안고 펄쩍펄쩍 기뻐했답니다.

read_ko.text: 자동차 친구들도 빵빵! 부릉부릉! 신이 나서 소리쳤어요.
read_ko.key: 자동차 친구들도 빵빵! 부릉부릉! 신이 나서 소리쳤어요.

read_ko.text: 이제 모두 함께 집으로 출발!
read_ko.key: 이제 모두 함께 집으로 출발!

read_ko.text: 서로 도우면 혼자서는 못 가는 길도 함께 갈 수 있답니다.
read_ko.key: 서로 도우면 혼자서는 못 가는 길도 함께 갈 수 있답니다.

read_en.text: In Ihyun's room, there was a little red toy car.
read_en.key: 이현이의 방에 작은 빨간 장난감 자동차가 있었어요.

read_en.text: Ihyun loved the little red car very much.
read_en.key: 이현이는 빨간 자동차를 참 좋아했어요.

read_en.text: In his room were a blue block, a yellow duck, and a shiny, sparkly little red car.
read_en.key: 방 안에는 파란 블록, 노란 오리, 그리고 반짝반짝 빨간 자동차가 있었지요.

read_en.text: Vroom, vroom! Every day Ihyun played with the car, zooming it all around.
read_en.key: 부릉부릉! 이현이는 날마다 자동차를 씽씽 굴리며 놀았어요.

read_en.text: Munch munch at mealtime, snore snore at bedtime, the red car was always in Ihyun's hand.
read_en.key: 밥 먹을 때도 냠냠, 잠잘 때도 쌔근, 언제나 손에 꼭 쥐고 있었지요.

read_en.text: Then one day, Ihyun was playing outside.
read_en.key: 그러던 어느 날, 밖에서 놀고 있었어요.

read_en.text: Ihyun held the red car in his hand and saw a butterfly. Look!
read_en.key: 이현이는 빨간 자동차를 손에 들고 나비를 보았어요.

read_en.text: Oh! A butterfly!
read_en.key: 어! 나비다!

read_en.text: The butterfly fluttered away, flutter, flutter, and Ihyun went hopping after it, hop, hop.
read_en.key: 나비가 팔랑팔랑 날아가자, 이현이는 폴짝폴짝 따라갔어요.

read_en.text: Ihyun was so busy playing that the red car slipped out, plop, onto the grass.
read_en.key: 노느라 그만 빨간 자동차를 톡, 놓고 말았어요.

read_en.text: The butterfly flapped and fluttered far, far away, over the flower field and out of sight.
read_en.key: 나비는 훨훨, 저 멀리 꽃밭 너머로 날아가 버렸어요.

read_en.text: And then... huh? The red car was nowhere to be seen!
read_en.key: 정신을 차려 보니… 어라? 빨간 자동차가 보이지 않아요!

read_en.text: Ihyun looked and looked for his car, and his tears fell, drip, drop.
read_en.key: 이현이는 자동차를 찾으며 눈물을 뚝뚝 흘렸어요.

read_en.text: Boo-hoo, where did my red car go?
read_en.key: 잉잉, 내 빨간 자동차 어디 갔지?

read_en.text: Ihyun went away, and the red car was left all alone on the grass.
read_en.key: 이현이가 떠난 자리에 빨간 자동차만 혼자 남았어요.

read_en.text: The little red car, all alone, decided to go and find Ihyun. Off it went, brave and bold!
read_en.key: 홀로 남은 빨간 자동차는 이현이를 찾기로 했어요. 용기 있게 출발!

read_en.text: Its little wheels wobbled and shook, but bravely it rolled on, round and round.
read_en.key: 작은 바퀴가 덜덜 떨렸지만, 씩씩하게 데굴데굴 굴러갔어요.

read_en.text: Vroom vroom! Let's go to Toy Land and find Ihyun!
read_en.key: 부릉부릉! 이현이를 찾아 장난감 세상으로 가자!

read_en.text: Creeeak! The great big gate of Toy Land swung open.
read_en.key: 끼이익, 장난감 세상의 커다란 문이 열렸어요.

read_en.text: Through the open gate, there it was: the world where toy friends live! Wow!
read_en.key: 열린 문을 지나자 장난감 친구들이 사는 세상이 나왔어요.

read_en.text: On a road in Toy Land, the red car met a police car.
read_en.key: 장난감 세상 길 위에서 빨간 자동차는 경찰차를 만났어요.

read_en.text: A little way down the road, there came a loud wee-woo, wee-woo!
read_en.key: 조금 가다 보니, 삐뽀삐뽀 우렁찬 소리가 들렸어요.

read_en.text: Big brother police car shouted at the toy robbers,
read_en.key: 경찰차 형아가 도둑 장난감들에게 외쳤어요.

read_en.text: Stop right there!
read_en.key: 게 멈춰라!

read_en.text: A toy police car was zooming after some toy robbers.
read_en.key: 경찰차 장난감이 도둑 장난감들을 쫓아 씽씽 달리고 있었어요.

read_en.text: The toy robbers jumped in surprise and threw their hands straight up in the air.
read_en.key: 도둑 장난감들이 깜짝 놀라 두 손을 번쩍 들었어요.

read_en.text: Huh? You're the police car Ihyun lost! Big brother police car!
read_en.key: 어? 너는 이현이가 잃어버렸던 경찰차 형아?!

read_en.text: Let's go find Ihyun together!
read_en.key: 우리 같이 이현이한테 가자!

read_en.text: Sure! I've caught all the robbers, so let's go together!
read_en.key: 좋아! 도둑을 다 잡았으니 같이 가자!

read_en.text: Big brother police car led the way.
read_en.key: 경찰차 형아가 앞장섰어요.

read_en.text: The red car and the police car came to a street full of toy houses.
read_en.key: 빨간 자동차와 경찰차는 장난감 집들이 있는 길에 도착했어요.

read_en.text: A little farther on, there came a wee-ooo sound.
read_en.key: 가다 보니 이번엔 위이잉, 소리가 났어요.

read_en.text: In front of the burning house, auntie fire truck called out,
read_en.key: 소방차 이모가 불이 난 집 앞에서 외쳤어요.

read_en.text: Stand back! I'm putting out the fire!
read_en.key: 조심하세요! 불을 끕니다!

read_en.text: A fire truck was spraying water, whoosh whoosh, on a fire at a little block house.
read_en.key: 소방차가 블록으로 만든 장난감 집에 난 불을 쉭쉭 끄고 있었어요.

read_en.text: Whoosh, whoosh, hiss! The flames went out, one, two, three, all gone.
read_en.key: 쉭쉭, 치익! 불꽃이 하나, 둘, 셋, 모두 꺼졌어요.

read_en.text: Oh? Auntie fire truck! Come with us to find Ihyun!
read_en.key: 어? 소방차 이모! 우리 같이 이현이 만나러 가요!

read_en.text: Of course! The fire is out, so let's go together!
read_en.key: 그래그래! 불을 다 껐으니 같이 가자!

read_en.text: Auntie fire truck happily joined the group.
read_en.key: 소방차 이모도 신나게 함께했어요.

read_en.text: The three friends zoomed off to the road by the toy hospital. Vroom!
read_en.key: 세 친구는 장난감 병원 앞길로 달려갔어요.

read_en.text: As the three drove on, there came a busy nee-naw, nee-naw!
read_en.key: 셋이서 길을 가다 보니 삐용삐용, 바쁜 소리가 들렸어요.

read_en.text: Uncle ambulance was taking some sick dolls to the hospital.
read_en.key: 구급차 삼촌이 아픈 인형들을 태우고 병원으로 가고 있었지요.

read_en.text: Click! The door opened, and the dolls tiptoed quietly into the hospital.
read_en.key: 철컥! 문이 열리고, 인형들이 살금살금 병원으로 들어갔어요.

read_en.text: Uncle ambulance! Come with us to find Ihyun!
read_en.key: 구급차 삼촌! 우리랑 같이 이현이한테 가요!

read_en.text: All right, all right! I've brought the sick friends to the hospital, so now let's go to Ihyun!
read_en.key: 오냐오냐, 아픈 친구들을 다 데려다주었으니 이제 이현이에게 가자!

read_en.text: Uncle ambulance came along too, strong and steady.
read_en.key: 구급차 삼촌도 든든하게 따라나섰어요.

read_en.text: The four friends left the hospital and came out onto a long, long road.
read_en.key: 병원을 떠난 친구 넷은 긴 길로 나왔어요.

read_en.text: The four friends drove side by side. They said hello with their sounds.
read_en.key: 넷이서 나란히 달려요. 친구들이 소리로 인사했어요.

read_en.text: The police car went wee-woo, the fire truck went wee-ooo, and the ambulance went nee-naw!
read_en.key: 경찰차는 삐뽀삐뽀, 소방차는 위이잉, 구급차는 삐용삐용!

read_en.text: Come on, everyone, let's go to Ihyun!
read_en.key: 자, 다 같이 이현이한테 가자!

read_en.text: The four friends zoomed along, zip, zip, slicing through the wind, happy as could be.
read_en.key: 친구 넷은 씽씽, 바람을 가르며 신나게 달렸어요.

read_en.text: The four friends reached a hilly road. Up, up, up!
read_en.key: 친구 넷이 언덕길에 다다랐어요.

read_en.text: But the little red car had driven for so long that it stopped with a clunk.
read_en.key: 하지만 너무 오래 달린 빨간 자동차는 그만 툭, 멈춰 서고 말았어요.

read_en.text: Oh dear, I'm so tired. I can't go any farther...
read_en.key: 아이고, 힘들어. 더는 못 가겠어…

read_en.text: Its wheels felt so heavy it couldn't move at all.
read_en.key: 바퀴가 무거워 꼼짝할 수가 없었지요.

read_en.text: Huff, puff. The little red car's engine went cold, and it slumped right down.
read_en.key: 빨간 자동차는 헉헉, 엔진이 식어 축 늘어졌어요.

read_en.text: Just then, from far away, came a sturdy clatter, clatter sound.
read_en.key: 그때, 저 멀리서 덜컹덜컹 든든한 소리가 들렸어요.

read_en.text: Don't worry! I'll help you!
read_en.key: 걱정 마! 내가 도와줄게!

read_en.text: It was the orange tow truck Ihyun had lost long ago!
read_en.key: 바로 이현이가 전에 잃어버렸던 주황색 견인차였어요!

read_en.text: The tow truck hooked its strong hook onto the red car. Click!
read_en.key: 견인차가 튼튼한 고리로 빨간 자동차를 찰칵! 걸어 주었어요.

read_en.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho!
read_en.key: 영차, 영차!

read_en.text: Thank you, tow truck! Now I can go again!
read_en.key: "고마워, 견인차야! 이제 다시 갈 수 있어!"

read_en.text: The five car friends went over the hill and out onto a long road.
read_en.key: 다섯 자동차 친구는 언덕을 지나 긴 길로 나왔어요.

read_en.text: The tow truck pulled the red car from the front, and the other cars followed close behind.
read_en.key: 견인차가 빨간 자동차를 앞에서 끌고, 그 뒤로 다른 차들이 든든하게 따랐어요.

read_en.text: At the very front, the tow truck pulled, heave-ho, heave-ho, and the friends followed along in a long, long line.
read_en.key: 맨 앞에서 견인차가 영차영차, 그 뒤로 친구들이 줄줄이 따라가요.

read_en.text: Like a long train, all in a row: chugga-chugga, vroom vroom vroom!
read_en.key: 긴 기차처럼 한 줄로 칙칙폭폭, 붕붕붕!

read_en.text: Clatter, clatter, vroom, vroom, wee-woo, wee-woo! The road was filled with happy sounds.
read_en.key: 덜컹덜컹, 부릉부릉, 삐뽀삐뽀! 신나는 소리가 길에 가득했어요.

read_en.text: At last, they found Ihyun at the playground!
read_en.key: 마침내 놀이터에 있는 이현이를 만났어요!

read_en.text: Wow! My red car!
read_en.key: 와아! 내 빨간 자동차다!

read_en.text: And the police car, the fire truck, the ambulance and the tow truck are all here too!
read_en.key: 경찰차랑 소방차, 구급차랑 견인차도 다 여기 있네!

read_en.text: Ihyun hugged all the precious toy cars and jumped for joy.
read_en.key: 이현이는 소중한 보물 자동차들을 모두 품에 안고 펄쩍펄쩍 기뻐했답니다.

read_en.text: The car friends honked and roared with joy. Beep, beep! Vroom, vroom!
read_en.key: 자동차 친구들도 빵빵! 부릉부릉! 신이 나서 소리쳤어요.

read_en.text: Now let's all go home together!
read_en.key: 이제 모두 함께 집으로 출발!

read_en.text: When we help each other, we can travel together down roads we could never travel alone.
read_en.key: 서로 도우면 혼자서는 못 가는 길도 함께 갈 수 있답니다.

ko.text: 엄마가 빨간 모자를 머리에 씌워 주었어요. 빨간 모자가 한 번 빙글 돌았어요.
"길에서 벗어나면 안 돼. 모르는 사람과 이야기하지도 마."
빨간 모자는 콧노래를 부르며 숲길을 걸어요.
어, 나무 뒤에서 뭔가 보슬보슬한 게 살짝 보였어요. 꼬리였나 봐요!
"꽃을 따 가면 할머니가 참 좋아하실 텐데~"
꽃밭에 알록달록 꽃이 가득해요. 꽃을 같은 색 꽃병에 쏙쏙 담아요!
꽃병마다 꽃다발이 활짝! 빨간 모자는 꽃을 따느라 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어요.
위에서는 빨간 모자가 꽃을 따요. 아래에서는 늑대가 지름길로 달려가요!
늑대는 할머니의 잠옷을 입고 침대에 누웠어요.
빨간 모자는 숲속 할머니 집에 도착했어요. 문을 톡 두드려요!
벽에 걸린 진짜 할머니 사진과 비교해서 다른 곳을 찾아봐요!
빨간 모자는 고개를 갸웃했어요. 또 이상한 곳이 있나 봐요.
빨간 모자는 깜짝 놀랐어요. 이 사람은 할머니가 아니에요!
늑대가 벌떡 일어났어요! 빨간 모자야, 어서 숨어요! 옷장을 톡!
빨간 모자는 옷장 속으로 쏙! 늑대는 두리번두리번 찾았지만 보이지 않았어요.
할머니를 먹어서 배가 불렀던 늑대는 스르르 눈이 감겼어요. 쿨쿨…
창밖으로 지나가던 사냥꾼이 코 고는 소리를 들었어요. 창문을 톡톡 두드려 봐요!
늑대가 딸꾹! 하자 할머니가 퐁! 하고 튀어나왔어요. 할머니는 다치지 않고 멀쩡했어요!
할머니 집 식탁에서 모두 함께 차를 마셔요. 바구니 속 간식을 한 가지씩 나눠 줘요!
"이제 약속을 꼭 지킬게요. 길에서 벗어나지 않고, 모르는 사람과는 이야기하지 않을래요."
빨간 모자는 새끼손가락을 걸고, 오늘 일을 오래오래 기억했어요.
빨간 모자를 톡톡톡! 한 걸음씩 걸어가요.
꽃이랑 색깔이 같은 꽃병이 어디 있을까?
사진 속 할머니와 달라 보이는 곳을 톡!
간식을 톡! 한 사람씩 나눠 줘요.
빨간 꽃이에요! 같은 색 꽃병을 톡!
빨간 꽃병이에요! 반짝이는 꽃병을 눌러 봐요!
노란 꽃이에요! 같은 색 꽃병을 톡!
노란 꽃병이에요! 반짝이는 꽃병을 눌러 봐요!
파란 꽃이에요! 같은 색 꽃병을 톡!
파란 꽃병이에요! 반짝이는 꽃병을 눌러 봐요!

en.text: Mother said to Little Red Riding Hood. Grandmother is sick. Bring her something yummy.
Put the bread, milk, and apple in the basket!
Three! The basket is full.
Mother put the red hood on her head. Red Hood spun around once.
Don't leave the path. And don't talk to strangers.
Yes, Mother! I promise.
Mother and Red Hood hooked their little fingers together.
Red Hood hummed as she walked along the forest path.

read_en.text: Grandmother's house was across the forest, at the end of a long, winding path.
read_en.key: 할머니 댁은 숲 건너 저쪽, 꼬불꼬불 숲길 끝에 있었지요.

read_en.text: Before Little Red Riding Hood left home, Mother called to her.
read_en.key: 집을 나서기 전, 엄마가 빨간 모자를 불렀어요.

read_en.text: Don't leave the path. And don't talk to strangers.
read_en.key: "길에서 벗어나면 안 돼. 모르는 사람과 이야기하지도 마."

read_en.text: Yes, Mother! I promise.
read_en.key: "네, 엄마! 약속해요."

read_en.text: Mother and Red Hood hooked their little fingers together.
read_en.key: 엄마와 빨간 모자는 새끼손가락을 걸었어요.

read_en.text: Red Hood set off, swinging her basket, swing, swing, as she went.
read_en.key: 빨간 모자는 바구니를 달랑달랑 흔들며 집을 나섰어요.

read_en.text: Red Hood hummed as she walked along the forest path.
read_en.key: 빨간 모자는 콧노래를 부르며 숲길을 걸어요.

read_en.text: The birds went tweet, tweet, and a squirrel scampered by, scurry, scurry! The forest was so peaceful.
read_en.key: 새들은 짹짹, 다람쥐는 쪼르르! 숲은 참 평화로웠지요.

read_en.text: Oh, something fluffy peeked out from behind a tree. It must be a tail!
read_en.key: 어, 나무 뒤에서 뭔가 보슬보슬한 게 살짝 보였어요. 꼬리였나 봐요!

read_en.text: The wolf slipped out from beside a tree. Little Red Riding Hood, where are you going?
read_en.key: 나무 옆에서 늑대가 슬그머니 나왔어요. "빨간 모자 아가씨, 어디 가니?"

read_en.text: I'm going to Grandmother's house. Red Hood answered.
read_en.key: "할머니 댁에 가요." 빨간 모자가 대답했어요.

read_en.text: The wolf smacked his lips, smack, smack, and his eyes gleamed.
read_en.key: 늑대는 입맛을 쩝쩝 다시며 눈을 번뜩였어요.

read_en.text: Grandmother would love it if you picked some flowers~
read_en.key: "꽃을 따 가면 할머니가 참 좋아하실 텐데~"

read_en.text: What a good idea! Red Hood forgot her promise to Mother.
read_en.key: "좋은 생각이에요!" 빨간 모자는 엄마와 한 약속을 깜빡하고 말았어요.

read_en.text: Little Red Riding Hood left the forest path and went into the flower patch.
read_en.key: 빨간 모자는 숲길을 벗어나 꽃밭으로 들어갔어요.

read_en.text: The flower field was full of red flowers, yellow flowers, and blue flowers, all bright and colorful.
read_en.key: 꽃밭에는 빨간 꽃, 노란 꽃, 파란 꽃이 알록달록 가득했어요.

read_en.text: Red Hood picked the flowers one by one, snip, snip, snip.
read_en.key: 빨간 모자는 꽃을 한 송이씩 하나하나 꺾어 모았어요.

read_en.text: Butterflies fluttered, flit, flit, and bees buzzed, bzzz, all around her.
read_en.key: 나비가 팔랑팔랑, 벌이 윙윙 따라다녔지요.

read_en.text: Bouquets in every vase! Red Hood was so busy picking flowers, she lost track of time.
read_en.key: 꽃병마다 꽃다발이 활짝! 빨간 모자는 꽃을 따느라 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어요.

read_en.text: Wolf wanted to reach Grandmother’s house before Little Red Riding Hood.
read_en.key: 늑대는 빨간 모자보다 먼저 할머니 집에 가려 했어요.

read_en.text: Up above, Red Hood picks flowers. Down below, the wolf runs along the shortcut!
read_en.key: 위에서는 빨간 모자가 꽃을 따요. 아래에서는 늑대가 지름길로 달려가요!

read_en.text: Wolf reached the door of Grandmother’s house.
read_en.key: 늑대는 할머니 집 문 앞에 도착했어요.

read_en.text: Knock, knock, knock... the door closes... gulp!
read_en.key: 똑똑똑… 문이 닫히고… 꿀꺽!

read_en.text: Wolf went inside and swallowed Grandmother.
read_en.key: 집 안으로 들어간 늑대가 할머니를 삼켜 버렸어요.

read_en.text: The wolf put on Grandmother's nightgown and lay down in her bed.
read_en.key: 늑대는 할머니의 잠옷을 입고 침대에 누웠어요.

read_en.text: "Heh heh, now I just have to wait for Red Hood." The wolf pulled the blanket right up to his nose.
read_en.key: "흐흐, 이제 빨간 모자만 기다리면 되겠군." 늑대는 이불을 코까지 끌어올렸어요.

read_en.text: After picking flowers, Little Red Riding Hood walked along the forest path again.
read_en.key: 꽃을 다 딴 빨간 모자는 다시 숲길을 걸어갔어요.

read_en.text: Red Hood reached Grandmother's house in the forest and knocked on the door, knock, knock, knock.
read_en.key: 빨간 모자는 숲속 할머니 집에 도착해 문을 똑똑똑 두드렸어요.

read_en.text: Come in~ A hoarse voice came from inside.
read_en.key: "들어오렴~" 안에서 쉰 목소리가 들렸어요.

read_en.text: Little Red Riding Hood opened the door and went over to the bed.
read_en.key: 빨간 모자는 문을 열고 침대 곁으로 다가갔어요.

read_en.text: Grandmother, are you here? But Grandmother in the bed looked a little odd.
read_en.key: "할머니, 오셨어요?" 그런데 침대 속 할머니가 어딘가 이상해요.

read_en.text: Grandmother, why are your ears so big?
read_en.key: "할머니, 귀가 왜 이렇게 커요?"

read_en.text: All the better to hear you with~
read_en.key: "네 말을 잘 들으려고 그렇지~"

read_en.text: Grandmother, why are your eyes so big and yellow?
read_en.key: "할머니, 눈이 왜 이렇게 노랗고 커요?"

read_en.text: All the better to see you with~
read_en.key: "너를 잘 보려고 그렇지~"

read_en.text: Grandmother, why is your mouth so long?
read_en.key: "할머니, 입이 왜 이렇게 길어요?"

read_en.text: Well, you see... Roar! Did I scare you?
read_en.key: "그건 말이지… 어흥! 놀랐지?"

read_en.text: Red Hood was startled. This is not Grandmother!
read_en.key: 빨간 모자는 깜짝 놀랐어요. 이 사람은 할머니가 아니에요!

read_en.text: The wolf jumped up!
read_en.key: 늑대가 벌떡 일어났어요!

read_en.text: Red Hood dashed, quick as a flash, over to the wardrobe.
read_en.key: 빨간 모자는 후다닥, 옷장 쪽으로 달려갔어요.

read_en.text: Red Hood slipped into the wardrobe! The wolf looked all around but could not see her.
read_en.key: 빨간 모자는 옷장 속으로 쏙! 늑대는 두리번두리번 찾았지만 보이지 않았어요.

read_en.text: It was pitch dark inside the wardrobe. Red Hood held her breath, her heart going thump, thump, thump.
read_en.key: 옷장 안은 깜깜했어요. 빨간 모자는 숨을 꼭 참고 가슴이 콩닥콩닥 뛰었지요.

read_en.text: The wolf was full from eating Grandmother, and his eyes slowly closed. Zzz...
read_en.key: 할머니를 먹어서 배가 불렀던 늑대는 스르르 눈이 감겼어요. 쿨쿨…

read_en.text: A hunter passing by the window heard the snoring.
read_en.key: 창밖으로 지나가던 사냥꾼이 코 고는 소리를 들었어요.

read_en.text: What a strange snore! Is something wrong at Grandmother's house? The hunter came into the room.
read_en.key: "이상한 코골이네? 할머니 댁에 무슨 일이 있나?" 사냥꾼이 방 안으로 들어왔어요.

read_en.text: It's a wolf! At a time like this, a tickle is the best!
read_en.key: "늑대잖아! 이럴 땐 간질간질 간지럼이 최고지!"

read_en.text: The hunter tickled the wolf's tummy, tickle, tickle, and his sides, softly, softly.
read_en.key: 사냥꾼은 늑대 배를 간질간질, 옆구리를 살살 간지럽혔어요.

read_en.text: The wolf hiccupped, hic! and Grandmother popped out, pop! Grandmother was not hurt at all!
read_en.key: 늑대가 딸꾹! 하자 할머니가 퐁! 하고 튀어나왔어요. 할머니는 다치지 않고 멀쩡했어요!

read_en.text: The wolf was so startled that Run for your life! and he ran away out the window.
read_en.key: 늑대는 깜짝 놀라서 "걸음아 날 살려라~" 하고 창밖으로 달아났어요.

read_en.text: Red Hood crept out of the wardrobe too. Grandma!
read_en.key: 빨간 모자도 옷장에서 살그머니 나왔어요. "할머니!"

read_en.text: "Oh, my sweet little one!" Grandmother hugged Red Hood tight.
read_en.key: "아이고, 우리 강아지!" 할머니는 빨간 모자를 꼭 끌어안았어요.

read_en.text: Safe at last, the three of them moved from the bedside to the table.
read_en.key: 이제 안심한 세 사람은 침대 곁에서 식탁으로 자리를 옮겼어요.

read_en.text: Everyone has tea together at Grandmother's table.
read_en.key: 할머니 집 식탁에서 모두 함께 차를 마셔요.

read_en.text: Bread for Grandmother, milk for Red Hood, and the apple for Mr. Hunter! Everyone ate happily, yum, yum.
read_en.key: 빵은 할머니, 우유는 빨간 모자, 사과는 아저씨! 모두 냠냠 맛있게 먹었어요.

read_en.text: Thank you, everyone! Grandmother smiled brightly.
read_en.key: "모두 고마워요!" 할머니는 활짝 웃었어요.

read_en.text: "I didn't listen to Mother, and I almost got into big trouble." Red Hood hung her head low.
read_en.key: "엄마 말을 안 들어서 큰일 날 뻔했어요." 빨간 모자는 고개를 푹 숙였어요.

read_en.text: I'll keep my promise now. I won't leave the path, and I won't talk to strangers.
read_en.key: "이제 약속을 꼭 지킬게요. 길에서 벗어나지 않고, 모르는 사람과는 이야기하지 않을래요."

read_en.text: Red Hood hooked her little finger again, and remembered today for a long, long time.
read_en.key: 빨간 모자는 새끼손가락을 걸고, 오늘 일을 오래오래 기억했어요.

read_en.text: A promise to Mother is a promise to keep.
read_en.key: 엄마와 한 약속은 꼭 지켜야 한답니다.

ko.text: 왕과 왕비는 오래오래 아기를 기다렸어요. 드디어 예쁜 공주님이 태어났어요!

요정과 금 접시, 어느 쪽이 더 많아요? 더 많은 쪽을 톡 눌러요.

요정은 더 많은 쪽이에요. 더 적은 쪽을 찾아봐요.
맞아요. 접시가 더 적어요. 일곱 개뿐이에요.
탑에 너무 오래 살아서 모두가 잊어버린 요정이었어요.
열여섯 살이 되면 물레 바늘에 찔려 영영 깨어나지 않는 깊은 잠에 빠질 거야.
영영이 아니에요. 백 년이 지나면 깨어날 거예요. 그리고 왕자님이 올 거예요.
공주님이 열여섯 살이 되던 날, 왕과 왕비는 멀리 나들이를 갔어요.
공주님은 성 구석구석을 돌아다니다 탑 꼭대기까지 올라갔어요.

할머니가 실을 잣고 있어요. 제일 긴 실은 어느 것일까요? 톡 눌러요.
그 실은 제일 짧아요. 제일 긴 실을 찾아봐요.
그 실보다 더 긴 실이 있어요. 다시 찾아봐요.

그 실보다 더 짧은 실이 있어요. 다시 찾아봐요.
우리 아가, 막내 요정 말대로 백 년을 자는구나.
공주님이 혼자 깨면 외로울 거야. 모두 함께 자요.

백 년이 흘렀어요. 낮과 밤이 몇 번이나 지났을까요.
저 안에 공주님이 백 년째 자고 있대요.

그날 저녁 예배당에서 결혼식을 올렸지요. 이번에는 요정 여덟 명을 모두 불렀어요. 접시도 여덟 개!

en.text: The king and queen waited a long, long time for a baby. At last, a lovely little princess was born!
Let's invite the whole kingdom and hold a feast!
The baby giggled, tee-hee!
Seven fairies were invited to be the baby's godmothers. Seven golden plates were set out for them.
But look, over there! One more fairy has come!
Fairies or golden plates, which are there more of? Tap the side that has more.
One plate for one fairy... oh, a fairy is left over. There are more fairies. Try again.
That's right. There are more fairies. One fairy has no plate.
Then which side has fewer? Tap the side that has fewer.
The fairies are the side with more. Find the side with fewer.
That's right. There are fewer plates. Only seven.
Which fairy has no plate?
It was the fairy who had lived in a tower so long that everyone had forgotten her.
There is no plate for me... They left me out.
Oh dear, I forgot. I'm sorry.
I'll speak last.
I give you a pretty face.
I give you a kind heart.
I give you sweet words.
I give you light, graceful dancing.
I give you a song like a songbird.
I give you the gift of playing the flute.
The baby smiled softly in her sleep.
When she turns sixteen, she will prick her finger on a spindle and fall into a deep sleep from which she will never wake.
Not never. After a hundred years she will wake up. And a prince will come.
Take away every spindle in the whole kingdom!
Every spindle was gone.
On the day the princess turned sixteen, the king and queen went away on a journey.
The princess wandered all around the castle, and climbed up to the very top of the tower.
Grandma, what are you doing?
I'm spinning thread, dear. Nobody told me the spindles had to go.
Grandma is spinning thread. Which thread is the longest? Tap it.
That thread is the shortest. Find the longest one.
There is a thread longer than that one. Look again.
That's right. This thread is the longest.
Then which thread is the shortest? Tap it.
That thread is the longest. Find the shortest one.
There is a thread shorter than that one. Look again.
That's right. This thread is the shortest.
Let me try too!
Ouch... I'm so sleepy...
Oh my, oh dear! Is anybody there?
My darling, just as the youngest fairy said, you will sleep a hundred years.
The princess would be lonely waking up alone. Let's all sleep together.
The candles went to sleep too, and all around the castle, a thorn hedge grew higher and higher.
A hundred years went by. How many days and nights passed?
They say a princess has been sleeping in there for a hundred years.
I'll go and see.
The thorn hedge opened a path, just for the prince.
Shh, everyone is sleeping.
The prince walked on tiptoe, as quietly as he could.
Everyone is fast asleep. Find the puppy sleeping under the table.
Not there. Look under the table.
That's right. The puppy is sleeping under the table.
Find the bird sleeping on the shelf.
Not there. Look on the shelf.
That's right. The bird is sleeping on the shelf.
Find the little boy sleeping next to the cook.
Not there. Look next to the cook.
That's right. The little cook is sleeping next to the cook.
Just then, the hundred years were up. The princess opened her eyes all by herself.
Is that you, Prince? I've waited so long.
Hello, Princess.
Everyone in the castle stretched and woke up.
That evening they were married in the chapel. This time, all eight fairies were invited. And eight plates, too!
Thank you for inviting me too.
Everyone waved and said goodbye. Bye-bye!

read_en.text: I'll speak last.
read_en.key: 나는 맨 나중에 말할래.

read_en.text: At the feast, six fairies gathered around the baby’s cradle.
read_en.key: 같은 잔치 자리에서 여섯 요정이 아기 요람을 둘러쌌어요.

read_en.text: One by one the fairies came forward and waved their wands, twinkle, twinkle.
read_en.key: 요정들이 한 명씩 다가와 지팡이를 반짝 흔들었어요.

read_en.text: I give you a pretty face.
read_en.key: 예쁜 얼굴을 줄게.

read_en.text: I give you a kind heart.
read_en.key: 상냥한 마음을 줄게.

read_en.text: I give you sweet words.
read_en.key: 고운 말씨를 줄게.

read_en.text: I give you light, graceful dancing.
read_en.key: 사뿐사뿐 춤을 줄게.

read_en.text: I give you a song like a songbird.
read_en.key: 꾀꼬리 같은 노래를 줄게.

read_en.text: I give you the gift of playing the flute.
read_en.key: 피리 솜씨를 줄게.

read_en.text: The baby smiled softly in her sleep.
read_en.key: 아기는 쌔근쌔근 웃었어요.

read_en.text: After the six fairies gave their gifts, the old fairy spoke to the baby.
read_en.key: 여섯 요정이 선물을 주자 늙은 요정이 아기에게 말했어요.

read_en.text: When she turns sixteen, she will prick her finger on a spindle and fall into a deep sleep from which she will never wake.
read_en.key: 열여섯 살이 되면 물레 바늘에 찔려 영영 깨어나지 않는 깊은 잠에 빠질 거야.

read_en.text: The king and queen gasped, and they trembled, shiver, shiver.
read_en.key: 왕과 왕비는 깜짝 놀라 부들부들 떨었어요.

read_en.text: Just then, the youngest fairy came out from behind the curtain.
read_en.key: 그때 커튼 뒤에서 막내 요정이 나왔어요.

read_en.text: Not never. After a hundred years she will wake up. And a prince will come.
read_en.key: 영영이 아니에요. 백 년이 지나면 깨어날 거예요. 그리고 왕자님이 올 거예요.

read_en.text: Take away every spindle in the whole kingdom!
read_en.key: 온 나라의 물레를 모두 치워라!

read_en.text: Rattle, rattle! The spinning wheels were loaded onto carts and taken far, far away.
read_en.key: 덜컹덜컹, 물레들이 수레에 실려 멀리멀리 떠났어요.

read_en.text: Every spindle was gone.
read_en.key: 물레는 모두 사라졌어요.

read_en.text: On the day the princess turned sixteen, the king and queen went away on a journey.
read_en.key: 공주님이 열여섯 살이 되던 날, 왕과 왕비는 멀리 나들이를 갔어요.

read_en.text: The princess wandered all around the castle, and climbed up to the very top of the tower.
read_en.key: 공주님은 성 구석구석을 돌아다니다 탑 꼭대기까지 올라갔어요.

read_en.text: The stairs wound round and round, up and up, as if they would never end.
read_en.key: 계단은 빙글빙글, 끝없이 위로 이어졌어요.

read_en.text: In the room at the top of the tower, an old woman sat at a spinning wheel.
read_en.key: 탑 꼭대기 방에서는 할머니가 물레 앞에 앉아 있었어요.

read_en.text: Grandma, what are you doing?
read_en.key: 할머니, 뭐 하세요?

read_en.text: I'm spinning thread, dear. Nobody told me the spindles had to go.
read_en.key: 실을 잣고 있단다. 물레를 치우라는 말은 못 들었거든.

read_en.text: The spinning wheel whirred round and round, and threads hung down, some long, some short.
read_en.key: 물레가 빙글빙글 돌고, 실이 길게 짧게 늘어졌어요.

read_en.text: Watching the spinning wheel, the princess spoke to the old woman.
read_en.key: 물레를 구경하던 공주님이 할머니에게 말했어요.

read_en.text: Let me try too!
read_en.key: 저도 해 볼래요!

read_en.text: The moment the princess reached out her hand, the tip of the spindle pricked her finger, prick!
read_en.key: 공주님이 손을 쑥 내민 순간, 바늘 끝이 손가락을 콕!

read_en.text: Ouch... I'm so sleepy...
read_en.key: 아야… 졸려요…

read_en.text: The princess closed her eyes and drifted off to sleep.
read_en.key: 공주님은 눈을 감고 스르르 잠이 들었어요.

read_en.text: Oh my, oh dear! Is anybody there?
read_en.key: 어머나, 큰일 났네! 누구 없어요?

read_en.text: The king and queen came running, hurry-scurry.
read_en.key: 왕과 왕비가 허둥지둥 달려왔어요.

read_en.text: The king and queen laid the sleeping princess on her bed.
read_en.key: 왕과 왕비는 잠든 공주님을 침실 침대에 눕혔어요.

read_en.text: My darling, just as the youngest fairy said, you will sleep a hundred years.
read_en.key: 우리 아가, 막내 요정 말대로 백 년을 자는구나.

read_en.text: The youngest fairy came to the princess’s bedroom and spoke softly.
read_en.key: 공주님의 침실에 온 막내 요정이 나직이 말했어요.

read_en.text: The princess would be lonely waking up alone. Let's all sleep together.
read_en.key: 공주님이 혼자 깨면 외로울 거야. 모두 함께 자요.

read_en.text: The youngest fairy gave her wand a little wave, and the puppy and the cook and everyone fell fast asleep, zzz.
read_en.key: 막내 요정이 지팡이를 살랑 흔들자, 강아지도 요리사도 쿨쿨 잠들었어요.

read_en.text: The candle went out, whoo, and the whole castle grew hushed and still.
read_en.key: 촛불이 후 꺼지고, 성 안이 조용조용해졌어요.

read_en.text: The candles went to sleep too, and all around the castle, a thorn hedge grew higher and higher.
read_en.key: 촛불도 잠들고, 성 둘레에는 가시덤불이 높이높이 자랐어요.

read_en.text: A hundred years went by. How many days and nights passed?
read_en.key: 백 년이 흘렀어요. 낮과 밤이 몇 번이나 지났을까요.

read_en.text: The tree grew tall, up, up, up, and the thorn hedge grew thicker and thicker.
read_en.key: 나무는 쑥쑥 자라고, 가시덤불은 더욱 빽빽해졌어요.

read_en.text: One day outside the castle, an old man spoke to a visiting prince.
read_en.key: 어느 날 성 밖에서, 할아버지가 찾아온 왕자에게 말했어요.

read_en.text: They say a princess has been sleeping in there for a hundred years.
read_en.key: 저 안에 공주님이 백 년째 자고 있대요.

read_en.text: I'll go and see.
read_en.key: 제가 가 볼게요.

read_en.text: As the prince came near, the thorn hedge began to stir, rustle, rustle.
read_en.key: 왕자님이 다가가자 가시덤불이 스르륵 움직였어요.

read_en.text: The thorn hedge opened a path, just for the prince.
read_en.key: 가시덤불이 왕자님에게만 길을 열어 주었어요.

read_en.text: After passing through the thorns, the prince stepped into the castle kitchen.
read_en.key: 가시덤불을 지나온 왕자님은 성 안 부엌으로 들어갔어요.

read_en.text: Shh, everyone is sleeping.
read_en.key: 쉿, 다들 자고 있어요.

read_en.text: The prince walked on tiptoe, as quietly as he could.
read_en.key: 왕자님은 발소리를 죽이고 걸었어요.

read_en.text: Under the table the puppy snored, zzz, and up on the shelf the bird nodded, nod, nod.
read_en.key: 탁자 아래에서는 강아지가 쿨쿨, 선반 위에서는 새가 꾸벅꾸벅 졸았어요.

read_en.text: Next to the cook, the little cook snored, zzz, still holding his ladle.
read_en.key: 요리사 옆에서는 꼬마 요리사가 국자를 든 채 드르렁 코를 골았어요.

read_en.text: The prince crept, creep, creep, up the stairs to find the princess's room.
read_en.key: 왕자님은 살금살금, 공주님의 방을 찾아 올라갔어요.

read_en.text: At last, the prince reached the bedroom where the princess slept.
read_en.key: 마침내 왕자님은 공주님이 잠든 침실에 도착했어요.

read_en.text: The prince knelt quietly beside the princess and waited.
read_en.key: 왕자님은 공주님 곁에 조용히 무릎을 꿇고 기다렸어요.

read_en.text: Just then, the hundred years were up. The princess opened her eyes all by herself.
read_en.key: 바로 그때, 백 년이 꽉 찼어요. 공주님이 스스로 눈을 떴어요.

read_en.text: Is that you, Prince? I've waited so long.
read_en.key: 왕자님이세요? 오래 기다렸어요.

read_en.text: Hello, Princess.
read_en.key: 안녕하세요, 공주님.

read_en.text: Everyone in the castle stretched and woke up.
read_en.key: 성 안의 모두가 기지개를 켰어요.

read_en.text: That evening they were married in the chapel. This time, all eight fairies were invited. And eight plates, too!
read_en.key: 그날 저녁 예배당에서 결혼식을 올렸지요. 이번에는 요정 여덟 명을 모두 불렀어요. 접시도 여덟 개!

read_en.text: The old fairy came to the chapel too, to wish them well.
read_en.key: 늙은 요정도 예배당에 와서 두 사람을 축하했어요.

read_en.text: Thank you for inviting me too.
read_en.key: 나도 불러 줘서 고마워.

read_en.text: Everyone waved and said goodbye. Bye-bye!
read_en.key: 모두 손을 흔들며 인사했어요. 안녕!

read_en.text: Never leave anyone out. Being forgotten makes a heart ache.
read_en.key: 아무도 빼놓지 않아야 해요. 잊힌 사람의 마음은 아프답니다.

ko.text: 옛날 어느 나라에 눈처럼 하얀 얼굴의 공주가 살았어요. 이름은 백설공주였어요.
왕비에게는 무엇이든 대답하는 신기한 거울이 있었어요.
거울아, 거울아, 이 나라에서 누가 제일 예쁘니?
공주님, 저는 도저히 못 하겠어요. 멀리멀리 달아나세요.
백설공주는 어두운 숲을 혼자 달리고 또 달렸어요.
날이 저물 무렵, 백설공주는 숲속에서 아주 작은 집을 찾았어요.
어머, 정말 작은 집이네. 계세요? 아무도 안 계세요?
삐걱, 문이 열렸어요. 집 안에는 아무도 없었어요.
작은 식탁 위에 작은 접시와 작은 컵이 나란히 놓여 있었어요.
배가 너무 고파요. 한 접시에서 다 먹으면 미안하니까, 조금씩만 먹을게요.
백설공주는 접시마다 한 입씩, 컵마다 한 모금씩 먹었어요.
의자가 정말 작네. 조금 작지만… 영차, 앉았다!
방에는 작은 침대가 나란히 놓여 있었어요.
이 침대는 너무 짧아요. 다리가 안 펴져요.
이 침대는 불편해요. 발끝이 쿵 닿아요.
몸을 동그랗게 웅크리면… 조금 작지만 포근해요. 잘 자요…
밤이 되자, 산에서 일하던 일곱 난쟁이가 집으로 돌아왔어요.
어? 내 침대에 누가 자고 있어!
깜짝이야! 저는 백설공주예요. 갈 곳이 없어요. 여기서 지내도 될까요?
백설공주는 집안일을 하고, 난쟁이들은 산에서 일했어요. 모두 사이좋게 지냈어요.
침대가 몇 개일까요? 톡 눌러 봐요.
이제 잘 시간! 난쟁이들이 침대를 찾아요.
모두 잘 자요. 함께 지내서 행복해요.
숲속 일곱 난쟁이 집의 백설공주가 제일 예뻐요.
왕비는 할머니로 변장하고 빨간 사과를 들고 숲으로 갔어요.
문은 열면 안 돼요. 난쟁이들과 약속했거든요.
백설공주는 사과를 한 입 베어 물고, 그만 스르르 잠이 들었어요.
난쟁이들은 백설공주를 맑은 유리관에 눕히고, 날마다 곁을 지켰어요.
어느 날, 이웃 나라 왕자님이 숲을 지나가다 백설공주를 보았어요.
이 공주님을 제 성으로 모셔 가 정성껏 돌보고 싶어요.
그런데 관을 옮기다가 덜컹! 목에 걸렸던 사과 조각이 툭 빠졌어요.
낯선 사람이 주는 것은 꼭 어른에게 먼저 물어봐요.

en.text: Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there lived a princess with a face as white as snow. Her name was Snow White.
The queen had a magic mirror that could answer any question.
Mirror, mirror, who is the fairest in the land?
The queen is lovely, but Snow White is even lovelier.
The queen was so jealous that her face turned red.
I must be the fairest! Call the hunter!
The hunter led Snow White deep into the forest.
Princess, I just cannot do it. Run far, far away.
Thank you, mister.
Snow White ran and ran through the dark forest, all alone.
As evening fell, Snow White found a tiny house in the woods.
Oh, what a tiny house! Hello? Is anybody home?
Shall we knock on the door? Tap!
Creeak, the door opened. There was nobody inside.
On a tiny table sat tiny plates and tiny cups, all in a row.
I am so hungry. It would be rude to eat everything from one plate, so I will only eat a little.
Snow White took one bite from each plate and one sip from each cup.
Oh, the chair is so small. A little tight, but... heave-ho, I sat down!
Haaaam, I am so sleepy.
In the next room, tiny beds stood side by side.
This bed is too short. My legs won't stretch out.
This bed is uncomfortable. My toes bump the end.
If I curl up round... it is a little small, but so cozy. Good night...
Snow White drifted off to sleep.
At night, the seven dwarfs came home from working in the mountains.
Who sat in my chair?
Who ate from my plate?
Who ate my bread?
Who used my spoon?
Who used my fork?
Who drank from my cup?
Hey! Someone is sleeping in my bed!
In the morning, Snow White opened her eyes.
Oh my! I am Snow White. I have nowhere to go. May I stay here?
Yes, I promise!
Snow White did the housework, and the dwarfs worked in the mountains. They all got along happily.
Bang-bang, thump-thump!
Wow, thank you!
How many beds are there? Tap to find out!
Time for bed! The dwarfs are looking for their beds.
Shall we find the red bed?
That is the red bed.
That's right, the red bed!
Shall we find the orange bed?
That is the orange bed.
That's right, the orange bed!
Shall we find the yellow bed?
That is the yellow bed.
That's right, the yellow bed!
Shall we find the green bed?
That is the green bed.
That's right, the green bed!
Shall we find the blue bed?
That is the blue bed.
That's right, the blue bed!
Shall we find the purple bed?
That is the purple bed.
That's right, the purple bed!
Shall we find the brown bed?
That is the brown bed.
That's right, the brown bed!
Good night, everyone. I am so happy to be together.
Snow White, in the seven dwarfs' house in the forest, is the fairest.
The queen disguised herself as an old woman and went into the forest with a red apple.
Apples for sale! Such delicious apples, dear.
I must not open the door. I promised the dwarfs.
Then just take one little taste through the window, dear.
Snow White took one bite of the apple, and drifted off to sleep.
The dwarfs came home in the evening and were startled.
They laid Snow White in a clear glass coffin and kept watch beside her every day.
One day, a prince from a neighboring kingdom rode through the forest and saw Snow White.
I would like to take this princess to my castle and take good care of her.
But as they carried the coffin, bump! The piece of apple stuck in her throat popped out.
Shall we tap Snow White's hand?
Oh my, I must have slept for a long time.
You are all right now. Let us go to the castle together.
Always ask a grown-up first before taking anything from a stranger.
The queen went far, far away.

read_ko.text: 숲속 언덕에서 유리관 뚜껑이 열렸어요. 난쟁이들과 왕자가 곁에서 지켜보았어요.
read_ko.key: 숲속 언덕에서 유리관 뚜껑이 열렸어요. 난쟁이들과 왕자가 곁에서 지켜보았어요.

read_ko.text: 백설공주의 손가락이 꼼지락꼼지락 움직였어요.
read_ko.key: 백설공주의 손가락이 꼼지락꼼지락 움직였어요.

read_ko.text: 어머, 제가 오래 잤나 봐요.
read_ko.key: 어머, 제가 오래 잤나 봐요.

read_ko.text: 백설공주가 눈을 뜨자, 왕자가 다정하게 말했어요.
read_ko.key: 백설공주가 눈을 뜨자, 왕자가 다정하게 말했어요.

read_ko.text: 이제 괜찮아요. 함께 성으로 가요.
read_ko.key: 이제 괜찮아요. 함께 성으로 가요.

read_ko.text: 만세! 백설공주가 깨어났다!
read_ko.key: 만세! 백설공주가 깨어났다!

read_ko.text: 난쟁이들은 깡충깡충 뛰며 손뼉을 짝짝 쳤어요.
read_ko.key: 난쟁이들은 깡충깡충 뛰며 손뼉을 짝짝 쳤어요.

read_ko.text: 왕비는 멀리 떠났어요
read_ko.key: 왕비는 멀리 떠났어요

read_ko.text: 낯선 사람이 주는 것은 꼭 어른에게 먼저 물어봐요.
read_ko.key: 낯선 사람이 주는 것은 꼭 어른에게 먼저 물어봐요.

read_en.text: Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there lived a princess with a face as white as snow. Her name was Snow White.
read_en.key: 옛날 어느 나라에 눈처럼 하얀 얼굴의 공주가 살았어요. 이름은 백설공주였어요.

read_en.text: Snow White had a kind heart, and her laugh rang out clear as a little bell.
read_en.key: 백설공주는 마음씨가 곱고, 웃음소리가 방울처럼 또랑또랑했어요.

read_en.text: In a room in the castle, the queen stood before her magic mirror.
read_en.key: 궁 안의 방에서 왕비가 신기한 거울 앞에 섰어요.

read_en.text: The queen had a magic mirror that could answer any question.
read_en.key: 왕비에게는 무엇이든 대답하는 신기한 거울이 있었어요.

read_en.text: Mirror, mirror, who is the fairest in the land?
read_en.key: 거울아, 거울아, 이 나라에서 누가 제일 예쁘니?

read_en.text: The queen is lovely, but Snow White is even lovelier.
read_en.key: 왕비님도 예쁘지만, 백설공주가 더 예뻐요.

read_en.text: The queen was so jealous that her face turned red.
read_en.key: 왕비는 샘이 나서 얼굴이 빨개졌어요.

read_en.text: The queen stamped her feet, stomp, stomp, and glared at the mirror.
read_en.key: 왕비는 발을 쿵쿵 구르며 거울을 노려보았어요.

read_en.text: I must be the fairest! Call the hunter!
read_en.key: 내가 제일이어야 해! 사냥꾼을 불러라!

read_en.text: The queen shouted at the hunter. Take Snow White deep into the forest and leave her there!
read_en.key: 왕비는 사냥꾼에게 소리쳤어요. 백설공주를 깊은 숲에 데려가서 버리고 오너라!

read_en.text: The hunter took Snow White by the hand, and off they went to the forest.
read_en.key: 사냥꾼은 백설공주의 손을 잡고 숲으로 떠났어요.

read_en.text: The hunter led Snow White deep into the forest.
read_en.key: 사냥꾼은 백설공주를 깊은 숲으로 데려갔어요.

read_en.text: The forest was dark, and the branches stuck out this way and that, all jagged and spiky.
read_en.key: 숲은 깜깜하고, 나뭇가지가 삐죽삐죽 뻗어 있었어요.

read_en.text: The hunter's hands trembled and shook.
read_en.key: 사냥꾼의 손이 부들부들 떨렸어요.

read_en.text: Princess, I just cannot do it. Run far, far away.
read_en.key: 공주님, 저는 도저히 못 하겠어요. 멀리멀리 달아나세요.

read_en.text: Thank you, mister.
read_en.key: 고맙습니다, 아저씨.

read_en.text: Snow White ran and ran through the dark forest, all alone.
read_en.key: 백설공주는 어두운 숲을 혼자 달리고 또 달렸어요.

read_en.text: Her skirt caught on the thorn bushes, rip, rip, and an owl hooted, hoo, hoo.
read_en.key: 가시덤불에 치마가 북북 걸리고, 부엉이가 부엉부엉 울었어요.

read_en.text: As evening fell, Snow White found a tiny house in the woods.
read_en.key: 날이 저물 무렵, 백설공주는 숲속에서 아주 작은 집을 찾았어요.

read_en.text: The chimney was small, the windows were small, and the door was very small too.
read_en.key: 굴뚝도 작고, 창문도 작고, 문도 아주 작았어요.

read_en.text: Snow White stood on her tiptoes and peeked, peek-a-boo, through the window.
read_en.key: 백설공주는 발끝을 들고 창문 안을 빼꼼 들여다보았어요.

read_en.text: Oh, what a tiny house! Hello? Is anybody home?
read_en.key: 어머, 정말 작은 집이네. 계세요? 아무도 안 계세요?

read_en.text: Snow White knocked on the door, knock, knock. There was no answer at all.
read_en.key: 백설공주는 문을 똑똑 두드렸어요. 아무 대답이 없었어요.

read_en.text: Creeak, the door opened. There was nobody inside.
read_en.key: 삐걱, 문이 열렸어요. 집 안에는 아무도 없었어요.

read_en.text: Snow White tiptoed, creep, creep, into the house.
read_en.key: 백설공주는 살금살금 집 안으로 들어갔어요.

read_en.text: Snow White stepped inside, tiptoe, tiptoe, and went to the little table.
read_en.key: 집 안으로 들어온 백설공주는 작은 식탁 앞으로 갔어요.

read_en.text: On a tiny table sat tiny plates and tiny cups, all in a row.
read_en.key: 작은 식탁 위에 작은 접시와 작은 컵이 나란히 놓여 있었어요.

read_en.text: Seven little plates, seven little cups, and seven little chairs.
read_en.key: 접시도 일곱 개, 컵도 일곱 개, 작은 의자도 일곱 개였어요.

read_en.text: I am so hungry. It would be rude to eat everything from one plate, so I will only eat a little.
read_en.key: 배가 너무 고파요. 한 접시에서 다 먹으면 미안하니까, 조금씩만 먹을게요.

read_en.text: Snow White took one bite from each plate and one sip from each cup.
read_en.key: 백설공주는 접시마다 한 입씩, 컵마다 한 모금씩 먹었어요.

read_en.text: Oh, the chair is so small. A little tight, but... heave-ho, I sat down!
read_en.key: 의자가 정말 작네. 조금 작지만… 영차, 앉았다!

read_en.text: Haaaam, I am so sleepy.
read_en.key: 하아암, 너무 졸려요.

read_en.text: Snow White rubbed her eyes and her head began to nod, nod, nod.
read_en.key: 백설공주는 눈을 비비며 꾸벅꾸벅 졸았어요.

read_en.text: Sleepy Snow White, yawn, left the table and went to the room with the beds.
read_en.key: 졸린 백설공주는 식탁을 떠나 침대가 있는 방으로 갔어요.

read_en.text: In the next room, tiny beds stood side by side.
read_en.key: 방에는 작은 침대가 나란히 놓여 있었어요.

read_en.text: This bed is too short. My legs won't stretch out.
read_en.key: 이 침대는 너무 짧아요. 다리가 안 펴져요.

read_en.text: This bed is uncomfortable. My toes bump the end.
read_en.key: 이 침대는 불편해요. 발끝이 쿵 닿아요.

read_en.text: Snow White rolled, roly-poly, from this bed to that bed.
read_en.key: 백설공주는 이 침대 저 침대 데굴데굴 굴러 보았어요.

read_en.text: If I curl up round... it is a little small, but so cozy. Good night...
read_en.key: 몸을 동그랗게 웅크리면… 조금 작지만 포근해요. 잘 자요…

read_en.text: The blanket was snug and cozy, and the pillow was soft and squishy.
read_en.key: 이불은 포근포근, 베개는 말랑말랑했어요.

read_en.text: Snow White drifted off to sleep.
read_en.key: 백설공주는 스르르 잠이 들었어요.

read_en.text: Outside the window the stars went twinkle, twinkle, and inside the house all was quiet, with soft little breaths.
read_en.key: 창밖에는 별이 반짝반짝, 집 안은 쌔근쌔근 조용했어요.

read_en.text: At night, the seven dwarfs came home from working in the mountains.
read_en.key: 밤이 되자, 산에서 일하던 일곱 난쟁이가 집으로 돌아왔어요.

read_en.text: The dwarfs came in, tromp, tromp, their lanterns swinging to and fro.
read_en.key: 난쟁이들은 등불을 흔들흔들 들고, 뚜벅뚜벅 들어왔어요.

read_en.text: The dwarfs looked all around the house, and one by one, they spoke.
read_en.key: 난쟁이들은 집 안을 둘러보며 한 명씩 말했어요.

read_en.text: Who sat in my chair?
read_en.key: 누가 내 의자에 앉았지?

read_en.text: Who ate from my plate?
read_en.key: 누가 내 접시에서 먹었지?

read_en.text: Who ate my bread?
read_en.key: 누가 내 빵을 먹었지?

read_en.text: Who used my spoon?
read_en.key: 누가 내 숟가락을 썼지?

read_en.text: Who used my fork?
read_en.key: 누가 내 포크를 썼지?

read_en.text: Who drank from my cup?
read_en.key: 누가 내 컵으로 마셨지?

read_en.text: Hey! Someone is sleeping in my bed!
read_en.key: 어? 내 침대에 누가 자고 있어!

read_en.text: Wow, what a pretty girl! Let's not wake her. Shh!
read_en.key: 와아, 정말 예쁜 아이다! 깨우지 말자, 쉿!

read_en.text: The morning sunlight came sparkling in through the window.
read_en.key: 아침 햇살이 창문으로 반짝 들어왔어요.

read_en.text: In the morning, Snow White opened her eyes.
read_en.key: 아침이 되자 백설공주가 눈을 떴어요.

read_en.text: The seven dwarfs were gathered by the bed. Snow White said to the dwarfs,
read_en.key: 침대 곁에는 일곱 난쟁이가 모여 있었어요. 백설공주가 난쟁이들에게 말했어요.

read_en.text: Oh my! I am Snow White. I have nowhere to go. May I stay here?
read_en.key: 깜짝이야! 저는 백설공주예요. 갈 곳이 없어요. 여기서 지내도 될까요?

read_en.text: Of course! But while we are away at work, never open the door to a stranger!
read_en.key: 그럼! 대신 우리가 일하러 간 사이, 낯선 사람에겐 절대 문을 열지 마!

read_en.text: Yes, I promise!
read_en.key: 네, 약속할게요.

read_en.text: The dwarfs shouldered their pickaxes and tramped off, tromp, tromp, to work in the mountains.
read_en.key: 난쟁이들은 곡괭이를 메고 뚜벅뚜벅 산으로 일하러 갔어요.

read_en.text: Snow White did the housework, and the dwarfs worked in the mountains. They all got along happily.
read_en.key: 백설공주는 집안일을 하고, 난쟁이들은 산에서 일했어요. 모두 사이좋게 지냈어요.

read_en.text: Snow White swept and scrubbed, swish, swish, and cooked soup that went bubble, bubble.
read_en.key: 백설공주는 싹싹 쓸고 닦고, 보글보글 국도 끓였어요.

read_en.text: One day, the dwarfs came home and gathered in the room with the beds.
read_en.key: 어느 날, 집에 돌아온 난쟁이들이 침대가 있는 방에 모였어요.

read_en.text: Our beds are too small for Snow White. Let's make her a big bed!
read_en.key: 백설공주에게는 우리 침대가 너무 작아. 큰 침대를 만들어 주자!

read_en.text: Bang-bang, thump-thump!
read_en.key: 뚝딱뚝딱, 쿵쿵!

read_en.text: Next to the seven little beds, ta-da! There stood a great big bed.
read_en.key: 작은 침대 일곱 개 옆에, 커다란 침대가 짠! 하고 놓였어요.

read_en.text: Wow, thank you!
read_en.key: 와아, 고맙습니다!

read_en.text: Good night, everyone. I am so happy to be together.
read_en.key: 모두 잘 자요. 함께 지내서 행복해요.

read_en.text: That night they all went off to dreamland, snoring, zzz, zzz.
read_en.key: 그날 밤은 모두 드르렁 쿨쿨, 꿈나라로 갔어요.

read_en.text: Meanwhile, back at the castle, the queen stood before her mirror again.
read_en.key: 한편, 궁 안의 왕비는 다시 거울 앞에 섰어요.

read_en.text: Mirror, mirror, who is the fairest in the land?
read_en.key: 거울아, 거울아, 이 나라에서 누가 제일 예쁘니?

read_en.text: Snow White, in the seven dwarfs' house in the forest, is the fairest.
read_en.key: 숲속 일곱 난쟁이 집의 백설공주가 제일 예뻐요.

read_en.text: The queen shook with anger, and she thought up a wicked plan.
read_en.key: 왕비는 부들부들 떨며 나쁜 꾀를 생각해 냈어요.

read_en.text: The queen disguised herself as an old woman and went into the forest with a red apple.
read_en.key: 왕비는 할머니로 변장하고 빨간 사과를 들고 숲으로 갔어요.

read_en.text: At the window of the little house in the forest, an old woman called to Snow White. Knock, knock!
read_en.key: 숲속 작은 집 창가에서 할머니가 백설공주를 불렀어요.

read_en.text: Apples for sale! Such delicious apples, dear.
read_en.key: 사과 사세요~ 아주 맛있는 사과란다.

read_en.text: I must not open the door. I promised the dwarfs.
read_en.key: 문은 열면 안 돼요. 난쟁이들과 약속했거든요.

read_en.text: Then just take one little taste through the window, dear.
read_en.key: 그럼 창문으로 하나만 맛보렴.

read_en.text: But uh-oh! The old woman's apple had a sleeping potion in it. One bite, and you fall fast asleep.
read_en.key: 할머니가 가져온 사과에는 먹으면 깊이 잠드는 약이 들어 있었어요.

read_en.text: The apple was bright red and shiny, and it looked so very yummy.
read_en.key: 사과는 새빨갛고 반질반질, 아주 맛있어 보였어요.

read_en.text: Snow White took the apple through the window.
read_en.key: 백설공주는 창문으로 사과를 받았어요.

read_en.text: Snow White took one bite of the apple, and drifted off to sleep.
read_en.key: 백설공주는 사과를 한 입 베어 물고, 그만 스르르 잠이 들었어요.

read_en.text: Thump! Snow White fell down under the window. And the queen, dressed as an old woman, ran away.
read_en.key: 백설공주가 창문 아래로 쓰러졌어요. 할머니로 변장한 왕비는 떠나 버렸어요.

read_en.text: The dwarfs came home in the evening and were startled.
read_en.key: 저녁에 돌아온 난쟁이들은 깜짝 놀랐어요.

read_en.text: Snow White was lying on the floor. They called her name, but she did not open her eyes.
read_en.key: 집 안에는 백설공주가 쓰러져 있었어요. 불러도 눈을 뜨지 않았어요.

read_en.text: Snow White, wake up! Please wake up...
read_en.key: 백설공주님, 일어나요! 일어나세요…

read_en.text: The dwarfs sniffled and sobbed as they gently lifted Snow White up.
read_en.key: 난쟁이들은 훌쩍훌쩍 울며 백설공주를 안아 들었어요.

read_en.text: They laid Snow White in a clear glass coffin and kept watch beside her every day.
read_en.key: 난쟁이들은 백설공주를 맑은 유리관에 눕히고, 날마다 곁을 지켰어요.

read_en.text: The glass coffin was set on a hill in the forest. The dwarfs stayed close beside sleeping Snow White.
read_en.key: 숲속 언덕에 유리관이 놓였어요. 난쟁이들은 잠든 백설공주 곁에 머물렀어요.

read_en.text: The glass coffin sparkled in the sunlight, and little birds fluttered down to sit beside it.
read_en.key: 유리관은 햇빛을 받아 반짝반짝 빛나고, 새들도 포르르 날아와 곁에 앉았어요.

read_en.text: One day, a prince from a neighboring kingdom rode through the forest and saw Snow White.
read_en.key: 어느 날, 이웃 나라 왕자님이 숲을 지나가다 백설공주를 보았어요.

read_en.text: I would like to take this princess to my castle and take good care of her.
read_en.key: 이 공주님을 제 성으로 모셔 가 정성껏 돌보고 싶어요.

read_en.text: But as they carried the coffin, bump! The piece of apple stuck in her throat popped out.
read_en.key: 그런데 관을 옮기다가 덜컹! 목에 걸렸던 사과 조각이 툭 빠졌어요.

read_en.text: On the forest hill, the lid of the glass coffin opened. Creak! The dwarfs and the prince watched closely.
read_en.key: 숲속 언덕에서 유리관 뚜껑이 열렸어요. 난쟁이들과 왕자가 곁에서 지켜보았어요.

read_en.text: Snow White's fingers began to wiggle, wiggle.
read_en.key: 백설공주의 손가락이 꼼지락꼼지락 움직였어요.

read_en.text: Oh my, I must have slept for a long time.
read_en.key: 어머, 제가 오래 잤나 봐요.

read_en.text: When Snow White opened her eyes, the prince spoke to her gently.
read_en.key: 백설공주가 눈을 뜨자, 왕자가 다정하게 말했어요.

read_en.text: You are all right now. Let us go to the castle together.
read_en.key: 이제 괜찮아요. 함께 성으로 가요.

read_en.text: Hooray! Snow White is awake!

en.text: High up in the sky lived the Sun and the Wind.
Shall we tap the Sun?
Tap the smiling Sun!
"I'm the warmest!"
Now tap the Wind!
Tap the puffy-cheeked Wind!
"No way, I'm the strongest!"
The Sun and the Wind both say they're the best.
A traveler is walking down the road below.
The traveler is wearing a thick coat.
The Wind said, "Whoever makes that coat come off first wins!"
The Sun smiled. "Okay. Wind, you go first."
The Wind puffed out big, round cheeks.
Tap the Wind to blow!
Tap the Wind and blow!
Stronger now! Tap!
Whoosh~ The leaves are flying away!
"Oh no, my hat!" The hat flew far, far away.
The coat flap-flap-flaps!
"Brrr, it's cold!" The traveler held the coat tight.
Every button is buttoned up tight. The coat won't budge!
The Wind blew even harder. Swish!
The Wind ran out of breath, huff puff, and its cheeks went all wrinkly.
"Aw, it's not working!"
Oh? The hat that flew away dropped right onto the traveler's head!
Now it's the Sun's turn.
Tap the Sun to shine nice and warm!
Tap the Sun!
"Ahh, so warm~" The traveler unbuttoned the coat.
A little more tapping!
"Phew, it's hot!" The traveler fans with the hat.
Tap one more time!
Off it goes! The traveler took off the coat!
The Wind was so surprised. "Wow, the Sun did it!"
When the Wind blew, the traveler held the coat tight.
When the Sun shone, the traveler took the coat off.
Who made the traveler take off the coat? Was it the Sun, or the Wind?
Who made the traveler take off the coat?
Look at the sky by the traveler without the coat!
It's the Sun! Tap the sparkling Sun!
That's right, it's the Sun! The warm Sun won!
Being gentle is stronger than pushing hard.
What should we wear on a snowy day?
On cold days, warm clothes are best.
The coat! Tap the sparkling one!
That's right! Wearing a warm coat feels so cozy.
What should we wear on a bright, sunny day?
On hot days, cool clothes are best.
The short sleeves! Tap the sparkling one!
That's right! Wearing short sleeves feels so cool.
When it's cold, put it on. When it's hot, take it off.
The traveler is resting by the stream.
The traveler dipped both feet into the cool water, splash!
Wind, could you blow gently this time? Tap, gently~
Tap the Wind gently!
"Ahh, so cool. Thank you, Wind!"
The Sun and the Wind looked at each other and smiled.
"Let's be good friends!"
Shall we tap the sky to change the weather?
The clothes change by themselves, too!
The Sun and the Wind watch over the sky together again today.
Kindness is the strongest power of all. The end!
