read_en.key: 후우! 바람이 힘껏 불자 풀잎이 휘청휘청 흔들렸어요.

read_en.text: Whoosh~ The leaves are flying away!
read_en.key: 휘잉~ 나뭇잎이 날아가요!

read_en.text: "Oh no, my hat!" The hat flew far, far away.
read_en.key: "앗, 내 모자!" 모자가 훨훨 날아갔어요.

read_en.text: The coat flap-flap-flaps!
read_en.key: 외투 자락이 펄럭펄럭!

read_en.text: "Brrr, it's cold!" The traveler held the coat tight.
read_en.key: "으으, 추워!" 나그네는 외투를 꽉 여몄어요.

read_en.text: Every button is buttoned up tight. The coat won't budge!
read_en.key: 단추까지 꼭꼭 채웠어요. 외투는 꼼짝도 안 해요!

read_en.text: The traveler hunched over and wobbled along, this way and that.
read_en.key: 나그네는 몸을 웅크리고 비틀비틀 걸어갔어요.

read_en.text: The traveler was still walking along the field path.
read_en.key: 나그네는 아직 그 들판 길을 걷고 있었어요.

read_en.text: The Wind blew even harder. Swish!
read_en.key: 바람은 더 세게 불었어요. 쓱!

read_en.text: But the traveler held his coat tight and did not budge one bit.
read_en.key: 하지만 나그네는 외투를 꼭 붙잡고 끄떡도 하지 않았어요.

read_en.text: The Wind ran out of breath, huff puff, and its cheeks went all wrinkly.
read_en.key: 바람은 숨이 차서 헉헉, 볼이 쭈글쭈글해졌어요.

read_en.text: "Aw, it's not working!"
read_en.key: "에이, 안 되네!"

read_en.text: Oh? The hat that flew away dropped right onto the traveler's head!
read_en.key: 어? 날아간 모자가 나그네 머리에 쏙 떨어졌어요!

read_en.text: The traveler put his hat back on and walked on, clomp, clomp.
read_en.key: 나그네는 모자를 다시 쓰고 뚜벅뚜벅 걸어갔어요.

read_en.text: Now it's the Sun's turn.
read_en.key: 이번엔 해님 차례예요.

read_en.text: The traveler was in the field, where the Wind had stopped blowing.
read_en.key: 바람이 멈춘 들판에 나그네가 있었어요.

read_en.text: The Sun smiled brightly and poured down warm sunshine, twinkle, twinkle.
read_en.key: 해님이 방긋 웃으며 따스한 햇살을 반짝반짝 쏟아 주었어요.

read_en.text: "Ahh, so warm~" The traveler unbuttoned the coat.
read_en.key: "아, 따뜻하다~" 나그네가 단추를 풀었어요.

read_en.text: The sunshine grew hotter and hotter, blazing bright, and little beads of sweat popped up on the traveler's forehead.
read_en.key: 햇살이 점점 쨍쨍, 나그네 이마에 땀이 송골송골 맺혔어요.

read_en.text: "Phew, it's hot!" The traveler fans with the hat.
read_en.key: "아이, 더워!" 모자로 부채질을 해요.

read_en.text: Phew! With the sun blazing like this, I do not need this coat.
read_en.key: "휴우, 햇볕이 쨍쨍하니 외투는 필요 없겠네."

read_en.text: Off it goes! The traveler took off the coat!
read_en.key: 훌러덩! 나그네가 외투를 벗었어요!

read_en.text: The Wind was so surprised. "Wow, the Sun did it!"
read_en.key: 바람이 깜짝 놀랐어요. "우와, 해님이 해냈네!"

read_en.text: The Sun and the Wind looked down at the traveler with his coat off.
read_en.key: 외투를 벗은 나그네 위로 해님과 바람이 내려다보았어요.

read_en.text: When the Wind blew, the traveler held the coat tight.
read_en.key: 바람이 불 때, 나그네는 외투를 꽉 여몄어요.

read_en.text: When the Sun shone, the traveler took the coat off.
read_en.key: 해님이 비출 때는 외투를 벗었지요.

read_en.text: The Wind scratched its head, scritch, scratch, and the Sun grinned from ear to ear.
read_en.key: 바람은 머리를 긁적긁적, 해님은 싱글벙글 웃었어요.

read_en.text: Being gentle is stronger than pushing hard.
read_en.key: 세게 미는 것보다 다정한 게 더 힘이 세요.

read_en.text: The traveler looked up at the Sun and gave a big, happy smile.
read_en.key: 나그네는 해님을 올려다보며 방긋 웃었어요.

read_en.text: The traveler followed the path to a stream.
read_en.key: 길을 걷던 나그네가 개울가에 다다랐어요.

read_en.text: The traveler is resting by the stream.
read_en.key: 나그네는 개울가에서 쉬어요.

read_en.text: The traveler dipped both feet into the cool water, splash!
read_en.key: 시원한 물에 발을 퐁당 담갔어요.

read_en.text: The stream babbled and burbled, and the traveler hummed a happy little tune.
read_en.key: 졸졸졸 흐르는 물소리에 나그네는 콧노래를 흥얼흥얼.

read_en.text: Wind, could you blow gently this time?
read_en.key: 바람아, 이번엔 살살 불어 줄래?

read_en.text: Whisper, whisper~ A soft breeze tickled the traveler's cheeks.
read_en.key: 살랑살랑~ 부드러운 바람이 나그네 뺨을 간질였어요.

read_en.text: "Ahh, so cool. Thank you, Wind!"
read_en.key: "아, 시원해. 고마워, 바람아!"

read_en.text: The traveler rolled up his coat for a pillow and flopped down with a happy sigh.
read_en.key: 나그네는 외투를 돌돌 말아 베고 벌렁 드러누웠어요.

read_en.text: While the traveler rested, the Sun and the Wind met in the sky.
read_en.key: 나그네가 쉬는 동안, 하늘에서는 해님과 바람이 만났어요.

read_en.text: The Sun and the Wind looked at each other and smiled.
read_en.key: 해님과 바람이 마주 보고 웃었어요.

read_en.text: They held hands tight and shook them up and down, up and down.
read_en.key: 둘은 손을 꼭 잡고 흔들흔들, 악수를 했어요.

read_en.text: "Let's be good friends!"
read_en.key: "우리, 사이좋게 지내자!"

read_en.text: Yes! Together, we are even better!
read_en.key: "그래! 둘이 함께라면 더 좋아!"

read_en.text: The Sun twinkled, the Wind whispered softly, and the whole sky grew bright.
read_en.key: 해님은 반짝반짝, 바람은 살랑살랑, 하늘이 환해졌어요.

read_en.text: The Sun and the Wind watch over the sky together again today.
read_en.key: 해님과 바람은 오늘도 사이좋게 하늘을 지켜요.

read_en.text: Kindness is the strongest power of all. The end!
read_en.key: 다정한 마음이 제일 힘이 세답니다. 끝!

read_en.text: Once upon a time, a mom and her two children, a brother and a sister, lived in a little hut in the mountains.

read_en.text: Swish, swish, she washed the rice. Crackle, crackle, she fed the fire. And puff, puff, she steamed the rice cakes.

read_en.text: When evening came, the lady of the house gave her a big armful of soft, squishy rice cakes.

read_en.text: Thank you for your hard work. Take these rice cakes!

read_en.text: The sun is slowly setting. Mom is crossing the first hill.

read_en.text: Then, from behind the rock, something popped out! It was a great big tiger.

read_en.text: "Roar! Give me two rice cakes, and I won't eat you!"

read_en.text: Mom fumbled in the basket and took out two rice cakes for the tiger.

read_en.text: Hold on tight and climb, heave-ho!

read_en.text: Up through the clouds, whoosh, whoosh!

read_en.text: Through six layers of clouds, the brother and sister reached the land in the sky!

read_en.text: The children were gone, and the tiger was left in the tree.
read_en.key: 오누이가 떠난 나무에 호랑이만 남았어요.

read_en.text: The tiger prayed to the sky too. And an old rope slid slowly down.
read_en.key: 호랑이도 하늘에 빌었어요. 그랬더니 낡은 줄이 스르르 내려왔어요.

read_en.text: "Roar! I am going up too!" The tiger was thrilled and grabbed the rope.
read_en.key: "어흥, 나도 올라가야지!" 호랑이는 신이 나서 줄을 덥석 잡았어요.

read_en.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho, the tiger climbed up the old rope.

read_en.text: Creak, creak... Snap! The old rope broke right in two.

read_en.text: The tiger tumbled down into the sorghum field with a great big thump!

read_en.text: "Ouch, my bottom! Ouch, my head!" A round bump popped up on the tiger's head.

read_en.text: The tiger ran off into the mountains with a bump on its head! And they say it never came back again.

read_en.text: Meanwhile, the children were safe together in the sky.

read_en.text: In the land in the sky, the brother became the Sun, and the sister became the Moon.
read_en.key: 하늘 나라에 간 오빠는 해님이, 동생은 달님이 되었어요.

read_en.text: The brother shone bright and blazing in the day, and the sister glowed softly at night.
read_en.key: 오빠는 낮에 쨍쨍 환하게, 동생은 밤에 은은하게 세상을 비추었지요.

read_en.text: The sister said, "Big brother, I am scared of the night."
read_en.key: 동생이 말했어요. "오빠, 나는 밤이 무서워요."

read_en.text: "Then let's switch!"
read_en.key: "그럼 우리 바꾸자!"

read_en.text: The brother smiled a big smile and gladly switched places.
read_en.key: 오빠는 싱긋 웃으며 기꺼이 자리를 바꿔 주었어요.

read_en.text: So the sister became the Sun, and the brother became the Moon.
read_en.key: 그래서 동생은 해님, 오빠는 달님이 되었답니다.

read_en.text: Even today, the Sun and the Moon shine brightly on us from the sky.
read_en.key: 해님 달님은 오늘도 하늘에서 우리를 환하게 비춰 준답니다.

read_en.text: When a brother and sister care for each other and stick together, they can get through even the scariest night.

en.text: Once upon a time, three little pigs lived together.
Mother Pig said. You are all grown up now. Go out into the world and build a house of your own.
Tap a little pig.
The three brothers said goodbye to Mother and set off on the road.
Look carefully at the little pigs' clothes.
Which pig is wearing a scarf?
Which pig is wearing a yellow hat?
Which pig is wearing a white hat?
Which pig is wearing blue overalls?
Which pig is wearing red overalls?
That's right! This is the pig.
Look once more, carefully.
Tap the sparkling pig.
At the shop, they decided to try blowing wind.
Straw flies away. It is very light.
Wood wobbles! It is a little bit strong.
Bricks don't budge! They are very, very strong.
Tap with your finger to blow the wind.
Tap what you want to build with.
The first pig decided to build with straw. Tap, tap, tap, stack the straw!
Ta-da! The straw house is done. The first pig played his flute.
The second pig decided to build with wood. Tap, tap, tap, tap, tap with the hammer!
Bang, bang! The wood house is done. The second pig played his violin.
His brothers teased him. Still building? Come and play with us! But the third pig kept stacking bricks, slowly.
The third pig decided to build with bricks. Bricks are heavy, so stack ten of them slowly.
He stacked all ten bricks. A strong brick house is done!
Tap, tap with your finger and blow, hoo, together with the wolf.
Then a hungry wolf came along, sniff, sniff. Little pig, little pig, open the door!
The first pig said. No, no, no! The wolf said. Then I'll huff and puff and blow it away!
The straw house flew away!
The first pig ran to his brother's house.
Then the wolf came to the wood house too. Little pig, little pig, open the door!
The first and second pigs said. No, no, no! The wolf said. Then I'll huff and puff and blow it down!
The wood house tumbled down!
The two little pigs ran to their youngest brother's house.
The two brothers were out of breath, huff, puff! Which house should they go to?
Pick the strongest house!
Straw is too light. Try again.
The brick house is the strongest!
That's right! It's the strongest brick house. The three brothers shut the door tight.
All three brothers were together. Shall we count them: one, two, three?
Tap a little pig.
We're together, all three. I'm not scared!
The wolf came to the brick house. Little pig, little pig, open the door!
No, no, no! Then I'll huff and puff and blow!
Tap the house to count how many times he blows.
Huff, puff! He blew eight times, but the brick house did not budge!
The wolf was out of breath and plopped down.
The wolf crept up onto the roof. He wanted to sneak in through the chimney.
The little pigs boiled water in a big pot.
Tap, tap the fire to make it bigger.
Bubble, bubble, the water is boiling! Then the wolf slid down the chimney.
Ouch, it's hot!
The wolf whooshed up the chimney and ran far, far away. He never came back.
The wolf never came again. The little pigs built more brick houses.
Tap the house to build a new one.
One, two, three! Now there were three strong brick houses.
The three brothers lived happily in their strong houses for a long, long time.

read_en.text: Heave-ho! Grandpa pulled hard on the leaves.
read_en.key: 영차! 할아버지가 잎을 힘껏 당겼어요.

read_en.text: The turnip won't budge.
read_en.key: 순무는 꿈쩍도 안 해요.

read_en.text: Oof! Grandpa plopped down on the ground.
read_en.key: 아이코! 할아버지가 엉덩방아를 찧었어요.

read_en.text: Grandpa can't do it alone. Grandpa calls Grandma!
read_en.key: 혼자서는 안 되겠어요. 할아버지가 할머니를 불러요!

read_en.text: Grandma came dashing out of the kitchen, pitter-patter, still wearing her apron.
read_en.key: 할머니는 앞치마를 두른 채 부엌에서 후다닥 뛰어나왔어요.

read_en.text: Grandpa waited beside the turnip in the garden.
read_en.key: 텃밭에서 할아버지가 순무 곁에 기다리고 있었어요.

read_en.text: Grandma came running. "Let's do it together!"
read_en.key: 할머니가 달려왔어요. "같이 해 봐요!"

read_en.text: Grandma held on tight to Grandpa's waist. Heave-ho!
read_en.key: 할머니가 할아버지 허리를 꽉 잡았어요. 영차!

read_en.text: The turnip came up a little! But it still won't come out.
read_en.key: 순무가 한 뼘 올라왔어요! 그래도 안 뽑혀요.

read_en.text: Sweetie, come here and help us!
read_en.key: "손녀야, 이리 와서 좀 도와주렴!"

read_en.text: Grandpa and Grandma waited for their granddaughter in the garden.
read_en.key: 텃밭의 할아버지와 할머니는 손녀를 기다렸어요.

read_en.text: The granddaughter, who was playing in the yard, came skipping over.
read_en.key: 마당에서 놀던 손녀가 깡충깡충 달려왔어요.

read_en.text: "Sweetie~!" The granddaughter held Grandma's waist. Heave-ho!
read_en.key: "손녀야~!" 손녀가 할머니 허리를 잡았어요. 영차!

read_en.text: It came up a little more!
read_en.key: 조금 더 올라왔어요!

read_en.text: Even with three of them pulling, heave-ho, heave-ho, the turnip was still stuck fast in the ground.
read_en.key: 세 사람이 영차영차 당겨도 순무는 땅속에 꼭 박혀 있었어요.

read_en.text: A sound came from beside the garden where the three were pulling.
read_en.key: 세 사람이 당기는 텃밭 옆에서 소리가 났어요.

read_en.text: Woof woof from behind the bush!
read_en.key: 덤불 뒤에서 멍멍!

read_en.text: The puppy came bounding out. "I'll help too!"
read_en.key: 강아지가 뛰어나왔어요. "나도 도울게요!"

read_en.text: Woof woof! I am very, very strong!
read_en.key: "멍멍! 저도 힘이 아주 세요!"

read_en.text: The puppy held the granddaughter's skirt tight. Heave-ho!
read_en.key: 강아지가 손녀 치마를 꼭 붙잡았어요. 영차!

read_en.text: The turnip wiggled up a bit more, but it still would not come out.
read_en.key: 순무가 꿈틀, 조금 더 올라왔지만 아직도 뽑히지 않았어요.

read_en.text: In the garden, all four, including Dog, were pulling hard.
read_en.key: 텃밭에서는 강아지까지 넷이 힘을 쓰고 있었어요.

read_en.text: Meow from the barn roof!
read_en.key: 헛간 지붕에서 야옹!

read_en.text: The cat hopped down from the roof.
read_en.key: 고양이가 지붕에서 폴짝 내려왔어요.

read_en.text: Huh? The puppy and the cat are glaring at each other.
read_en.key: 어? 강아지랑 고양이가 서로 째려봐요.

read_en.text: "Hmph!" But the cat held the puppy's tail tight anyway.
read_en.key: "흥, 알았어!" 그래도 고양이가 강아지 꼬리를 꼭 잡았어요.

read_en.text: Even with five of them pulling, heave-ho, heave-ho, the turnip did not budge.
read_en.key: 다섯이 영차영차 당겨도 순무는 꼼짝하지 않았어요.

read_en.text: Phew, everyone got tired and plopped down.
read_en.key: 휴우, 모두 지쳐서 털썩 주저앉았어요.

read_en.text: As the five rested in the garden, a tiny sound came.
read_en.key: 다섯이 텃밭에 앉아 쉬는데 작은 소리가 났어요.

read_en.text: Squeak, squeak from a hole in the ground.
read_en.key: 흙구멍에서 찍찍 소리가 나요.

read_en.text: A teeny tiny mouse scurried out.
read_en.key: 아주 작은 생쥐가 쪼르르 나왔어요.

read_en.text: "You're too small. It won't work~"
read_en.key: "너무 작아서 안 될 거야~"

read_en.text: "Me too!" The mouse held the cat's tail tight.
read_en.key: "나도 할래요!" 생쥐가 고양이 꼬리를 꼭 잡았어요.

read_en.text: Everyone jumped right up and held on tight to the one in front.
read_en.key: 모두 벌떡 일어나 앞사람을 꼭 붙잡았어요.

read_en.text: The six stood in the garden and pulled the turnip again.
read_en.key: 텃밭에 선 여섯은 순무를 다시 당겼어요.

read_en.text: This time, all six together!
read_en.key: 이번엔 여섯이 다 함께!

read_en.text: Heave-ho, heave-ho! The turnip began to wobble and wiggle.
read_en.key: 영차, 영차! 순무가 흔들흔들 움직이기 시작했어요.

read_en.text: Pop! The big turnip came out! Everyone tumbled over backwards.
read_en.key: 쑥! 커다란 순무가 뽑혔어요! 모두 벌렁 넘어졌어요.

read_en.text: When everyone, even the tiny mouse, pulled together, it came out!
read_en.key: 작은 생쥐까지 모두 힘을 모았더니 뽑혔어요!

read_en.text: Thank you, everyone! And thank you too, little mouse.
read_en.key: "고맙다, 얘들아! 생쥐야, 너도 정말 고맙구나."

read_en.text: After pulling up the turnip, all six gathered in the house.
read_en.key: 순무를 뽑은 여섯은 집에 모였어요.

read_en.text: Grandpa chopped the turnip, chop, chop, chop, and Grandma brought out her biggest pot.
read_en.key: 할아버지는 순무를 숭덩숭덩 썰고, 할머니는 커다란 냄비를 꺼냈어요.

read_en.text: They cooked yummy turnip soup.
read_en.key: 맛있는 순무국을 끓였어요.

read_en.text: Bubble, bubble! A warm, tasty smell filled the whole house.
read_en.key: 보글보글, 구수한 냄새가 온 집 안에 퍼졌어요.

read_en.text: Let's share the soup, one bowl each.
read_en.key: 순무국을 한 그릇씩 나눠 줘요.

read_en.text: Six bowls for six friends! Just right.
read_en.key: 여섯 그릇, 여섯 명! 딱 맞아요.

read_en.text: They all ate it up together, yum.
read_en.key: 모두 함께 맛있게 먹었답니다.

read_en.text: Even the smallest strength becomes great big strength when everyone joins together.
read_en.key: 작은 힘도 모이면 커다란 힘이 된답니다.

어? 제일 큰 알은 아직이에요. 톡! 두드려 볼까요?
크고 회색인 아기 오리가 나왔어요! 머리에 알껍데기 모자를 썼네요.
엄마 오리가 아기들을 데리고 연못에 갔어요. 줄을 서서 헤엄쳐요.
회색 아기 오리는 헤엄을 제일 잘해요! 쏙 들어갔다가 퐁!
그런데 늘 줄 맨 끝에서 혼자 따라가요.
농장 마당에 닭이랑 오리들이 모여 있어요.
혼자 남은 아기 오리 마음은 어떨까요?

기쁜 얼굴이에요! 반짝이는 얼굴을 눌러 봐요.
슬픈 얼굴이에요! 반짝이는 얼굴을 눌러 봐요.
무서워하는 얼굴이에요! 반짝이는 얼굴을 눌러 봐요.
화난 얼굴이에요! 반짝이는 얼굴을 눌러 봐요.
맞아요. 아기 오리는 슬퍼요. 눈물이 똑 떨어졌어요.
아기 오리를 톡 눌러서 쓰다듬어 줄까요? "괜찮아."
그래도 아기 오리는 마음이 쓸쓸했어요. 넓은 세상을 보러 길을 떠났어요.
갈대가 아기 오리 머리보다 훨씬 높아요.
뒤뚱뒤뚱, 갈대숲을 지나 넓은 늪에 닿았어요.
저 멀리서 큰 소리가 났어요. 깜짝 놀란 기러기들이 모두 날아가 버렸어요.
맞아요. 아기 오리는 무서워요. 갈대 속에 웅크렸어요.
갈대를 톡 눌러서 아기 오리를 살포시 덮어 줄까요?
쉿, 이제 조용해요. 아기 오리는 갈대 속에서 포근하게 쉬었어요.
어느덧 가을이 되었어요. 아기 오리는 조금 더 자라 어린 새가 되었어요.
하늘 높이 하얀 새들이 줄지어 날아가요.
추운 겨울이 왔어요. 호수가 꽁꽁 얼어서 발이 얼음에 붙어 버렸어요.
아기 오리가 날개로 몸을 감싸서 따뜻하게!
날개로 몸을 꼭 감쌌더니 조금 따뜻해졌어요.
쩍! 얼음이 깨졌어요. 발이 쏙 빠졌어요!
농부 할아버지가 아기 오리를 품에 폭 안았어요. 따뜻한 집으로 가요!

en.text: On a warm summer day, Mama Duck sat on her nest, keeping her eggs warm.
Four little yellow ducklings hatched. Peep peep!
Hm? The biggest egg is still waiting. Tap it!
Tap the big egg!
A big gray duckling hatched! Look, an eggshell hat on its head.
Pop! The hat fell off.
Mama Duck said. "Oh my, this baby is big and gray. That's okay. You are all my babies!"
Mama Duck took her babies to the pond. They swam in a line.
Shall we tap to swim?
Tap! Swim!
The gray duckling swims the best! Dive in, and pop up!
But the gray duckling always follows at the very end of the line, all alone.
Chickens and ducks are gathered in the farmyard.
The rooster said. "Cock-a-doodle-doo! You're ugly!"
The ducks said. "Quack quack! You're not like us!"
How does the duckling feel?
How does the duckling feel now?
How does the lonely duckling feel?
How does the swan feel now?
Look closely at the duckling's face. What do the eyebrows and mouth look like?
It's a happy face! Tap the sparkling face.
It's a sad face! Tap the sparkling face.
It's a scared face! Tap the sparkling face.
It's an angry face! Tap the sparkling face.
That's right. The duckling is sad. A tear dropped.
Shall we tap the duckling to give it a gentle pat? "It's okay."
Tap! Give the duckling a gentle pat.
"It's okay. You are wonderful just as you are."
Mama Duck said too. "My baby swims the best!"
The rooster and the ducks felt shy and said. "Sorry for teasing you."
Still, the duckling felt lonely. So it set off to see the wide world.
The reeds are much taller than the duckling's head.
Tap to push the reeds apart.
Tap! Push the reeds apart.
Waddle, waddle, past the reeds, and on to a wide marsh.
Geese lived in the marsh.
The geese said. "Hello! Let's play together!"
That's right! The duckling is happy to have made friends.
The geese and the duckling played and played.
A loud noise came from far away. The startled geese all flew off.
That's right. The duckling is scared. It curled up in the reeds.
Shall we tap the reeds to cover the duckling softly?
Tap the reeds! Cover it softly.
Shh, it's quiet now. The duckling rested cozily in the reeds.
Before long, it was autumn. The duckling had grown a little and become a young bird.
White birds are flying high in the sky, in a line.
Whoo~ A sound like a trumpet! They are swans.
The duckling gazed up at the sky for a long, long time. "I want to fly like that, too."
Cold winter came. The lake froze solid, and the duckling's feet got stuck in the ice.
The duckling wraps its wings around itself to keep warm!
Wrapped tight in its wings, the duckling got a little warmer.
Then an old farmer passed by and saw the duckling. "Oh dear, your feet are stuck in the ice!"
Crack! The ice broke. The feet popped out!
The old farmer hugged the duckling close in both arms. Off to a warm house!
Grandma's house was warm, with a stove. A cat and a hen lived there too.
The cat said. "Meow. Can you purr?"
The duckling tried to copy it.
Not a purr, but a quack! Everyone burst out laughing. The duckling laughed too.
The hen said. "Cluck cluck. Then can you lay an egg?" The duckling shook its head.
What is the duckling good at?
Cat: "I'm good at purring~"
Hen: "I'm good at laying eggs~"
Remember? Dive into the pond, and pop up!
It's swimming! Tap the sparkling card.
That's right! The duckling swims the best.
The cat and the hen nodded. "I see! Everyone is good at different things."
Warm spring came. The duckling grew bigger and bigger.
Shall we tap the duckling to spread its wings wide?
Tap! Wings wide open!
Wow, the wings have grown so big!
Flap flap! The duckling is flying in the sky!
The duckling landed by the lake. Who is in the water?
A long white neck, big white wings…
"Huh? Is that me?" The duckling was a white swan!
Tap them in the order the duckling grew! What came first?
What came after the egg?
What came after the baby?
What came after the young bird?
"I'm next~"
It's the egg! Tap the sparkling card.
It's the baby! Tap the sparkling card.
It's the young bird! Tap the sparkling card.
It's the swan! Tap the sparkling card.
Egg, baby, young bird, and then swan! That's how it grew.
The swans swam over. "Hello! You're our friend too. Let's live together!"
That's right! The swan is so, so happy.
Far away, Mama Duck and the other ducklings wave their wings happily. "You've grown so much!"
Tap the swans to dance together!
The duckling who looked different grew into a wonderful swan, just like this.
Look closely at the swan's face. What do the eyebrows and mouth look like?

read_en.key: 그래도 아기 오리는 마음이 쓸쓸했어요. 넓은 세상을 보러 길을 떠났어요.

read_en.text: The duckling left the farm and went into the reeds alone.
read_en.key: 농장을 떠난 아기 오리는 혼자 갈대숲에 들어섰어요.

read_en.text: The reeds are much taller than the duckling's head.
read_en.key: 갈대가 아기 오리 머리보다 훨씬 높아요.

read_en.text: Sunlight twinkled, sparkle, sparkle, between the tall reeds.
read_en.key: 갈대 사이로 햇살이 반짝반짝 비쳤어요.

read_en.text: Rustle, rustle, the duckling pushed its way through the tall reeds.
read_en.key: 바스락바스락, 아기 오리는 갈대를 헤치며 나아갔어요.

read_en.text: Waddle, waddle, past the reeds, and on to a wide marsh.
read_en.key: 뒤뚱뒤뚱, 갈대숲을 지나 넓은 늪에 닿았어요.

read_en.text: After passing through the reeds, the duckling stopped at the marsh.
read_en.key: 갈대숲을 지난 아기 오리는 늪에서 걸음을 멈추었어요.

read_en.text: Geese lived in the marsh.
read_en.key: 늪에는 기러기들이 살고 있었어요.

read_en.text: The geese said. "Hello! Let's play together!"
read_en.key: 기러기들이 말했어요. "안녕! 우리랑 같이 놀자!"

read_en.text: The duckling hopped and hopped for joy. It had made friends!
read_en.key: 아기 오리는 기뻐서 폴짝폴짝 뛰었어요. 친구가 생겼거든요!

read_en.text: The geese and the duckling played and played.
read_en.key: 기러기들과 아기 오리는 신나게 놀았어요.

read_en.text: A loud noise came from far away. The startled geese all flew off.
read_en.key: 저 멀리서 큰 소리가 났어요. 깜짝 놀란 기러기들이 모두 날아가 버렸어요.

read_en.text: The duckling was so scared that it shivered and shook, and curled up in the reeds.
read_en.key: 아기 오리는 무서워서 덜덜 떨며 갈대 속에 웅크렸어요.

read_en.text: Shh, it's quiet now. The duckling rested cozily in the reeds.
read_en.key: 쉿, 이제 조용해요. 아기 오리는 갈대 속에서 포근하게 쉬었어요.

read_en.text: Before long, it was autumn. The duckling had grown a little and become a young bird.
read_en.key: 어느덧 가을이 되었어요. 아기 오리는 조금 더 자라 어린 새가 되었어요.

read_en.text: The duckling left the marsh and wandered beside an autumn lake.
read_en.key: 늪을 떠난 아기 오리는 가을 호숫가를 거닐었어요.

read_en.text: Colorful leaves came fluttering down, flit, flit, flit.
read_en.key: 알록달록 나뭇잎이 팔랑팔랑 떨어졌어요.

read_en.text: White birds are flying high in the sky, in a line.
read_en.key: 하늘 높이 하얀 새들이 줄지어 날아가요.

read_en.text: Whoo~ A sound like a trumpet! They are swans.
read_en.key: 뿌우~ 나팔 같은 소리! 백조들이에요.

read_en.text: The duckling gazed up at the sky for a long, long time. "I want to fly like that, too."
read_en.key: 아기 오리는 오래오래 하늘을 올려다보았어요. "나도 저렇게 날고 싶다."

read_en.text: Snow fell around the duckling, alone beside the lake.
read_en.key: 호숫가에 혼자 남은 아기 오리 곁으로 눈이 내렸어요.

read_en.text: Cold winter came. The lake froze solid, and the duckling's feet got stuck in the ice.
read_en.key: 추운 겨울이 왔어요. 호수가 꽁꽁 얼어서 발이 얼음에 붙어 버렸어요.

read_en.text: The cold wind blew, whoosh, whoosh, and the duckling shivered, brrr, brrr.
read_en.key: 찬 바람이 쌩쌩 불고, 아기 오리는 오들오들 떨었어요.

read_en.text: Wrapped tight in its wings, the duckling got a little warmer.
read_en.key: 날개로 몸을 꼭 감쌌더니 조금 따뜻해졌어요.

read_en.text: Then an old farmer passed by and saw the duckling. "Oh dear, your feet are stuck in the ice!"
read_en.key: 그때 농부 할아버지가 지나가다 아기 오리를 보았어요. "저런, 얼음에 발이 붙었구나!"

read_en.text: The old farmer banged on the ice, bang, bang, bang.
read_en.key: 할아버지는 얼음을 쿵쿵 두드렸어요.

read_en.text: Crack! The ice broke. The feet popped out!
read_en.key: 쩍! 얼음이 깨졌어요. 발이 쏙 빠졌어요!

read_en.text: The old farmer hugged the duckling close in both arms. Off to a warm house!
read_en.key: 농부 할아버지가 아기 오리를 품에 폭 안았어요. 따뜻한 집으로 가요!

read_en.text: The old farmer's arms were warm and snug, and the duckling's eyes slowly drifted shut.
read_en.key: 할아버지 품은 포근포근, 아기 오리는 스르르 눈을 감았어요.

read_en.text: The farmer brought the duckling to the house where Grandma was.
read_en.key: 농부 할아버지는 아기 오리를 할머니가 있는 집에 데려다주었어요.

read_en.text: Grandma's house was warm, with a stove. A cat and a hen lived there too.
read_en.key: 할머니 집은 난로가 있어 따뜻했어요. 고양이와 암탉도 함께 살았어요.

read_en.text: The fire crackled, crackle, crackle, and the duckling's feathers dried soft and fluffy.
read_en.key: 난로 불이 타닥타닥, 아기 오리 깃털이 보송보송 말랐어요.

read_en.text: The cat said. "Meow. Can you purr?"
read_en.key: 고양이가 말했어요. "야옹. 너, 가르릉 할 줄 아니?"

read_en.text: The duckling tried to copy it.
read_en.key: 아기 오리가 흉내를 내 보았어요.

read_en.text: Not a purr, but a quack! Everyone burst out laughing. The duckling laughed too.
read_en.key: 가르릉이 아니라 꽥! 모두 깔깔 웃었어요. 아기 오리도 웃었어요.

read_en.text: The hen said. "Cluck cluck. Then can you lay an egg?" The duckling shook its head.
read_en.key: 암탉이 말했어요. "꼬꼬. 그럼 알은 낳을 줄 아니?" 아기 오리는 고개를 저었어요.

read_en.text: "But I swim the best! Splish, splash!" the duckling said proudly.
read_en.key: "그래도 헤엄은 내가 제일 잘해! 첨벙첨벙!" 아기 오리가 자랑스럽게 말했어요.

read_en.text: The cat and the hen nodded. "I see! Everyone is good at different things."
read_en.key: 고양이와 암탉이 고개를 끄덕였어요. "그렇구나! 모두 잘하는 게 다르구나."

read_en.text: Warm spring came. The duckling grew bigger and bigger.
read_en.key: 따뜻한 봄이 왔어요. 아기 오리는 몸이 부쩍 자랐어요.

read_en.text: The duckling came outside into the spring breeze.
read_en.key: 집 밖으로 나온 아기 오리가 봄바람을 맞았어요.

read_en.text: The duckling stretched, streeetch, and spread its wings out wide.
read_en.key: 아기 오리는 기지개를 쭉 켜고 날개를 활짝 펼쳤어요.

read_en.text: Wow, the wings have grown so big!
read_en.key: 와, 날개가 이렇게 커졌어요!

read_en.text: Flap, flap, flap, flap! Its feet lifted up, just a little, off the ground.
read_en.key: 파닥파닥, 파닥파닥! 발이 땅에서 살짝 떠올랐어요.

read_en.text: Flap flap! The duckling is flying in the sky!
read_en.key: 훨훨! 아기 오리가 하늘을 날아요!

read_en.text: The duckling landed by the lake. Who is in the water?
read_en.key: 아기 오리가 호숫가에 내려앉았어요. 물에 누가 비쳤을까요?

read_en.text: When the ripples settled, lap, lap, a white bird appeared in the water.
read_en.key: 물결이 찰랑찰랑 잔잔해지자, 하얀 새 한 마리가 보였어요.

read_en.text: A long white neck, big white wings…
read_en.key: 길고 하얀 목, 커다란 하얀 날개…

read_en.text: "Huh? Is that me?" The duckling was a white swan!
read_en.key: "어? 이게 나야?" 아기 오리는 하얀 백조였어요!

read_en.text: Egg, baby, young bird, and then swan! That's how it grew.
read_en.key: 알, 아기, 어린 새, 그리고 백조! 이렇게 자랐어요.

read_en.text: Ripples spread beside the swan as he looked at his reflection.
read_en.key: 물에 비친 모습을 보던 백조 곁으로 물결이 일렁였어요.

read_en.text: The swans swam over. "Hello! You're our friend too. Let's live together!"
read_en.key: 백조들이 헤엄쳐 왔어요. "안녕! 너도 우리 친구야. 같이 살자!"

read_en.text: The swan was so happy it flapped its wings, flap, flap, and stretched its neck up high.
read_en.key: 백조는 기뻐서 날개를 파닥파닥, 목을 쭉 뻗었어요.

read_en.text: Far away, Mama Duck and the other ducklings wave their wings happily. "You've grown so much!"
read_en.key: 저 멀리 엄마 오리와 형제들도 반갑게 날개를 흔들어요. "잘 자랐구나!"

read_en.text: The swans bobbed and floated on the water, dancing together.
read_en.key: 백조들은 둥실둥실 물 위에서 함께 춤을 췄어요.

read_en.text: The duckling who looked different grew into a wonderful swan, just like this.
read_en.key: 다르게 생겼던 아기 오리는 이렇게 멋진 백조로 자랐답니다.

read_en.text: It's okay to be different. Everyone grows up wonderful in their own way.
read_en.key: 달라도 괜찮아요. 모두 저마다 멋지게 자란답니다.

read_en.key: 사박, 사박. 조용한 발소리가 점점 가까워졌어요.

read_en.text: Who came up behind Dahyun?
read_en.key: 다현이 뒤에 누가 왔을까요?

read_en.text: There in the moonlight stood a white unicorn.
read_en.key: 달빛 아래, 하얀 유니콘이 서 있었어요.

read_en.text: The unicorn spoke gently to Dahyun.
read_en.key: 유니콘이 다현이에게 다정하게 말했어요.

read_en.text: I was here all along.
read_en.key: 나는 계속 여기 있었어.

read_en.text: I saw how kind you were, every time.
read_en.key: 네가 친절한 걸 다 보고 있었어.

read_en.text: To the sheep, to the deer, and to the horse, too.
read_en.key: 양에게도, 사슴에게도, 말에게도 말이야.

read_en.text: A unicorn...!
read_en.key: 유니콘…!

read_en.text: Dahyun's eyes shone, sparkle, sparkle. Her heart went thump, thump, thump.
read_en.key: 다현이의 눈이 반짝반짝 빛났어요. 가슴이 콩닥콩닥 뛰었지요.

read_en.text: Dahyun hugged the unicorn tight.
read_en.key: 다현이는 유니콘을 꼭 안았어요.

read_en.text: The next morning, Dahyun came back to the hill by her home with the unicorn.
read_en.key: 다음 날 아침, 다현이는 유니콘과 함께 집 앞 언덕으로 돌아왔어요.

read_en.text: Dahyun gently tucked the red flower from her basket into the unicorn's mane.
read_en.key: 다현이는 바구니 속 빨간 꽃을 유니콘 갈기에 살며시 꽂아 주었어요.

read_en.text: The unicorn thanked Dahyun.
read_en.key: 유니콘이 다현이에게 고맙다고 말했어요.

read_en.text: Thank you. It's so pretty!
read_en.key: 고마워, 정말 예뻐!

read_en.text: If you are kind to someone, you can meet a unicorn of your very own.
read_en.key: 너도 누군가에게 친절하면, 너만의 유니콘을 만날 수 있답니다.

ko.text: 핼러윈 밤이에요. 바람을 타고 무언가 팔랑팔랑 날아왔어요.
거리 끝 사탕 가게 창이 환하게 켜졌어요.
어서 와, 친구들! 나는 사탕 마녀야.
다현이랑 친구들은 사탕 가게로 쪼르르 들어갔어요.
오늘은 핼러윈 특별 사탕을 만들 거야. 먼저 솥을 끓여야지.
화르륵! 불이 활활, 솥이 뽀글뽀글 끓기 시작했어요.
핼러윈 사탕 재료야! 빨간 건 아기 용 콧물이랑 소방차, 노란 건 호박 등이랑 병아리 방귀!
파란 건 괴물 응가랑 파란 생선, 초록은 개구리랑 공룡!
히히, 색을 섞으면 다른 색 사탕이 돼. 먹으면 어떻게 되는지는… 비밀! 같이 만들까?
그럼 다현이가 먼저, 마지막엔 다 같이!
넣고 싶은 재료를 톡 눌러 솥에 넣어요.
다현이가 넣어 줘. 하나든 여러 개든 좋아.
빨강이랑 노랑을 섞으면 무슨 색이 될까요? 톡 눌러요.
노랑이랑 파랑을 섞으면 무슨 색이 될까요? 톡 눌러요.
빨강이랑 파랑을 섞으면 무슨 색이 될까요? 톡 눌러요.
빨강이랑 초록을 섞으면 무슨 색이 될까요? 톡 눌러요.
초록이랑 노랑을 섞으면 무슨 색이 될까요? 톡 눌러요.
초록이랑 파랑을 섞으면 무슨 색이 될까요? 톡 눌러요.
빨강만 넣었더니 빨간 딸기 사탕이 됐어요!
노랑만 넣었더니 노란 오리 사탕이 됐어요!
파랑만 넣었더니 파란 물고기 사탕이 됐어요!
뿅! 다현이의 볼이랑 배가 호박처럼 환해졌어요!
뿅! 다현이 등에 박쥐 날개가 돋았어요!
뿅! 다현이 입에 초콜릿 수염이 났어요!
길을 데굴데굴 굴러가다 호박 등에 통!
폴짝, 폴짝, 폴짝! 지붕 위에서 손을 흔들었어요.
박쥐 친구들이랑 달 앞을 빙글 돌았어요.
아까랑 같네? 다음엔 다른 색도 해 봐!
한 번 더 하려면 솥을 톡 눌러요.
마지막은 핼러윈 특별 사탕! 색을 전부 다 넣는 거야. 다 같이!
이번엔 빨강, 노랑, 파랑 다 넣어요! 톡 눌러요.
하나, 둘, 셋! 색을 전부 섞으면…
유령 흉내를 내며 마을을 한 바퀴 돌았어요. 하나도 안 무서워요, 다 웃고 있거든요.
자, 약속! 남은 사탕 다 나와라!
솥에서 사탕이 퐁퐁퐁 쏟아졌어요. 모두 하나씩… 마녀는 두 개!
뿅, 뿅, 뿅! 딸기, 개구리, 오리, 박쥐, 물고기, 호박… 다 같이 변신!
다현이 덕분에 사탕이 가득! 내년에도 같이 섞자.
초록만 넣었더니 초록 악어 사탕이 됐어요!
뿅! 다현이가 동그란 연두 키위가 됐어요!
통, 통, 통! 키위 공처럼 길을 통통 튀어 갔어요.
뿅! 다현이한테 초록 악어 꼬리가 생겼어요!
엉금엉금 기어가다 앙! 호박이가 깜짝 놀라 폴짝 뛰었어요.

en.text: It's Halloween night. Something came fluttering, fluttering on the wind.
Oh? An invitation! There's a cauldron and candy on it!
At the end of the street, the candy shop window lit up bright.
Come in, come in, friends! I'm the Candy Witch.
Dahyun and her friends scurried right into the candy shop.
Today we're making special Halloween candy. First, we have to get the cauldron bubbling.
Tap the firewood to light the fire.
Whoosh! The fire blazed, and the cauldron began to bubble, bubble, bubble.
Meow!
These are the Halloween candy ingredients! For red, baby dragon snot and a fire truck. For yellow, a pumpkin lantern and chick toots!
For blue, monster poo and a blue fish. And for green, a frog and a dinosaur!
Eww! Snot and poo?

chick fart and

monster poo and

the red fire truck went in!
the ladybug went in!

the rubber duck went in!
monster poo went in!
the blue fish went in!
the blue wave went in!
the green frog went in!
the green dinosaur went in!
the grilled green onion went in!
Eww! Snot?
Eww! Poo?
Nya... stinky!
Hee hee, mix the colours and you get a different colour candy. What happens when you eat it is... a secret! Shall we make some together?
Yes! I want to do it!
Then Dahyun goes first, and at the very end, all together!
Tap the ingredients you want to drop into the cauldron.
Dahyun, you put them in. One or lots, it's all good.
Three colours? That's for the very end!
You have to put in at least one!
All in? Then let's stir!
Here we go, stir, stir. Bubble, bubble...
What colour do you get when you mix red and yellow?
What colour do you get when you mix yellow and blue?
What colour do you get when you mix red and blue?
What colour do you get when you mix red and green?
What colour do you get when you mix green and yellow?
What colour do you get when you mix green and blue?
What colour will red and yellow make? Tap to choose.
What colour will yellow and blue make? Tap to choose.
What colour will red and blue make? Tap to choose.
What colour will red and green make? Tap to choose.
What colour will green and yellow make? Tap to choose.
What colour will green and blue make? Tap to choose.
That one's orange.
That one's green.
That one's purple.
That one's brown.
That's right, orange!
That's right, green!
That's right, purple!
That's right, brown!
Only red went in... so it stays red!
Only yellow went in... so it stays yellow!
Only blue went in... so it stays blue!
Only green went in... so it stays green!
Red and yellow mixed together made orange!
Yellow and blue mixed together made green!
Red and blue mixed together made purple!
Red and green mixed together made brown!
Green and blue mixed together made teal!
Only red went in, so it became a red strawberry candy!
Only yellow went in, so it became a yellow duck candy!
Only blue went in, so it became a blue fish candy!
Pop! Candies came popping out of the cauldron.
You try one first.
But it's made from snot... eww...
Huh? It's yummy! ...It's strawberry candy!
Huh? It's yummy! ...It's duck candy!
Huh? It's yummy! ...It's fish candy!
Huh? It's yummy! ...It's frog candy!
Huh? It's yummy! ...It's pumpkin candy!
Huh? It's yummy! ...It's bat candy!
Huh? It's yummy! ...It's chocolate candy!
Yum... it's strawberry candy!
Yum... it's duck candy!
Yum... it's fish candy!
Yum... it's frog candy!
Yum... it's pumpkin candy!
Yum... it's bat candy!
Yum... it's chocolate candy!
Poof! Dahyun turned into a red strawberry!
Poof! Dahyun's feet turned into duck feet!
Poof! Dahyun grew a fish tail!
Poof! Dahyun's cheeks and tummy glowed like a pumpkin!
Poof! Bat wings sprouted on Dahyun's back!
Poof! Dahyun grew a chocolate moustache!
Rolly, rolly, roll... somebody stop me!
Quack, quack... huh? My feet!
I'm swimming in the sky!
Ribbit! Hop, all the way up to the roof!
My tummy turned into a lantern!
Flap, flap, hello, Moon!
Drip, drip... I'm melting!
Hee hee, it's Halloween magic!
At the end, all together!
She rolled and rolled down the street and bonked into a pumpkin lantern!
Waddle, waddle, and Pumpkin the cat waddled too.
She swam, bubble bubble, all around the full moon.
Hop, hop, hop! She waved from up on the roof.
The dark street grew bright, all thanks to Dahyun.
She circled in front of the moon with her bat friends.
She went flat as a pancake... then poof!
Where are you going!
She melted!
Poof! Dahyun was back to normal.
This time, shall we try a different colour?
Tap the ingredients!
Same as before? Next time, try a different colour too!
Want to do it one more time?
To go one more time, tap the cauldron.
Whoosh, the cauldron water turned clear again.
Last of all, the special Halloween candy! We put in every single colour. All together!
Every single one?
This time, put in red, yellow and blue, all of them! Tap!
One, two, three! When you mix all the colours...
Bubble, bubble... POP!
Out came a black candy!
Huh? My lips turned black! It's ghost candy!
Hee hee, me too!
The witch, Pumpkin the cat and the friends, all with black lips...
They marched around the village pretending to be ghosts. Not scary at all, because everyone was laughing.
Now, as promised! All the leftover candy, come on out!
Candy came pouring out of the cauldron, pop, pop, pop. One for everyone... and two for the witch!
Hee hee, two for me!
Poof, poof, poof! Strawberry, frog, duck, bat, fish, pumpkin... everyone changed together!
Poof! Everyone back to normal.
Thanks to Dahyun, we have candy galore! Let's mix again next year.
Yes! Next time, with different colours!
Tap the Candy Witch to say goodbye.
Green and yellow mixed together made lime green!
Only green went in, so it became a green crocodile candy!
Yum... it's kiwi candy!
Yum... it's crocodile candy!
Poof! Dahyun turned into a round lime-green kiwi!
So fuzzy... it tickles! Hee hee!
Boing, boing, boing! She bounced down the street like a kiwi ball.
Poof! Dahyun grew a green crocodile tail!
Snap! Snap! I'm a crocodile!
She crawled along, creep, creep... then SNAP! Pumpkin the cat jumped in surprise.
Poof! Dahyun turned into a teal frog!

ko.text: 아주 먼 옛날, 엄마 염소와 일곱 마리 아기 염소가 살았어요.

"엄마는 풀을 뜯으러 다녀올게. 늑대가 오면 문을 열어 주면 안 돼!"

엄마가 가고 얼마 뒤, 문밖에서 소리가 났어요.
늑대는 밀가루를 발에 묻혀서, 하얀 발을 쑥 내밀었어요.
그런데 들어온 건 엄마가 아니라 늑대였어요!
막내는 키 큰 시계 속에 쏙 숨었어요. 아무도 몰랐어요.
늑대는 시계 속만 빼고, 아기 염소들을 모두 찾아내서 꿀꺽 삼켜 버렸어요.
하지만 아기 염소들은 다치지 않았어요. 아주 따뜻하고 포근한 뱃속이었거든요.
집에 돌아온 엄마 염소는 깜짝 놀랐어요.
늑대는 배가 불러서, 나무 아래에서 쿨쿨 자고 있었어요.
"쉿! 늑대가 깨지 않게, 살살 배에서 아기들을 꺼내 줄게."
엄마가 가위로 슥삭슥삭, 늑대 배를 열었어요. 늑대는 쿨쿨 자고 있었어요.
엄마가 바늘로 콕콕콕 꿰맸어요. 늑대는 아무것도 몰랐어요.
늑대는 흠뻑 젖은 채 멀리멀리 도망갔어요.
엄마와 일곱 아기 염소는 손을 잡고 신나게 춤을 추었어요.
아기 염소를 톡! 눌러 같이 춤춰 봐요!
엄마 목소리를 잘 아는 아기 염소들은 오래오래 행복하게 살았답니다.
막내 염소를 톡 눌러서 시계 속에 숨겨 줘요!

en.text: Long, long ago, a mother goat and seven little kids lived together.
One day, Mother Goat picked up a basket and said,
I'm going out to eat some grass. Don't open the door if the wolf comes!
The wolf has a rough voice and black paws. Remember!
Yes, Mother! The little goats answered in loud voices.
Soon after Mother left, there was a sound outside the door.
Children, it's Mother. Open the door! It was a rough voice.
The little goats looked at each other.
That voice is rough. You're not our mother! said the oldest kid.
Go away, wolf! the little goats shouted.
The wolf thought hard.
I need a sweet voice. Shall I eat some chalk?
The wolf's voice became thin and sweet.
Children, it's Mother. Open the door, please~
Then show us your paw through the crack! said the little goats.
The wolf dipped his paw in flour and stuck out a white paw.
Achoo! The wolf sneezed flour.
Oh? A white paw! It's Mother! The little goats were fooled and opened the door.
But it was not Mother who came in. It was the wolf!
Hide, hide! The little goats hid in the blankets and in the laundry basket, pop, pop.
Where will the youngest hide?
The youngest hid inside the tall clock. Nobody knew.
Where did you hide? I'll find every one of you! The wolf searched the house.
The wolf found all the little goats except the one in the clock, and gulped them down.
But the little goats were not hurt. It was warm and cozy inside his tummy.
Mother Goat came home and was very surprised.
Children, where are you? Mother is home!
Mother! The youngest hopped out of the clock.
The wolf gulped down my brothers and sisters!
Don't worry. Mother will save them! Mother took her scissors and needle.
The wolf was full, and he was fast asleep under a tree.
Mother and the youngest tiptoed closer.
Shh! So the wolf won't wake up, I'll gently take the little ones out of his tummy.
Snip, snip! Mother opened the wolf's tummy with her scissors. The wolf kept on snoring.
Mother! All six little goats came out safe and sound.
Now let's put stones in the wolf's tummy.
Mother stitched with her needle, poke, poke, poke. The wolf did not notice a thing.
The wolf woke up and stumbled to his feet.
Oh dear, my tummy is so heavy. I'm thirsty!
I must drink water from the well.
Splash! The wolf fell into the well.
Yikes, it's cold! I'm never coming back!
The wolf ran far, far away, dripping wet.
Mother and the seven little goats held hands and danced happily.
Tap a little goat to dance together!
The little goats who knew Mother's voice well lived happily for a long, long time.
Tap Mother Goat!
Tap the youngest goat to hide him in the clock!
Tap, tap the wolf's tummy!
Tap the wolf!
Tap the stone!

read_en.key: 풍덩! 늑대가 우물에 빠졌어요.

read_en.text: Yikes, it's cold! I'm never coming back!
read_en.key: "으악, 차가워! 다시는 안 올 거야!"

read_en.text: The wolf ran far, far away, dripping wet.
read_en.key: 늑대는 흠뻑 젖은 채 멀리멀리 도망갔어요.

read_en.text: The goat family gathered by the well after the wolf ran away.
read_en.key: 늑대가 달아난 우물가에 염소 가족이 모였어요.

read_en.text: Mother and the seven little goats held hands and danced happily.
read_en.key: 엄마와 일곱 아기 염소는 손을 잡고 신나게 춤을 추었어요.

read_en.text: Round and round, hop, hop, hop! Their giggles rang out, tee-hee-hee.
read_en.key: 빙글빙글, 깡충깡충! 웃음소리가 까르르 울려 퍼졌지요.

read_en.text: "We will never forget Mother's voice again!" the little goats all said together.
read_en.key: "이제 엄마 목소리는 절대 안 잊을래요!" 아기 염소들이 입을 모았어요.

read_en.text: The little goats who knew Mother's voice well lived happily for a long, long time.
read_en.key: 엄마 목소리를 잘 아는 아기 염소들은 오래오래 행복하게 살았답니다.

read_en.text: Remember what Mother says, and never open the door to a stranger.
read_en.key: 엄마 말을 잘 기억하고, 낯선 이에게는 문을 열어 주지 않는답니다.
